raw.excerpt: As a Client Manager, you will be a trusted advisor to a portfolio of clients, driving adoption, engagement, and business value through NielsenIQ's proprietary solutions.
raw.description:
As a Client Manager, you will be a trusted advisor to a portfolio of clients, driving adoption, engagement, and business value through NielsenIQ's proprietary solutions. You'll build strong relationships, lead strategic conversations, and help clients unlock new opportunities through data-driven insights and innovation.

Acting as the voice of the customer, you'll partner across Product, Analytics, and Commercial teams to shape the future of our solutions while delivering an exceptional client experience. If you're passionate about retail, data, and building meaningful partnerships, this is your opportunity to make a measurable impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with client stakeholders across Retail Collaboration programs, driving engagement, adoption, and business growth.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to internal and external clients, being a strong voice, resolving issues proactively and consistently delivering measurable business value.
  • Train and consult clients on NielsenIQ solutions, datasets, and analytics, providing guidance on best practices for integrating insights into key business processes/workflows such as category reviews, joint business planning, assortment optimization, and product innovation.
  • Lead onboarding, training, and enablement activities, including the development and delivery of live and recorded product demonstrations, workshops, and educational content.
  • Manage and prioritize multiple client initiatives and collaboration programs simultaneously, ensuring successful execution against timelines, objectives, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams and subject matter experts to identify client needs, validate requirements, and deliver high-quality solutions and materials.
  • Document, refine, and optimize processes and program workflows to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and the overall client experience.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, Retail Management, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in client management, customer success, account management, retail analytics, category management, consulting, or a related field.
  • Experience working with retailers, suppliers, CPG/FMCG manufacturers, syndicated market data, or retail technology solutions.
  • Proven ability to build, manage, and grow client relationships while driving adoption, retention, and business outcomes.
  • Strong consultative, communication, and presentation skills, with experience delivering business reviews, training, and strategic recommendations to client stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client programs, projects, and priorities while navigating competing business needs.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data and insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Experience collaborating across cross-functional teams to deliver client solutions and achieve business objectives.
  • Strong understanding of analytics solutions, SaaS platforms, and data-driven business processes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting contract renewals, client retention strategies, adoption initiatives, or business growth opportunities.
  • Familiarity with NielsenIQ datasets, retail measurement, category management, joint business planning, assortment optimization, or collaboration platforms.
  • Experience leading client onboarding, training, enablement, and change management initiatives.
  • Experience with SQL, Python, visualization tools, or other analytical and reporting technologies.
  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or supporting the development of junior team members.

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation of the following range: $83,700 - $95,000.  Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role might also be eligible for a sales-based incentive or performance-based bonus. Other benefits include flexible working environment, comprehensive health insurance, industry-leading parental leave, life insurance, education support and more.

  • Comprehensive healthcare plan (medical, Rx, dental, and vision).
  • Flexible spending accounts and a Health Savings Account (including company contributions).

  • 401(k) retirement plan including company matching contributions.

  • Tuition Reimbursement.
  • Discretionary paid time off program and 11 paid holidays.

raw.description:
Elevate your career with MANTECH International Corporation! Join a dynamic team dedicated to national security through cutting-edge technology. Since 1968, MANTECH has led in delivering advanced solutions to government intelligence, the Department of Defense, and Federal Civilian sectors. Dive into innovation in Digital Transformation, Cybersecurity, IT, Data Analytics and Software Development. Your journey to impactful work and rapid growth starts now—be extraordinary at MANTECH!

MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Senior Hyperion Developer to join our team supporting the Programming, Budgeting, and Execution System (PBES). Role isRemote with office visits to the Arlington, VA office monthly.


The Senior Hyperion Developer will leverage their strong technical background and expertise to design, develop, maintain, and optimize Hyperion enterprise performance management applications in support of critical financial planning and budgeting systems.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design, develop, and maintain complex Hyperion Financial Management (HFM) and Hyperion Planning applications to support financial forecasting and execution.
  • Develop and tune calculation scripts, business rules, MAXL scripts, and data load rules to ensure optimal application performance and accurate data processing.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders, financial analysts, and system architects to translate complex business requirements into technical system specifications.
  • Integrate Hyperion components with upstream and downstream data sources, ensuring seamless data flows and reporting accuracy across enterprise systems.
  • Perform system administration tasks, routine maintenance, performance tuning, data reconciliations, and troubleshooting across development and production environments.
  • Recommend, test, and implement approved system enhancements, process improvements, and automated workflows to increase operational efficiency.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Hyperion development and administration.
  • Expertise with Oracle Hyperion EPM Suite (Hyperion Planning, HFM, Essbase, Smart View, and Financial Reporting).
  • Experience writing and optimizing MAXL scripts, MDX queries, calculation scripts, and business rules.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting the Programming, Budgeting, and Execution System (PBES) or DoD financial management applications.
  • Solid understanding of government budgeting, execution processes, and enterprise financial systems.
  • Oracle Certified Professional or relevant Oracle Hyperion certifications.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex data anomalies, system bottlenecks, and integration failures.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with database administration, SQL querying, and ETL tools supporting financial databases.
  • Self-starter with strong problem-solving skills capable of driving project deliverables independently in a fast-paced environment.

Clearance Requirements:

  • Must have a current/active Secret security clearance

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
  • Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, and related equipment.
  • Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations and exchanging accurate information in these situations.



The projected compensation range for this position is $117,000.00-$195,100.00. There are differentiating factors that can impact a final salary/hourly rate, including, but not limited to, Contract Wage Determination, relevant work experience, skills and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location (For Remote Opportunities), education and certifications as well as Federal Government Contract Labor categories. In addition, MANTECH invests in its employees beyond just compensation. MANTECH’s benefits offerings include, dependent upon position, Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, Holiday Pay, short-term and long-term Disability, Retirement and Savings, Learning and Development opportunities, wellness programs as well as other optional benefit elections.

MANTECH considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to disability or veteran status or any other status protected under any federal, state, or local law or regulation.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply for a position with MANTECH, please email us at and provide your name and contact information.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Chomps is America’s fastest-growing meat snack brand, redefining convenient snacking with a commitment to real ingredients and bold, satisfying flavors. Crafted from 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef and venison, along with antibiotic-free turkey and chicken, each Chomps meat stick delivers 10+ grams of high-quality protein without sugar, hormones, soy, dairy, artificial preservatives, artificial nitrates, or MSG. Seasoned with a blend of flavorful herbs and spices, Chomps provides a nutritious protein snack for the whole family. As a minority-owned, family-operated, and B Corporation-certified business, Chomps prioritizes thoughtful sourcing and recently earned the non–ultra-processed food certification through the non-GMO project. Discover a new standard in snacking at www.chomps.com.

Traits of a Chompian

If you’ve been called nimble, resourceful, and persistent, then you might just be a Chompian. You’re a team player who’s self-motivated and action-oriented. You’re committed to delivering efficiency and accuracy, and you happen to be great at proactive cross-functional communication. You’re a critical thinker and a natural problem solver who enjoys details, research, and data. You take initiative and complete ownership of everything you do, and you’ll go the extra mile for your team, consumers, and audience. You’re hungry to learn with a passion to grow and improve every day. You also take a keen interest in health, fitness, and nutrition. Sound like you? Then we want to meat you.

What You Will Do

The Senior Manager, Fulfillment is responsible for managing day-to-day fulfillment execution and the customer service function to ensure Chomps’ fulfillment network operates with accuracy, accountability, cost discipline, and scalability. This role translates established fulfillment priorities into clear operating routines and partner expectations across multiple distribution locations and 3PL partners. The ideal candidate brings strong fulfillment and 3PL management experience, understands order execution and customer service operations, and can turn complex operational priorities into practical processes, measurable results, and clear cross-functional communication.

Role Expectations: This role is expected to independently manage recurring fulfillment and customer service cadences, 3PL partner follow-up, KPI reporting, process controls, order exception management, and customer escalations. This role will also provide operational inputs, data analysis, customer and service insights, risk visibility, and execution support to leadership for network planning, budget development, partner governance, and material service, cost, compliance, or performance escalations.

Responsibilities

  • Fulfillment Network Operations & 3PL Management
    • Support daily fulfillment operations across a growing multi-node distribution network, ensuring accurate order execution, capacity readiness, inventory flow, cost discipline, and consistent partner follow-through.
    • Manage weekly and monthly 3PL operating cadences, including partner meetings, KPI reviews, action-item tracking, QBR content preparation, performance follow-up, corrective action tracking, SLA monitoring, root-cause analysis, and readiness checkpoints.
    • Create, maintain, and continuously improve scalable SOPs, process controls, compliance requirements, and partner playbooks covering receiving, inventory control, order release, allocation, pick/pack/ship execution, exception management, and partner escalation paths, ensuring consistent execution across distribution nodes and customer channels.
    • Support fulfillment budget management by preparing invoice audits, spend analysis, productivity tracking, cost-per-order or cost-per-case reporting, and cost-reduction recommendations across the partner network.
  • Order Management & Allocation
    • Manage order allocation across wholesale, retail, eCommerce, and other channels, balancing customer requirements, inventory availability, freight efficiency, production constraints, and service commitments.
    • Partner with Sales, Planning, Transportation, Finance, Customer Supply Chain, and Operations to execute customer requirements, manage order flow constraints, support inventory positioning decisions, and provide cost-to-serve inputs.
    • Drive proactive exception management for constrained inventory, customer allocation decisions, backorder risk, order holds, shipment readiness, and cross-functional communication.
  • Customer Service
    • Lead day-to-day customer service for wholesale, retail, distributor, and eCommerce accounts, serving as the operational link between Chomps’ fulfillment network and its customers. Oversee order status and shipment inquiries, the shared Customer Service inbox, and open-order review, catching PO issues (pricing errors, MOQ shortfalls, unapproved NetSuite POs, missed ship-by dates) before shipment.
    • Set the team’s structure and standards, including priorities, ownership boundaries, escalation paths, channel coverage, backup plans, a shared tracker, and an SOP library. Define and monitor KPIs such as inbox response time, on-time weekly PO updates, PO issue resolution time, OTIF, and fill rate.
    • Serve as the primary supply chain point of contact for key customers, supporting business reviews and new-customer onboarding. Partner with Sales, Account Management, Planning, and Quality to resolve customer issues and deliver weekly PO status updates, cut and delay notices, post-allocation ETAs, key-account update files, and customer portal PO approvals.
    • Own processes for PO revisions, cancellations, and expedites; UDRs, shortages, damages, and returns; and chargebacks, deductions, and disputes, with clear ownership from intake through resolution. Manage retailer compliance (routing guides, vendor manuals, labeling mandates, ASN accuracy, EDI readiness, and appointment scheduling) to protect OTIF and minimize penalties.
    • Turn customer feedback and performance trends into process improvements, driving root-cause analysis and corrective action with 3PLs, carriers, and internal teams to reduce chargebacks, shorten PO-to-delivery cycle time, and manage cost-to-serve. Partner with Planning on retailer demand signals, In-Stock %, Weeks of Supply, and CPFR with key accounts.
  • Technology, Reporting & KPIs
    • Support business-side execution of order management and fulfillment automation improvements, including reducing manual touches, improving order accuracy, strengthening exception workflows, supporting UAT, driving adoption, and increasing visibility across systems and 3PL partners.
    • Partner with Digital Transformation, Business Analytics, Sales Operations, and 3PL technology teams on NetSuite and partner-system improvements, including requirements, EDI/API integrations, order routing logic, reporting, issue tracking, and operational controls.
    • Own fulfillment scorecards and KPI reporting across service, cost, compliance, productivity, inventory flow, automation adoption, customer requirements, and partner performance, converting recurring issues into corrective action plans, partner follow-up, leadership-ready updates, and prioritized improvement recommendations.
    • Build ad hoc analyses that identify service risks, cost drivers, recurring partner issues, customer compliance exposure, inventory constraints, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Launch Readiness
    • Manage operational readiness for fulfillment, ensuring 3PL processes, documentation flows, lot traceability, shipment readiness, customer requirements, and exception management are defined and consistently executed.
    • Coordinate operational launch readiness for new customers, channels, facilities, lanes, and market launches by confirming people, processes, systems, inventory, documentation, partner capabilities, and escalation paths are aligned before go-live.
  • People & Cross-Functional Leadership
    • Guide, coach, and develop customer service and fulfillment team members as applicable, and influence cross-functional stakeholders, by reinforcing clear ownership, operating rhythms, priorities, and expectations and building a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and disciplined follow-through.
    • Partner with cross-functional teams and external partners to align on execution priorities, resolve constraints, and support fulfillment growth.
    • Translate business growth priorities into practical execution plans, partner requirements, system needs, process controls, and team readiness actions.
    • Provide operational insights, data-backed recommendations, implementation support, and disciplined follow-through to support leadership decisions related to network planning, transportation, contracts, budgets, partner performance, and risk response.

Who You Are

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in fulfillment, distribution planning, customer supply chain, logistics, or 3PL operations, including experience managing complex multi-node distribution networks and customer-facing operational process.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage 3PL partners, operational KPIs, QBRs, corrective actions, SLA follow-up, and fulfillment performance across multiple facilities or business channels.
  • Experience with ERP, WMS, TMS, EDI, API, and order management systems; NetSuite experience strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to identify, design, and implement automation or process improvement opportunities that improve order accuracy, reduce manual work, accelerate cycle times, and strengthen operational visibility.
  • Highly analytical and comfortable using data to make recommendations on allocation, cost-to-serve, service risk, inventory positioning, readiness gaps, and partner performance.
  • Strong understanding of fulfillment and supply chain metrics, including OTIF, fill rate, order cycle time, inventory accuracy, warehouse productivity, cost-per-order or cost-per-case, 3PL SLA performance, chargeback exposure, and capacity utilization.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence Sales, Planning, Finance, Operations, Quality, Digital Transformation, and external partners without always having direct authority.
  • Comfortable operating at both planning and execution levels, moving from operational readiness and issue resolution to SOP development, partner follow-up, and process improvement.
  • Excellent written and verbal communicator with the ability to translate operational complexity into clear recommendations, leadership-ready updates, and partner-facing expectations.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and process-oriented; energized by building scalable systems, improving ways of working, and creating structure in a high-growth environment.
  • Demonstrated p[eople leadership experience, including coaching, prioritization, ownership setting, and development of team members.
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% to distribution centers, partner sites, customer meetings, and cross-functional business reviews.

Position: Senior Manager, Fulfillment

Reports to: Director, Fulfillment & Logistics

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time, exempt

Salary Range Opportunity:

  • The salary range for this role is $130,000 - $140,000 + 20% annual bonus

Compensation Philosophy & Total Comp:

  • Our salary ranges are based on verified market data and our philosophy of paying competitively for our size and industry.
  • Individual pay rate decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.
  • In addition to base salary, full-time team members receive medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401K 6% match, and monthly reimbursements for wellness and home office.

Other Perks:

  • Ability to make an impact: Join a rapidly growing and entrepreneurial-spirited team at a pivotal point to positively impact the food industry.
  • Opportunities to grow: Advance within Chomps quickly based on outstanding performance.
  • Unlimited PTO and 15+ paid holiday days. Hybrid & flexible remote schedule. Chicago office open to those in the area.
  • Paid maternity and paternity leave.
  • Bi-annual total team in-person activities.
  • Company-wide Continual Education budget.
  • Unlimited snacks: Enough meat sticks that if you wanted to eat your body weight in them you could (no judgment here).

Our Commitment

Chomps is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. To achieve our mission of making nutritious food more accessible we greatly benefit from a range of perspectives, which comes from diversity of all types, at all levels of the organization. Achieving true diversity and inclusion is the right thing to do and the smart thing for our business.

We're aware of the research showing that historically underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for a job if they don't believe that they meet all of the criteria. Do you hesitate to submit an application because you believe you need to check every box? Please apply anyway with a thoughtful cover letter! We would love to hear from you to discuss how you can help us build a great team at Chomps.

You must reside in the United States to be considered for this position. Chomps does not provide employment-based visa sponsorship at this time. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Important Notice:

It has come to our attention that fraudsters have been posing as Chomps employees or recruiters and contacting job-seeking candidates regarding potential job opportunities. These fraudulent messages sometimes include a request for payment and confidential personal information. Please note that the Chomps recruiting process does not include asking candidates for payments or other confidential financial information. Band

Level 7

Job Description Summary



We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Executive Director, Data Science & Applied AI to lead the development, operationalization, and scaling of machine learning, predictive modeling, and AI-powered solutions across Novartis US Commercial.

This leader will be responsible for translating complex business challenges into scalable, production-ready AI capabilities that enable intelligent decision-making, personalized customer engagement, and improved business outcomes.

The successful candidate will combine deep expertise in data science, machine learning, and modern AI technologies with strong business acumen, technical leadership, and exceptional people management skills. They will lead high-performing teams, partner across business and technology functions, and accelerate the adoption of reusable, enterprise-grade AI capabilities.

This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel.

Job Description

Data Science & Applied AI Leadership

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of machine learning models, predictive and prescriptive AI solutions, and intelligent decision systems addressing high-value commercial business needs.
  • Establish technical direction, development standards, and best practices for Data Science and Applied AI, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, explainable, and maintainable.
  • Advance the application of machine learning, optimization, generative AI, and agentic AI to enable intelligent business decisions and operational effectiveness.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize decision-making through AI-driven capabilities and innovative modeling approaches.
  • Translate emerging AI technologies into practical solutions that deliver measurable business value.

AI-Powered Commercial Decision Systems

  • Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, Medical, Analytic and Strategy teams to identify and prioritize high-value opportunities for Data Science and Applied AI.
  • Drive the development of predictive and prescriptive models supporting customer engagement, targeting, HCP and patient identification, and next-best-action capabilities.
  • Lead the development of AI-powered decision intelligence solutions that enhance commercial effectiveness and customer experiences.
  • Integrate AI models and decision capabilities into business processes, enterprise applications, and operational workflows to maximize adoption and measurable impact.
  • Establish success measures to evaluate model effectiveness, operational performance, business adoption, and value realization.

AI Innovation, Engineering & Scalability

  • Drive the transition from individual models and use cases to reusable, scalable AI capabilities, components, and intelligent services.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, and Technology teams to enable production-grade AI solutions.
  • Champion modern development and operational practices, including MLOps, model monitoring, automated evaluation, and continuous improvement.
  • Guide the integration of machine learning, generative AI, and agentic workflows into enterprise platforms and business applications.
  • Ensure appropriate governance, responsible AI practices, data privacy, security, and regulatory compliance throughout the AI lifecycle.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Influence

  • Serve as a trusted technical and strategic advisor to business leaders, translating complex Data Science and AI concepts into actionable recommendations.
  • Build strong partnerships across commercial functions, Data & Digital, Insights & Analytics, Strategy, and other enterprise teams.
  • Influence cross-functional priorities, technical decisions, and solution design through evidence-based recommendations and collaborative leadership.
  • Drive alignment across stakeholders on business requirements, AI solution approaches, delivery expectations, and success measures.
  • Communicate progress, opportunities, risks, and business outcomes effectively to senior leadership.

People Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, develop, and inspire high-performing teams of data scientists, machine learning specialists, and applied AI professionals across US and global locations.
  • Build organizational capabilities in predictive modeling, machine learning, AI engineering, generative AI, and emerging technologies.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, technical excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and meaningful career development opportunities.
  • Establish effective operating practices that balance innovation, speed, technical quality, and business impact.
  • Manage resource allocation, delivery priorities, and external partnerships to maximize organizational effectiveness.

Essential Requirements:


  • Advanced degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline. PhD preferred.
  • 12+ years of relevant experience in data science, machine learning, AI development, or related technical disciplines, including significant leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary technical teams and delivering enterprise-scale machine learning and AI solutions.
  • Deep understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning, predictive modeling, optimization, and modern AI methodologies.
  • Strong familiarity with generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and emerging agentic AI architectures.
  • Experience translating business challenges into AI solution strategies and measurable business outcomes.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead initiatives across complex, matrixed organizations.
  • Excellent communication, executive presentation, and organizational leadership skills.

Desirable Requirements:


  • Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or life sciences industry.
  • Strong understanding of US pharmaceutical commercial operations, customer engagement, patient-level modeling, and field effectiveness.

We’re more than a software company. We’re a team of problem-solvers, innovators and collaborators working together to reinvent the category of accounts payable. Our solutions use Artificial Intelligence to eliminate manual work, bring clarity, confidence, and control, and empower finance teams of the future.

At Medius,our values guide how we work and grow together:

  • Connect – We believe in the power of people—individually and collectively—and our success depends on understanding and respecting each other. We appreciate that ‘empowering finance teams of the future’ is an exciting endeavor, and we share it with everyone around us.

  • Question – We enjoy the challenge of our work and the thrill of collaboration. We are not afraid to question ourselves and each other because we believe diverse perspectives can lead to better outcomes and that there is great power in resolution.

  • Own – We are thorough, thoughtful, and decisive. We anticipate what’s next, what a customer might need, and then we deliver. That’s how we get things done. And that’s how we remain a leader. Customers trust us to do our job so that they can focus on what they do best.

At Medius, you’ll join a diverse, global community where curiosity is celebrated, ideas matter, and innovation never stops. If you’re passionate about technology, eager to make an impact, and ready to grow alongside a team that lives its values, Medius is where you can do your best work — your impact is global.

Learn more at

Job Overview

Medius is expanding its AI-native Product Marketing team, and this is a core Senior Product Marketing role focused on driving growth for our Payments solution pillar.

Reporting to the VP, Product Marketing, you will own the go-to-market strategy, positioning, and sales enablement bill of materials for Medius Payments, accelerating both net-new customer acquisition and cross-sell expansion into our existing accounts payable customer base.

As the product marketer for "Medius Payments", you will turn our payment execution, vendor onboarding, and financial security capabilities into compelling narratives that land with CFOs, Controllers, and AP leaders.

  • "Medius Payments" enables finance teams to automate payment execution, eliminate manual processing, enhance fraud protection, and streamline global payment rails, from ACH and wire transfers to automated check processing and virtual card rebates.

  • Product Marketing at Medius:We define how Medius wins in the market. We turn product into narrative that lands with finance and procurement teams. We partner across Product, Sales, and Marketing on positioning, launches, and the go-to-market bill of materials. We measure success by outcomes: win rates, deal velocity, and adoption.

How We Work with AI

  • AI is central to how we work. You will use it to scale your output and sharpen your thinking, not to replace the judgement that makes great product marketing. We want someone who already operates this way or is hungry to.

  • We are AI-native. Claude is our enterprise standard and core to how we operate. We position Medius as a system that manages outcomes, not workflows. AI is not a side experiment here. Claude is our enterprise standard, every employee has an enterprise licence, and we are actively transforming every part of the business to be AI-native.

You will join a company that is genuinely rewiring how it works — not one bolting AI on at the edges.

  • Claude is your daily tool, alongside Microsoft Copilot across the M365 stack.

  • You can structure prompts, iterate quickly, and refine outputs to a high standard.

  • You use AI to accelerate thinking and research, not just to produce content.

  • You help build AI-native ways of working that lift the whole team.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Own positioning, messaging, and end-to-end GTM strategy for the Medius Payments solution pillar.

  • Drive GTM initiatives that accelerate net-new enterprise acquisition and increase cross-sell velocity across our global AP customer base.

  • Translate complex payment automation, secure payment execution, vendor onboarding, and virtual card rebate mechanisms into sharp, outcome-focused buyer value propositions.

  • Build and maintain the sales bill of materials for Payments, including pitch decks, battlecards, ROI calculators, cheat sheets, and competitive plays.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Demand Gen, and Customer Success to equip account executives and account managers with enablement tools to cross-sell payments into existing accounts.

  • Run competitive and market research across the B2B payments, virtual card, and AP automation landscape, using AI to accelerate depth and speed.

  • Develop reusable prompts, workflows, and content systems that scale output across the team.

About You:

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, with direct experience in B2B payments, corporate payment automation, virtual cards, fintech, or AP-adjacent financial tools.

  • Demonstrated success driving product marketing programs focused on both net-new acquisition and cross-selling into an established B2B customer base.

  • Solid domain familiarity with B2B payment rails (ACH, wire transfers, virtual cards, automated check processing) and finance team workflows.

  • Exceptional written English and the ability to simplify complex financial and technical topics into sharp, high-converting narrative.

  • A proven track record of working closely with Sales and Product to drive measurable business outcomes (win rates, pipeline, cross-sell adoption).

  • High curiosity, speed, AI-native operating standard, and an ownership mindset.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • At 6 months: You have refreshed the Payments positioning and launched cross-sell enablement plays that Sales and Account Management actively use in live opportunities.

  • At 12 months: You have driven measurable increases in new business win rates and existing account cross-sell attachment for Medius Payments, while building scalable AI workflows the team relies on.

About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

Role Summary

Role Type: Contractor, part time

Red Cell is seeking experienced Information Systems Security Experts to contribute their specialized knowledge to an IT training and evaluation project focused on streamlining the information security systems accreditation and compliance monitoring processes employed by federal and military network and information assurance programs.

We are particularly interested in highly skilled and experienced U.S. federal and military Information Systems Security Officers (ISSO), Information Systems Security Managers (ISSM) and their equivalents. The ideal candidate will possess deep experience performing those roles in multiple organizations and maintain a detailed practitioner’s knowledge of U.S. federal or military network security frameworks (NIST, RMF), ATO processes, threat analysis, risk management, and compliance requirements, ensuring that security accreditations and risk management protocols are properly integrated throughout the system lifecycle.

Scope of Work

The Information Systems Security Expert will:

  • Evaluate AI-generated content related to intelligence technologies, technical systems security, and national security applications.
  • Review technical scenarios involving information systems accreditation and risk management.
  • Assess the accuracy, rigor, and reliability of technical workflows related to federal and military information assurance processes.
  • Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and unrealistic assumptions in AI-generated technical assessments.
  • Provide structured feedback to improve AI reasoning and understanding of cyber systems risks and security management requirements.
  • Review and refine technical documentation, case studies, and scenario-based materials reflecting real-world information systems security challenges.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Robust professional experience in an Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) or Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) capacity, responsible for the cybersecurity of programs, systems, or enclaves.
  • Ability to produce and evaluate gap analysis on audit results, such as SOC Type 2, HIPAA comparison review and analyze against NIST security controls.
  • Deep working knowledge and experience with Risk Management Framework (RMF), NIST guidelines FISMA, and Security Assessment or their equivalents in one or more federal department/agency or military service.
  • Extensive experience developing security accreditation packages and achieving Authorities to Operate (ATOs), Authority to Connect (ATC) and Interim Authorization to Test (IATT) or their equivalents, ideally within multiple federal or military roles and entities and a range of classified and sensitive but unclassified network systems
  • Strong skill in creating and managing security policies, interpreting legal statutes (e.g., U.S. Code), and ensuring adherence to security requirements related to critical infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of current and emerging threats/threat vectors, including system and application vulnerabilities (e.g., buffer overflow, cross-site scripting, malicious code).
  • Current expertise in areas including Computer Network Defense, Encryption, Operating Systems, Database Administration, and Network Security Architecture concepts (e.g., defense-in-depth).
  • Relevant DoD 8570 / DoD 8140 baseline security certifications such as CISSP or Security+ are required.
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience

Hourly Range: $60-$150 based on experience, skills, and other factors.

  • Opportunities for professional development and continued learning.
  • Optional 401K, FSA, and equity incentives available.
  • Mental health benefits are available through Tara Mind.
  • Cost effective GLP-1 solutions available through Crux.

These providers include applicant tracking systems, candidate verification platforms, and fraud detection tools (collectively, "Hiring Platforms"). About GoCharting

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading platform. Traders use professional orderflow tools — footprint charts, volume and market profile, cumulative delta, DOM trading — to read the market and place orders through their broker, all in the browser. Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world.

The Role

You will be the senior technical owner of GoCharting's web terminal, working hands-on in the code every week. The role is full-time and remote from Europe, reports to the Director of Client Engineering, and works with engineers in India and Europe, with working hours that overlap the Chennai team. This is an immediate need. It is an individual contributor role: you write and review code rather than manage people. At 3 to 6 months, you should own the terminal architecture and code review alongside engineering leadership, and the main charting and real-time features should ship through your reviews.

What you'll do

  • Co-own the terminal codebase — architecture, code review and releases for the web terminal and the charting SDK
  • Set the technical bar — define patterns, review the hardest changes and raise code quality across the team
  • Build the hardest features — take on the most complex terminal and charting work yourself
  • Keep the terminal fast and stable — protect performance under live market data and busy charts
  • Mentor engineers — coach the terminal and mobile engineers through reviews and design sessions
  • Plan with the Director of Client Engineering — turn delivery dates into a technical plan and flag risk early

Must-haves:

  • 8+ years building production web applications in React and TypeScript
  • Has owned the architecture of a large front-end codebase in production
  • Has built real-time or data-dense web UIs, such as charting, trading or live-data screens (any one counts)
  • Writes and reviews production code every week
  • Has mentored or technically led other engineers, with or without formal line management
  • Based in Europe, in a UK or EU time zone, with at least 4 hours of working-day overlap with 09:00–18:00 IST

Nice-to-haves:

  • Canvas, SVG or WebGL rendering for charts (adds depth on the charting engine)
  • A charting SDK or developer-facing library (adds depth on the SDK)
  • Browser performance profiling of long-lived sessions (adds the ability to find slowdowns)

raw.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer (C++) - Hardware Safety
raw.excerpt: Latitude AI () is building the future of Ford’s autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone.
raw.description:
Latitude AI () is building the future of Ford’s autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone. Bringing this vision to scale, our fully in-house developed hands-free ADAS platform will debut on the all-new Ford Fathom in 2027.

When you join the Latitude team, you’ll work alongside leading experts across machine learning and robotics, cloud platforms, mapping, sensors and compute systems, test operations, systems and safety engineering – all dedicated to redefining the relationship between people and their vehicles for millions of customers.

As a Ford Motor Company subsidiary, we operate independently to develop automated driving technology at the speed of a technology startup. Latitude is headquartered in Pittsburgh with engineering centers in Dearborn, Mich., and Palo Alto, Calif.

Meet the team:

The Embedded Software team develops foundational platform software critical to development across the company. The Hardware Safety & Power Systems group specializes in the real-time firmware that orchestrates safe system behavior during fault conditions, power transitions, and thermal events.

We develop FreeRTOS and SafeRTOS-based drivers, state machines, and diagnostic frameworks for power management, thermal monitoring, voltage supervision, and hardware watchdog systems on TDA4 (Jacinto 7) embedded targets. Projects often require deep collaboration with hardware teams (PMIC vendors, SoC architects), safety engineers (ISO 26262 compliance), and system integration teams across the company.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the end-to-end architecture of hardware safety and power management systems: design safe-state strategies, power sequencing across multiple cores and PMICs, thermal throttling, and watchdog orchestration. Your designs must meet ASIL-B/C safety goals
  • Implement low-level drivers and firmware for safety-critical integrated circuits (PMIC, voltage supervisor, thermal monitor) directly from datasheets and the TDA4 Functional Safety Manual. These drivers run on bare metal and FreeRTOS; they must be bug-free and testable
  • Lead the development of hardware-software safety diagnostic frameworks — integrate TI Safety Diagnostic Library (LBIST, PBIST, ECC, DCC, ESM) into the firmware; ensure diagnostic coverage maps to ISO 26262 hardware fault metrics; mentor engineers on coverage traceability
  • Consistently perform deep-dive code reviews across all hardware safety modules. Ensure PRs are simple, bug-free, and adhere to unified architectural vision (clean driver interfaces, consistent error handling, testable design patterns). Root out assumptions that could lead to latent ASIL-rated failures
  • Serve as the SME for hardware-firmware-safety interfaces. Navigate ambiguity in hardware requirements (PMIC sequencing, watchdog timing, thermal limits, voltage thresholds). Mediate disagreements in technical approach through evidence-based influence and clear understanding of safety constraints
  • Mentor engineers on embedded safety patterns — code review discipline, hardware driver architecture, RTOS integration, ISO 26262 traceability, and functional safety reasoning. Build capability across the team

What you'll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field and 4+ years of relevant experience (or Master's degree and 2+ years of relevant experience, or PhD)
  • Experience in embedded C/C++ with deep understanding of advanced language features, design paradigms, and embedded constraints (no exceptions, no RTTI, careful memory management). Proven ability to design clean abstractions and interface-based code for testability
  • Proven expertise in ARM-based SoC architectures, specifically ARM Cortex-R5F: memory-mapped I/O, interrupt controllers (VIM), MPU configuration, cache behavior, and memory barriers. Experience debugging at the register level using datasheets
  • Direct experience configuring MPUs and hardware-level firewalls to enforce spatial and temporal isolation in multi-core, safety-critical environments
  • Experience building or significantly refactoring Hardware Abstraction Layers (HAL) to support multiple hardware targets, RTOS environments, or variant configurations. Understands the role of HAL in isolating driver complexity and enabling testing
  • Ability to root-cause complex system failures — power sequencing hangs, missed watchdog feeds, thermal throttle race conditions, interrupt latency issues — involving shared memory, RTOS task scheduling, and hardware peripherals without supervision
  • Ability to see potential pitfalls in low-level designs (e.g., power rail ordering dependencies, watchdog timeout misconfiguration, voltage threshold hysteresis). Can express designs in sufficient detail (state diagrams, timing requirements, register-level sequences) for rapid, correct implementation
  • Expert-level use of embedded debugging tools (JTAG, on-target debugging, logic analyzers) to verify low-level hardware-software interactions and timing-critical behavior
  • Deep understanding of Real-Time Operating Systems — FreeRTOS and/or SafeRTOS: task lifecycle, inter-task synchronization, interrupt handling, timing constraints, and periodic task patterns. Comfortable reasoning about task preemption, priority inversion, and stack requirements
  • Direct experience developing drivers for safety-critical integrated circuits (PMIC, voltage supervisor, thermal sensor, or equivalent) from datasheet: SPI/I2C protocol implementation, register-level configuration, fault handling, and diagnostic integration
  • Foundational knowledge of ISO 26262 ASIL-B/C functional safety concepts — safe-state strategies, diagnostic coverage, hardware/software fault tolerance allocation, and traceability. Ability to map code behavior to safety requirements without constant guidance

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience with TDA4 / J784S4 (Jacinto 7) or other TI automotive SoCs — familiarity with TI PSDK, SDL (Safety Diagnostic Library), register maps, and peripheral architecture significantly accelerates ramp-up
  • Expertise in Linux-based embedded software development including gtests, Python scripting, Bazel build system, and Docker containerization for embedded CI/CD
  • Prior involvement in ISO 26262 functional safety audits or certification — experience with Jama requirements traceability, FMEA/HARA, and safety case argumentation
  • Experience with hardware diagnostic frameworks — LBIST (Logic BIST), PBIST (Programmable BIST), ECC integration, or other ISO 26262 diagnostic mechanisms
  • Proficiency with advanced embedded debugging tools — Tracealyzer for RTOS visualization, logic analyzers for protocol decoding, or in-circuit emulators
  • Prior automotive or safety-critical domain experience — body control, powertrain, medical devices, industrial control, or aerospace/defense

Description et livrables de la prestation

Contexte :

Au sein d’une équipe technique dédiée, vous contribuez à la modernisation d’une plateforme SaaS de télérelève exploitée en production et traitant une forte volumétrie de données en séries temporelles.
La transformation s’effectue progressivement, avec une coexistence entre les systèmes existants et les nouveaux services pendant la migration des clients. L’enjeu est de faire évoluer la plateforme tout en préservant sa fiabilité et en améliorant ses performances.

Missions :

Avec l’appui du lead technique, vous prenez en charge vos chantiers du cadrage technique jusqu’à la mise en production :

  • Refondre progressivement les mécanismes d’export et de reporting à destination de systèmes tiers.
  • Optimiser les requêtes SQL et les traitements de masse, en mesurant et en documentant les gains obtenus.
  • Mettre en place une couche ORM sur l’existant, en maîtrisant ses impacts sur les performances.
  • Moderniser le code legacy : remise sous tests, suppression du code mort et réduction de la dette technique.
  • Contribuer à la migration progressive des clients vers le socle cible.
  • Conteneuriser les services et les intégrer aux chaînes CI/CD.
  • Mettre en place l’observabilité applicative pour faciliter le suivi et le diagnostic en production.
  • Développer et maintenir les tests unitaires et d’intégration.

Compétences attendues :

1. Indispensables :

  • Maîtrise confirmée de C# et .NET.
  • Solides compétences en SQL, PostgreSQL et utilisation d’ORM.
  • Expérience des traitements batch, des chaînes d’export et du messaging avec RabbitMQ.
  • Expérience d’applications à forte volumétrie, avec une exposition réelle à la production.
  • Expérience d’une modernisation de système legacy sans réécriture globale.
  • Capacité à démontrer des optimisations de requêtes par des mesures avant/après.

2. Compétences complémentaires appréciées :

  • Expérience en conteneurisation, CI/CD et observabilité.
  • Appétence pour approfondir les sujets d’industrialisation et de plateforme.

Livrables attendus :

  • Évolutions et refontes livrées par incréments, accompagnées de tests unitaires et d’intégration.
  • Améliorations de performance documentées et mesurées avant/après.
  • Services conteneurisés, instrumentés et intégrés aux chaînes CI/CD.

Expertise souhaitée

Profil recherché :

Vous savez comprendre un existant avant de le faire évoluer et privilégiez des changements progressifs, testés et maîtrisés. Vous assumez les travaux de maintenance et de nettoyage nécessaires à la pérennité du code.
Votre approche de la performance repose sur la mesure. Vous êtes capable d’expliquer vos choix techniques, de documenter leurs résultats et de prendre en charge vos développements jusqu’à leur mise en production.
Si vous utilisez l’IA générative dans votre travail, vous en gardez une lecture critique et restez responsable de la compréhension, de la validation et de la qualité du code produit.

Mobilité

Non renseigné

title: Senior Regional Sales Director, Startups – AI & Digital Natives (East)
description: About UsAt Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet.

raw.title: Senior Regional Sales Director, Startups – AI & Digital Natives (East)
raw.excerpt: About UsAt Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet.
raw.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: NYC, Boston, Atlanta, Miami OR Carolinas

About the Role

Cloudflare's North America Startups segment is growing its U.S. East go-to-market team. The goal is to win the fastest-growing AI-native and digital native companies early and grow with them as they scale. A new generation of companies is building AI models, agents, AI apps and developer tools, and many of them can go from seed funding to global scale in under two years. Cloudflare wants to be the platform they build, run and secure on from their first line of code through their IPO.

As the Senior Regional Sales Director, Startups – East, you will lead the managers and Account Executives (AEs) covering venture-backed AI and digital native companies across the eastern U.S., including New York, Boston, the DC area, Atlanta and Miami. You'll own revenue, hiring and Cloudflare's reputation in the East Coast startup and venture community, while keeping the Cloudflare culture. This role suits builders who like speed, technical buyers and the challenge of turning fast usage growth into lasting, multi-million-dollar customer relationships.

You'll set strategy for the region and lead a team that sells to founders, CTOs and heads of engineering and infrastructure. Your team will:

  • Move fast deals forward without losing sight of the long-term account
  • Turn companies already on Cloudflare's free and pay-as-you-go plans into committed contracts
  • Work with Product, Developer Speedboat, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success and the Cloudflare for Startups program to make Cloudflare the default choice for AI-native builders

Success means startups that love Cloudflare and recommend it, have grown alongside us from early stage to scale, and run their most important workloads on our Developer Platform, AI products, application security and network.

What You'll Do

  • Drive revenue growth across new customers, expansion and conversion of pay-as-you-go accounts to contracts. Build a sales motion where usage growth opens the door to the next use case.
  • Lead a team of Regional Sales Directors and their Startup Account Executives. Also lead indirectly, the Solutions Engineers, Business Development Reps, Customer Success and Field Marketing teams who support startup accounts.
  • Build the East Coast startup sales team. Work with your Ecosystem and Recruiting to hire people who are technical, sharp about the business and comfortable talking with founders and engineers.
  • Spot breakout companies early. Use funding rounds, usage data, hiring and developer adoption signals to find likely winners, then win them before they lock into AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel or other platforms.
  • Make venture investors a growth channel. Build relationships with VC firms, accelerators and startup programs across the East Coast, working with the Cloudflare for Startups and Workers Launchpad teams to bring in companies at the earliest stages.
  • Help shape the product roadmap. Bring what AI-native customers need back to Product and Engineering, and run design-partner relationships with leading startups that influence what Cloudflare builds next.
  • Adapt our sales process for startups. Use and influence Cloudflare's sales methodology for faster deals with technical buyers. Bring discipline to forecasting usage-based revenue, contracts sized for growth and expansion planning.
  • Balance short-term and long-term revenue. Close fast deals while also building multi-year relationships with companies expected to become tomorrow's large enterprise customers. Work with Enterprise leaders on clean handoffs when accounts move to that segment.
  • Represent Cloudflare in the East Coast startup scene at founder events, AI meetups, investor portfolio sessions and developer communities.

What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years of sales experience, including 3+ years managing managers (second-line leadership), with a track record of beating targets in a high-growth segment
  • Experience selling cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, application security or data and AI infrastructure to startups, digital natives or high-growth tech companies
  • Proven success in usage-based businesses, including converting product-led or pay-as-you-go customers to committed contracts and expanding from there
  • Credibility with technical buyers: comfortable at the whiteboard with CTOs and founders talking about how their AI systems are built, latency, how they scale and what it costs per request or token
  • Strong ties to the East Coast venture and startup community
  • A history of hiring and developing great AE managers and AEs, and building a team people want to join
  • Disciplined forecasting and pipeline management in fast-moving, high-volume deal environments
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the drive to build processes, programs and playbooks where none exist

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

  • For New York City and Boston based hires: Estimated annual salary of $418,000 - $575,000 OTE

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

  • Medical/Rx Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Commuter Spending Accounts
  • Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
  • On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
  • Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

  • Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

  • Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
  • Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

: We released to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actualrace, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

Job Title

Account Manager Ultraschall (m/w/d) in der deutschsprachigen Schweiz

Job Description

In dieser Position hast du die Möglichkeit:

  • Klinisches und technisches Expertenwissen in einem definierten Bereich sowie zu den dazugehörigen Produkten, Softwarelösungen und Services aufzubauen und dieses Wissen in unterschiedlichen Kundensituationen gezielt einzusetzen.
  • Einen definierten Kundenstamm gemeinsam mit dem Vertriebsteam strategisch weiterzuentwickeln und bereichsbezogene Projekte bei Bestandskunden eigenständig zu steuern.
  • Mit deinem Markt- und Kundenwissen aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Produkt- und Lösungsangebots beizutragen.

Für folgende Themen übernimmst du Verantwortung:

  • Das Health Systems Portfolio im Bereich Ultraschallsysteme, einschließlich Equipment und Produkten, Software, Customer Service sowie weiterer Services und Lösungen.
  • Den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen in enger Abstimmung mit relevanten Rollen und Funktionen und im Einklang mit der gemeinsam entwickelten Vertriebsstrategie.
  • Die proaktive Identifizierung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und deren Qualifizierung gemeinsam mit dem Key Account Manager und District Leader.
  • Die vollständige und korrekte Abbildung des Sales Funnels in unserem Customer-Relationship-Management-System (SFDC).
  • Die Erstellung kundenorientierter Angebote, einschließlich Konfiguration und Preisgestaltung, in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Customer Service Specialist und bei Bedarf weiteren Expertinnen und Experten.
  • Die Präsentation von Angeboten sowie die gemeinsame Führung von Kundenverhandlungen im Team.
  • Die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kundenbeziehungen mit dem Ziel, langfristige Partnerschaften und Rahmenvereinbarungen aufzubauen.
  • Die Organisation und Koordination von Produktdemonstrationen und Referenzbesuchen.
  • Die kontinuierliche Beobachtung des Wettbewerbs und relevanter Branchenentwicklungen sowie die Weitergabe von Markt- und Kundenfeedback an die Business Unit.

Darüber hinaus bist du in deinem Verantwortungsbereich zuständig für:

  • Order Intake (Auftragseingang) und Sales (Umsatz) für Equipment, Produkte, Software und Customer Service.
  • Order Intake und Sales für Lösungen.
  • Datenqualität in SFDC und Forecast Accuracy.
  • Kundenzufriedenheit (NPS), einschließlich Rücklaufquote und Ergebnis.
  • Share of Wallet (SoW).
  • Preisrealisierung für Equipment, Produkte und Customer Service.

Dafür bieten wir dir:

  • Eine attraktive Vergütung.
  • Einen Firmenwagen mit der Möglichkeit zur privaten Nutzung.
  • Purpose: Sinnvolle Arbeit, mit der wir gemeinsam als Team das Leben von Menschen verbessern.
  • Philips University: Ein breites Angebot an fachlichen Trainings sowie Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung.
  • Philips MyShop: Vergünstigte Philips Produkte.
  • Philips in Balance: Vielfältige Angebote rund um körperliche und mentale Gesundheit sowie Sportkurse.

Wer Verantwortung übernimmt, sollte fair und transparent vergütet werden. Das jährliche Grundentgelt für diese Position liegt bei vollständiger Erfüllung des Anforderungsprofils zwischen 80,000 CHF - 125,000 CHF ein Einstieg in ein niedrigeres Gehaltsband ist möglich, wenn noch nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllt sind. Die konkrete Höhe deines Gehalts innerhalb dieser Spanne legen wir anhand objektiver Faktoren fest, wie beispielsweise der für die Position erforderlichen Fähigkeiten, deiner einschlägigen Erfahrung sowie der Verantwortung, die Du in dieser Rolle übernehmen wirst. Dabei berücksichtigen wir außerdem die interne Gleichbehandlung und die lokalen Marktbedingungen.

Für diese Position besteht Anspruch auf eine variable Vergütung in Form eines Sales Incentive, dessen Höhe an das Erreichen festgelegter KPIs gekoppelt ist. Das gesamte Vergütungskonzept erläutern wir Dir gerne im Rahmen des Bewerbungsprozesses, damit Du eine klare und fundierte Entscheidung treffen kannst.


Warum du zu Philips kommen solltest

Arbeiten bei Philips ist mehr als nur ein Job. Wir fühlen uns berufen, durch sinnvolle Arbeit eine gesündere Gesellschaft zu schaffen, indem wir uns auf innovative, kundenorientierte Lösungen der Gesundheitstechnologie fokussieren. Hilf uns, die Gesundheit und das Wohlbefinden von Milliarden von Menschen zu verbessern.


Wir bei Philips fördern Chancengleichheit. Alle qualifizierten Kandidat:innen werden unabhängig von Hautfarbe, Religion, Alter, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, nationaler Herkunft, Glaube, Staatsbürgerschaft, Behinderung oder Familienstand gleichermaßen in unserem Auswahlprozess berücksichtigt.


Auf unserer Karriereseite erfährst du wie es ist bei Philips zu arbeiten. Lies die Geschichten in unserem Mitarbeiterblog und finde Informationen über unsere Einstellungsverfahren und Antworten auf einige häufig gestellte Fragen.

raw.title: Head of Sales
raw.excerpt: About Us Martin is a leading, tech-enabled insurance advisory firm celebrating over 30 years of excellence.
raw.description:
About Us

Martin is a leading, tech-enabled insurance advisory firm celebrating over 30 years of excellence. We partner with national, regional, and local insurance carriers and Managing General Agents (MGAs) across the U.S. to solve their most critical challenges. Our expertise spans Product Development, Actuarial Services, Regulatory Compliance, State Filings, and Data Analytics. Our mission is simple: build lasting partnerships and deliver technology-driven outcomes that fuel business success.

We recently acquired Adaptify, bringing its engineering team in-house and accelerating our platform roadmap. We are now a fully remote team backed by private equity, with consulting expertise and technology under one roof.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Head of Sales to lead our sales team day to day and build the sales engine for Martin’s next stage of growth. In this newly created role, you will own team performance, pipeline, forecasting, and sales process. That frees our Chief Revenue Officer to focus on revenue strategy, strategic relationships and new markets.

With our recent acquisition of Adaptify, we have a bigger story to tell and a broader offering to sell. This role will shape how we take that combined offering to market.

Selling at Martin is consultative. Our clients increasingly buy expertise and software together, and our deals range from productized platform sales to complex, custom engagements. You will lead a team that sells both well, working alongside Sales Engineers and our Professional Services Group so that what we sell is what we deliver.

This is a builder's role. We are looking for a leader who coaches as well as they close, who brings structure without slowing the team down, and who is energized by taking a capable sales team to the next level.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop the sales team

  • Manage, coach and develop the sales team through regular one-on-ones, deal coaching and call reviews
  • Set clear expectations for activity, pipeline and results, and hold the team accountable to them
  • Hire, onboard and ramp new sellers as the team grows
  • Build the team's fluency in selling services and software together

Own pipeline, forecast and results

  • Own team quota attainment across new business and expansion
  • Run a disciplined pipeline and forecast cadence, and report results to the CRO and executive team
  • Stay close to the deals that matter: join key client conversations, shape strategy and help the team close
  • Use CRM data to spot what is working, what is stalling and where to focus

Build the sales engine

  • Define and document a repeatable sales process, from qualification through close, for both productized and custom deals
  • Establish the playbooks, messaging and tools the team needs to sell consistently
  • Partner with the CRO on territory and account planning, pricing approach and compensation design
  • Work with Marketing on pipeline generation and with Product on market feedback
  • Lead the team's shift to selling the combined services and technology offering, including positioning, messaging and cross-sell into existing clients

Partner across the business

  • Work with Sales Engineers on discovery, demonstrations and solution design
  • Bring the Professional Services Group into deals early so scope, pricing and timelines are right before signature
  • Represent Sales in deal review alongside Operations, Finance and Product
  • Stay engaged through the transition from sale to delivery, so clients experience one team
  • Coordinate with Account Management on renewals and growth within existing clients

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of B2B sales experience, including 3+ years leading and developing a sales team
  • A record of meeting or beating team targets in a consultative, multi-stakeholder sale
  • Experience selling professional services, software, or ideally both together
  • Insurance, insurtech or financial services experience strongly preferred; curiosity and the ability to learn a technical domain quickly are required
  • Experience building sales process and forecasting discipline in a growth-stage company, ideally PE- or VC-backed
  • A coaching mindset, with examples of sellers you have developed and promoted
  • Comfort working in the details: CRM data, deal strategy and live client conversations
  • The ability to build trust across Sales, Delivery, Product and Finance in a fully remote company

Why Join Us?

  • Real scope at the right moment. You will shape how Martin sells as we scale, with direct access to the CRO and executive team.
  • Expertise that scales. Our value comes from deep insurance expertise, delivered through people and a platform. You will sell something clients need and that few firms can offer.
  • Own the outcomes. We give leaders room to build and expect them to deliver. You will have the mandate to make the changes the team needs.
  • Do the right thing. We sell what we can deliver and stand behind it. Long-term client trust matters more to us than a quick close.
  • A remote team that stays connected. We are fully remote by design and invest in bringing people together.
  • Momentum you can sell. A recent acquisition, an expanded engineering team and private equity backing give us the product, the resources and the ambition to grow.

Salary and Benefits

  • Base salary: $185,000 – $210,000, based on experience.
  • Variable compensation: On-target earnings (OTE) of $290,000 – $330,000, with an approximately 65/35 base-to-variable mix. Variable pay is tied to team performance.
  • Benefits: Our salaries are complemented by an extensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance, including:

-Health, dental, and vision insurance

-401(k) retirement plan options

-Generous, flexible paid time off (PTO) policy

-Fully remote work environment

Job brief

Join Elite Escapes and turn your passion for travel into your next career.

As a Remote Group Travel Planner (Sales-Focused), you'll help groups turn we should all go somewhere together into a confirmed trip that everyone is excited about. You'll combine destination knowledge, group logistics, and a consultative sales approach to match teams, companies, families, and friend groups with the right destination, accommodations, activities, and travel experience—whether it's a sports team tournament, corporate retreat, incentive trip, family reunion, milestone celebration, or friends' getaway.

What You'll Do

  • Connect with group leaders to understand trip goals, group size, budget, preferred dates, destination ideas, and must-have experiences.
  • Recommend destinations, hotels or resorts, room blocks, transportation options, meeting spaces, team-building activities, and group excursions that fit the group's purpose and budget.
  • Turn group inquiries into confirmed trips through email, chat, and phone with energy, accuracy, and a client-first approach.
  • Explain group travel details clearly, including deposit structures, payment schedules, cancellation policies, rooming lists, name changes, and travel requirements.
  • Coordinate group logistics: room allocations, special requests, group rates, contracts, deposits, final payments, and pre-trip communication.
  • Handle changes, questions, and concerns quickly and professionally so group leaders and participants feel supported from first quote through return home.
  • Share valuable insights on destinations, group-friendly resorts, team activities, corporate meeting facilities, family experiences, and seasonal opportunities.
  • Build post-booking relationships that encourage repeat group trips, referrals, testimonials, and long-term partnerships.

Nice to Have

  • Interest in group travel, sports travel, corporate meetings and incentives, family reunions, or destination celebrations.
  • Travel-industry, sales, hospitality, event planning, customer-service, or booking experience is preferred—but not required. Zero experience is welcome.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to guide group leaders toward decisions.
  • Strong organization skills and comfort managing multiple group quotes, rooming lists, contracts, follow-ups, and client details.
  • Comfort with technology, online booking platforms, CRM systems, and AI tools—we will train you on the rest.
  • A genuine passion for bringing people together through travel and creating memorable shared experiences.

What You Get

  • Fully remote work with the flexibility to build your schedule around your life.
  • Comprehensive onboarding and training on group travel, supplier platforms, negotiation and sales conversations, and travel planning.
  • A collaborative, supportive team atmosphere with colleagues who want to see you succeed.
  • The opportunity to grow into specialties such as sports team travel, corporate meetings and incentives, family reunions, milestone celebrations, or luxury group getaways.
  • Clear paths toward leadership and higher earning potential.

Group travel has many moving parts—but if you enjoy coordinating room blocks, planning team activities, designing corporate retreats, and bringing families and friends together in amazing destinations, you will thrive here. Your work will transform group ideas into confirmed itineraries and shared travel memories that last long after the trip ends.

Apply today—we look forward to welcoming you to the team.
