raw.description:
Team Lead – CYP ADHD Titration Service

United Kingdom (Remote)

Ref: CYP001

Reporting to: Clinical Operations Manager – Children and Young Person Service

Remuneration: £74,000 FTE- plus £1000 working from home allowance

Contract Type:Permanent/Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Location:Home-based/various UK meeting locations as required

Closing Date for applications: Monday 30th November 2026*

Please note: While internal applications may be considered, no formal offer of employment will be made until the successful completion of any current probation period.

About Us:

Psychiatry UK is the UK’s leading provider of digital psychiatry services, working both privately and with the NHS to support children, teenagers and adults with expert, patient-centred care.

A career with Psychiatry UK allows you to expand your knowledge, enhance your skills, and gain valuable life experience—all while enjoying the flexibility of a remote full-time role. As part of a leading online mental health service, you'll collaborate with innovative, forward-thinking professionals in a dynamic, multidisciplinary team committed to making a real difference.

The Team Lead – CYP ADHD Titration Service plays a crucial role within Psychiatry UK, reporting directly to the Clinical Operations Director. This position is responsible for providing clinical leadership and operational oversight of the Children and Young People (CYP) ADHD Titration Service, ensuring the delivery of safe, effective and high-quality clinical care.

The service supports children and young people through the initiation, titration and stabilisation of ADHD medication, ensuring treatment is tailored to individual clinical needs, developmental considerations and relevant prescribing guidance. The Team Lead will oversee clinical practice, support prescribing clinicians and ensure appropriate engagement with children, young people, parents and carers throughout the treatment pathway.

The post holder will contribute to service development, operational excellence and clinical governance, allocating their time across team leadership, pathway ownership, clinical supervision and operational management to drive continuous improvement and maintain high standards of patient care.

This role is predominantly remote (applicants must reside in the UK) but requires attendance at various meeting locations within the UK as needed and operates in accordance with Psychiatry UK's flexitime principles.

As our Team Lead – CYP ADHD Titration Service, you will:

  • Lead and maintain clinical safety, prescribing governance and quality standards within the CYP ADHD Titration Service.

  • Develop, implement and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and clinical protocols to ensure evidence-based, safe and effective ADHD medication management.

  • Ensure clinical practices align with relevant NICE guidance, professional prescribing standards and regulatory requirements relating to ADHD treatment in children and young people.

  • Oversee appropriate monitoring of medication effectiveness, adverse effects, physical health parameters and clinical risk throughout the titration pathway.

  • Contribute to clinical governance, quality assurance, prescribing audits and service improvement activities, identifying and addressing areas of clinical risk.

  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement through the review of clinical incidents, patient feedback and treatment outcomes.

Clinical Leadership

  • Provide clinical supervision, guidance and professional support to prescribing clinicians within the CYP ADHD Titration Service, promoting best practice and professional development.

  • Support clinicians in the safe initiation, adjustment, monitoring and stabilisation of ADHD medication, ensuring treatment decisions are evidence-based and appropriate to the child's or young person's individual needs.

  • Provide clinical guidance on complex presentations, including co-occurring mental health conditions, neurodevelopmental needs, medication tolerability and safeguarding concerns.

  • Promote developmentally appropriate, patient-centred and family-inclusive approaches to treatment, supporting informed decision-making and effective engagement throughout the titration process.

  • Review applications and participate in interviewing and recruitment processes for new team members, working collaboratively with Talent Acquisition.

  • Maintain own Continuing Professional Development (CPD) and support compliance with relevant professional registration, prescribing competency and development requirements across the team.

Team Management

  • Manage the performance, workload and wellbeing of clinical staff within the CYP ADHD Titration Service.

  • Facilitate regular multidisciplinary team (MDT) meetings, clinical case discussions and reflective practice to promote effective clinical decision-making and team cohesion.

  • Provide coaching, mentoring and regular clinical supervision to build a resilient, motivated and skilled workforce.

  • Support clinicians in managing complex prescribing decisions, maintaining professional standards and practising within their individual scope of competence.

  • Identify training and development needs, ensuring clinicians are appropriately supported to deliver safe and effective ADHD treatment to children and young people.

  • Work collaboratively with operational and workforce colleagues to identify recruitment, capacity and resource requirements.

Operational Oversight

  • Oversee day-to-day operations of the CYP ADHD Titration Service, ensuring efficient patient flow, appropriate clinical allocation and effective resource management.

  • Monitor pathway performance, clinical capacity, prescribing activity and patient progression through medication initiation, titration and stabilisation.

  • Support timely clinical reviews, medication adjustments and follow-up arrangements, ensuring treatment is delivered in accordance with agreed clinical protocols.

  • Oversee appropriate arrangements for patients completing titration, including clinical handover and transfer to ongoing prescribing or shared care where clinically appropriate and agreed.

  • Collaborate with internal teams and external partners, including NHS services, GPs and other healthcare professionals, to support continuity of care.

  • Escalate clinical risks, prescribing concerns and safeguarding issues in accordance with Psychiatry UK policies and relevant statutory requirements.

  • Contribute to workforce planning and service development initiatives to support the safe and sustainable delivery of the CYP ADHD Titration Service.

Safeguarding and Patient-Centred Care

  • Promote a strong safeguarding culture, ensuring the safety, welfare and best interests of children and young people remain central to clinical decision-making.

  • Ensure clinicians understand and fulfil their safeguarding responsibilities, including recognising, documenting and escalating concerns appropriately.

  • Support effective communication with children, young people, parents and carers, ensuring medication information, treatment expectations and potential adverse effects are explained clearly and in a developmentally appropriate manner.

  • Promote good practice in relation to consent, Gillick competence, parental responsibility, confidentiality and information sharing, recognising the legal and ethical considerations associated with prescribing for children and young people.

  • Support clinicians in identifying and responding appropriately to concerns relating to medication adherence, treatment response, physical health, mental health and wider vulnerabilities.

  • Ensure the views and experiences of children and young people are considered throughout treatment, promoting their involvement in decisions about their care.

Engagement and Collaboration

  • Foster effective working relationships within Psychiatry UK, the NHS, primary care and other healthcare providers to support integrated and coordinated patient care.

  • Collaborate with clinical and operational leadership to identify opportunities for pathway improvement, service development and improved patient outcomes.

  • Communicate regularly with the Clinical Operations Director regarding service performance, clinical risks, workforce challenges and improvement initiatives.

  • Support effective communication and collaboration between prescribing clinicians, patients, families and external healthcare professionals throughout the titration pathway.

  • Promote Psychiatry UK's values, mission and vision through effective leadership and professional conduct.

Administration and Documentation

  • Ensure accurate, comprehensive and timely recording of clinical assessments, prescribing decisions, medication adjustments, monitoring outcomes and patient communications within electronic patient records.

  • Maintain oversight of clinical documentation standards, ensuring compliance with prescribing governance, information governance and data protection requirements.

  • Participate actively in clinical supervision and Psychiatry UK's Personal Development Review (PDR) process.

  • Attend relevant mandatory and professional development training.

raw.excerpt: Client Success Specialist (Legal Tech) Join Codekeeper and play a crucial role in managing customer success for our clients.
raw.description:
Client Success Specialist (Legal Tech)
Join Codekeeper and play a crucial role in managing customer success for our clients. As a LegalTech company, our focus is on the intersection of customer communications, technical support, and legal drafting / review. We're looking for a talented Client Success Specialist to excel in this dynamic and multifaceted position.

We're accepting applications for the next two months and will fill the position as soon as we've found the perfect match.


Role Description

As a Client Success Specialist within the Customer Success team, this role is crucial in ensuring customers attain their desired outcomes using our product or service. This responsibility is pivotal for enhancing customer satisfaction and retention. You will act as an essential bridge between our company and its customers, championing customer success and satisfaction. Additionally, the duties shall include conducting legal research, drafting legal documents, and offering support on legal matters, contributing significantly to our overall service quality.


Key Responsibilities

Customer Service

  • You’ll be receiving requests from users and leads, asking questions about the services we offer and how to manage their Codekeeper account

  • Since we operate a full service model, you’ll be making sure their requests are handled quickly and correctly

Tech Setup Support

  • Customers will also be required to set up connections between their source code management platform

  • You will support them in this process and make sure everything is administered correctly on our side

Sales Support

  • Since in our view customer success starts from the very first contact, you’ll also be working with leads who have questions, guiding them about our service

  • This is done via email and website chat

Report Drafting

  • Some of our customers require us to inspect information they provide

  • You draft the reports and send them back to them

Legal Drafting/Review

  • As part of our service customers require written agreements incorporating their requirements. You’ll be managing this process by drafting the legal language to fit those requirements

  • You’ll be preparing the required documents, which will then be checked by your manager before it is shared with the client



About the Company

Codekeeper was founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art software escrow solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our app.


What We Offer

  • Passionate and fun-loving colleagues

  • Startup mindset with ample opportunities for growth

  • Regular team activities and gatherings

  • Comprehensive onboarding process with a dedicated ramp-up period

  • A supportive team that values open communication and direct feedback

  • A chance to excel in your career and make a difference


What We Are Looking For

We are seeking a motivated individual ready to embrace this challenge. While extensive legal or technical experience is not expected, familiarity with LegalTech concepts is crucial for success in this role.

  • Prior experience in customer success or similar role is preferred

  • Proficiency in drafting legal documents

  • Exposure to working with diverse companies of varying sizes and industries


Additional Requirements

  • Analytical thinking, and a proactive attitude

  • Excellent written English communication skills

  • Proficiency in modern web tools like Google Docs and similar platforms

  • Highly organized with a strong attention to detail

  • Comfortable adapting and multitasking in a fast-paced environment


Additional Info

  • Job Location: Remote

  • Join us to shape the future of software escrow!


How to Apply

To apply, use the Apply button on this listing. In your application, tell us how you would like to fill this position. There are no right answers or expectations. Show us your role in our company’s future and our role in yours, address some of the work we do, and introduce yourself as a colleague.

Please note: Applications and follow-ups sent through any other channel, such as our customer website chat, support email or direct messages to team members, won’t be considered. Need an accessibility adjustment to apply? Visit Our Careers Page for how to reach us.

raw.description:
日本市場におけるSwiftMRの事業拡大を統括する責任者の募集です。

■AIRS Medicalについて

AIRS Medicalは、ソウル大学の医学・工学のエキスパートたちによって設立されたグローバルスタートアップです。 私たちは「MRI × AI」という非常に難易度の高い領域に対し、世界で最も優れた解決策を提示できる集団であることを自負しています。 その技術力は、Facebook（現Meta社）とニューヨーク大学が共催した「fastMRI Challenge」での連続優勝といった実績に裏打ちされています。

私たちの使命は、放射線医学の領域を革新し続けることで、「予防医療」へのアクセシビリティを劇的に高めることです。 MRI検査をより身近なものへと進化させ、病気の早期発見と予防が中心となる新しい医療モデルを世界中で実現していきます。

■主力製品：SwiftMR

当社の主力製品である「SwiftMR」は、AIディープラーニングモデルを用いたベンダーニュートラルのMRI画像再構成ソリューションです。

  • 課題の解決: 従来のMRI検査の課題であった「長い検査時間」と「高コスト」を解消し、より効率的で費用対効果の高い検査を実現します。
  • 提供価値: MRIをより身近な診断ツールへと進化させ、医療従事者が潜在的な健康リスクを早期に発見できるようサポートします。

■グローバルな実績と評価

私たちの技術力は世界的に認められており、急速な成長を遂げています。

  • 導入実績: 世界40カ国以上、1,400以上の医療機関で導入されています。
  • 受賞歴:
    • 2023年 Frost & Sullivanにて「Technology Innovation Leadership Award」受賞
    • 2019年・2020年 fastMRI Challenge（Facebook AI ResearchおよびNYU Langone Health主催）にて連続優勝
  • グローバル展開: 韓国を拠点に、米国、欧州、日本に法人を設立し、グローバル市場で事業を拡大しています。

Requirements

🚩Roles & Responsibilities

日本市場におけるSwiftMRの事業開発責任者として、大手企業との販売提携、新たな流通チャネルの開拓、医療データやエコシステムを活用した新規事業モデルの構築など、非連続な成長を生み出す事業開発をリードしていただきます。売上目標の達成に責任を持ち、日本法人代表の直属として、本社経営陣とも連携しながら日本事業の成長を牽引するポジションです。

1. 事業戦略・市場開拓

  • 日本市場の中長期事業計画・売上目標の策定と実行
  • 市場動向、競合、診療報酬などの制度動向を分析し、戦略に反映
  • 大学病院・基幹病院・画像診断センターなど重点顧客層の特定と開拓方針の策定

2. 戦略的パートナーシップの構築

  • MRIメーカー、PACSベンダー、医療機器商社・代理店との提携の開拓と交渉
  • 提携条件、価格、契約の交渉を主導し、収益性を最大化
  • 既存パートナーとの短・中・長期の目標を揃え、関係を深化

3. 営業推進・キーアカウント管理

  • パートナーとの共同営業を統括し、大型案件の商談やクロージングに参画
  • 放射線科医や病院経営層など、KOL・意思決定者との関係構築
  • リファレンスサイトの開拓と導入事例の創出

4. 組織の構築・マネジメント

  • 事業開発観点から営業チームの採用、育成、目標管理へ関与し、営業マネージャーに伴走
  • パートナー向けのトレーニング・オンボーディング体制の整備

5. 社内・グローバル連携

  • マーケティング、カスタマーサクセス、他の関連部門と連携したGo-to-Marketの推進
  • 韓国本社経営陣への業績報告と、日本市場のニーズの製品へのフィードバック

🎯Qualifications

  • 医療機器、ヘルスケアIT、またはB2B SaaS業界での事業開発・アライアンス・チャネル営業の経験（目安10年以上）
  • 営業・事業開発チームのマネジメント経験（目安10年以上）
  • 売上目標に対する責任を持ち、事業計画の策定から達成までを主導した実績
  • 代理店・販売パートナーとの契約交渉や提携構築の実績
  • 日本語（ネイティブレベル）、英語（英語環境で業務遂行へ抵抗のない方コミュニケーションレベル。デジタルツールの翻訳機能をフル活用することが可能な方）
  • 経営層向けのプレゼンテーション力と交渉力
  • 国内出張および海外出張（韓国本社など）に抵抗がないこと

🏅Preferred Experiences

  • 放射線・画像診断機器（MRI、CT、PACSなど）または医療AIソフトウェアの事業経験
  • 大学病院・基幹病院・画像診断センター、放射線科KOLとのネットワーク
  • 外資系企業での日本市場立ち上げ・事業拡大の経験
  • 薬機法、診療報酬、医療機関の購買プロセスに関する知見
  • スタートアップ・急成長企業での勤務経験、またはその環境を楽しめること
  • SalesforceなどCRMを活用したパイプライン管理・営業予測の経験
  • AIツールをフル活用し、効率的に業務を推進できること

Benefits

就業場所

フルリモート（ 当面転勤なし、顧客・パートナー訪問のための出張あり）

賃金

  • 想定年収：800万円～1500万円（賃金形態：年俸制）

    • 固定残業代：￥126,582～￥237,342を含む/月

※超過した時間外労働の残業時間代は追加支給

raw.description:
Put Your Billing Expertise to Work From Home

Partners In Home Care is looking for an experienced pharmacy billing professional to own the back end of the revenue cycle for our Solutions and Pharmacy services. If you take pride in clean claims, enjoy tracking down a tricky denial, and want a full-time remote role where your expertise is valued, we’d love to meet you.

This is an individual-contributor role focused on post-service billing in WellSky CareTend. Our Intake team handles referrals, benefit verification, and prior authorizations, so you can focus on what you do best: getting claims paid accurately and on time.

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote – United States

Duties and Responsibilities

Charge Capture & Claims

  • Review dispensing, delivery, nursing, therapy, and clinical documentation to capture all billable drugs, supplies, services, equipment, and per diems
  • Reconcile charges against orders, delivery records, fee schedules, payer requirements, and dates of service
  • Prepare and submit medical and pharmacy claims to Medicare, Medicaid, commercial plans, workers’ compensation, and other payers
  • Validate coding, modifiers, units, authorizations, and payer sequencing before submission
  • Work claim queues, clearinghouses, and payer portals to resolve edits and rejections within filing deadlines
  • Process corrected, replacement, voided, secondary, and tertiary claims

A/R, Denials & Appeals

  • Drive unpaid, underpaid, denied, suspended, and aging claims to resolution
  • Analyze EOBs, remittance advice, denial codes, and payment variances
  • Prepare and submit appeals and reconsiderations
  • Research underpayments, refunds, recoupments, and contract discrepancies
  • Escalate filing-limit risks and complex reimbursement barriers when needed

Process Improvement

  • Spot denial trends and recommend fixes that prevent future issues
  • Help build billing guides, reporting tools, clean-claim standards, and denial-prevention resources
  • Support audits, reporting, and revenue cycle initiatives
  • Keep billing records, payer information, and documentation audit-ready in CareTend

Collaboration

  • Partner with Intake, Pharmacy, Nursing, Clinical, Delivery, Finance, and Revenue Cycle teams to resolve billing issues
  • Communicate clearly with patients, caregivers, payers, and referral sources about claim status and documentation needs

Compliance

  • Follow HIPAA, Medicare, Medicaid, CMS, OIG, and payer regulations
  • Maintain a secure, HIPAA-compliant home workspace
  • Meet productivity, quality, and accuracy expectations

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED
  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare billing, pharmacy billing, reimbursement, revenue cycle, or accounts receivable
  • Experience billing Medicare Part B, Part D, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and commercial plans
  • Strong grasp of claim submission, denial resolution, payer follow-up, and timely filing
  • Working knowledge of HCPCS, CPT, ICD-10, NDC coding, and modifiers
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, billing systems, payer portals, clearinghouses, and remote collaboration tools
  • Sharp attention to detail and strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

Nice to Have

  • 2+ years billing home infusion, specialty pharmacy, DME, respiratory, or other complex therapies
  • Experience billing IVIG, TPN, enteral nutrition, specialty medications, or biologics
  • WellSky CareTend billing and A/R experience
  • Experience with Waystar, Availity, Brightree, CPR+, EDI, or ERA systems
  • Certification such as CPB, CPC, CCS, CRCR, CPhT, ExCPT, or equivalent
  • Associate degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Finance, Medical Billing & Coding, Pharmacy Technology, or a related field
  • Knowledge of ACHC, URAC, CMS, or OIG accreditation and compliance requirements

What We Offer

  • Full-time remote work
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Supplemental Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Generous paid time off
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • Tuition reimbursement and an annual training budget
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Legal services, ID protection, pet insurance, and financial wellness programs

Ready to bring your billing expertise to a mission-driven team? Apply today!

Partners In Home Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Faculty are responsible for facilitating student learning by teaching courses and programs in accordance with DeVry University requirements. Faculty develop course syllabi and lesson plans and apply teaching techniques to best achieve course and programmatic objectives. All DeVry instructors will participate in a comprehensive faculty training program and ongoing faculty development activities to ensure the highest quality instruction. DeVry University does not guarantee any specific number of work hours or assignments, which may vary based on the University’s needs and discretion. As you explore this opportunity, we invite you to view this brief video highlighting how our faculty engage in meaningful student support.

Responsibilities:

Develops and provides students with an approved DeVry University syllabus that follows a template established by the local campus, and which includes the terminal course objectives. Organizes, prepares, and regularly revises and updates all course materials. Uses appropriate technological options for online technologies and course-related software, including Websites, e-mail, and online discussions for preparing the course and making it accessible to students. Models effective oral and written communications that engage the students, provide clarity, and improve student learning. Sets clear expectations for the course by publishing course terminal objectives, assignment/examinations dates, and weight the distribution of various evaluation categories. Ensures that the content and level of material included on exams correspond to the course terminal objectives. Demonstrates consistency and fairness in the preparation and grading of exams and provides timely feedback to students. Embraces and integrates the responsible use of AI technologies in the classroom to enhance teaching and learning outcomes. Demonstrates the ability to recognize, evaluate, and address appropriate and inappropriate student use of AI tools in academic work. Completes other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

A doctorate in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a closely related field is required, with at least 18 graduate credit hours in cybersecurity, information assurance, network security, digital forensics, or related computing disciplines.

Applicants must upload unofficial graduate-level transcripts with their application. Degrees must be awarded by an institution accredited by an agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education or the Council for Higher Education Accreditation, or by an international institution determined to hold equivalent accreditation.

Three to five years of applied professional experience in cybersecurity, information security, security operations, threat analysis, or digital risk management. Demonstrated experience with cybersecurity technologies and practices, including network security, system hardening, vulnerability management, incident response, and security monitoring. Industry-recognized certifications or professional credentials relevant to cybersecurity, information assurance, or information security operations. Strong subject matter expertise in cybersecurity principles and defensive security practices, combined with effective communication skills and the ability to explain complex security concepts to diverse learners. Knowledge of cyber risk management, regulatory and compliance considerations, ethical security practices, and responsible use of security technologies. Faculty must have a commitment to ongoing professional development in instructional technology, digital literacy, and responsible AI practices. Additional requirements driven by state licensing, institutional policy, or accreditation standards may apply.

Preferred Qualifications:

Industry certifications related to cybersecurity operations, ethical hacking, incident response, or security management (e.g., certifications associated with security analysis, penetration testing, or security governance). Experience with security frameworks and operational models, such as risk management frameworks, security operations center practices, and threat intelligence processes. Experience with defensive and proactive cybersecurity techniques, including penetration testing methodologies, vulnerability assessment, digital forensics, and incident response. Experience implementing DevSecOps or secure development practices to support secure application and infrastructure environments. Experience with programmatic or regional accreditation processes, including outcomes assessment, curriculum alignment, and continuous improvement initiatives. Active membership or engagement in professional cybersecurity or information security organizations to maintain current industry awareness. Experience integrating cybersecurity laboratories, security simulation platforms, capture-the-flag environments, and real-world security scenarios into post-secondary instruction to support applied learning. Two to five years of teaching experience at the post-secondary level, preferably in cybersecurity, networking, digital forensics, information assurance, or related computing disciplines.

Pay may vary in most states from $1500-$2700 per 8-week session.

Pay in the states of AZ, CA, IN and PA is paid at an hourly rate of either $22.00/hour or $23.50/hour.

Account Executive, Partnerships

United States – Remote

About the Account Executive, Partnerships Position

The Account Executive, Partnerships is a true hunter responsible for identifying, developing, and closing new business and strategic partnership opportunities across 360 Legal. This role owns the sales process from initial outreach through contract execution, including prospecting, cold calling, discovery, solution presentation, negotiation, and securing signed agreements.

After contract execution, the Account Executive provides a complete and timely handoff to the internal teams responsible for onboarding, implementation, activation, go-live, and ongoing account management.

About 360 Legal (A Family of Brands)

360 Legal is a leading provider of online legal and business solutions, offering a suite of innovative, easy-to-use platforms designed to empower individuals, entrepreneurs, nonprofits, and businesses at every stage. As the parent company of a growing family of brands, 360 Legal delivers accessible and affordable services across a wide range of needs – from business formation and trademark registration to estate planning, legal documents, mail management, and nonprofit compliance.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify, research, and prospect strategic partners, including associations, software providers, professional services firms, referral organizations, and complementary businesses.
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities across 360 Legal.
  • Conduct outbound prospecting through cold calling, email, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, conferences, trade shows, and other sales channels.
  • Engage business owners, executives, and other decision-makers; lead discovery meetings to understand business needs, goals, budget, decision process, and potential fit.
  • Present relevant products, pricing, partnership models, and value propositions; develop tailored proposals, presentations, and business cases.
  • Own the full sales cycle, manage objections and stakeholders, negotiate pricing and commercial terms within company guidelines, and secure executed agreements.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Finance, Product, and other internal stakeholders during the contracting process and accurately document all agreed-upon terms, requirements, and commitments.
  • Conduct a structured post-signature handoff, including complete documentation of business needs, contracted terms, timelines, stakeholders, and commitments made during the sales process.
  • Maintain accurate prospecting activity, opportunity stages, notes, next steps, contract values, close dates, and forecasts in HubSpot CRM.
  • Provide reliable pipeline forecasts and monitor pipeline coverage, conversion rates, sales-cycle progress, and performance against assigned goals.
  • Share market feedback, customer needs, competitive insights, and sales trends with Sales, Marketing, Product, and leadership.
  • Represent the company professionally at customer meetings, webinars, conferences, trade shows, and industry events.

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Three to seven or more years of experience in account executive, business development, partnerships, channel sales, strategic alliances, or consultative B2B sales.
  • Demonstrated success prospecting, developing, negotiating, and closing new business through a complete sales cycle.
  • Strong cold-calling, outbound prospecting, consultative selling, presentation, objection-handling, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to identify and engage decision-makers, create urgency, and advance opportunities through complex sales cycles.
  • Experience developing proposals and business cases and communicating financial, operational, and strategic value.
  • Experience selling B2B SaaS, technology, legal, financial, compliance, nonprofit, or professional services solutions preferred.
  • Proficiency with CRM and sales engagement platforms such as HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, or similar tools.
  • Strong pipeline management, forecasting, organization, follow-through, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a results-driven remote environment.
  • Ability to accurately represent product capabilities, negotiate within approved parameters, and travel periodically as needed.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Building a repeatable pipeline of qualified partnership opportunities.
  • Signing high-quality strategic partners.
  • Achieving an 80% or greater partner activation rate.
  • Driving first-year partner revenue.
  • Building long-term customer acquisition channels.
  • Delivering accurate forecasts and maintaining strong CRM hygiene.

Compensation

Base Salary: $60,000

On-Target Earnings: Approximately $100,000

This position is eligible for variable compensation based on:

  • The number of new partners signed, paid quarterly
  • The number of new partners activated, paid quarterly
  • A percentage of first-year revenue generated by newly activated partners during the first twelve months following activation, paid annually.

Final commission rates, performance thresholds, eligibility requirements, and payment terms will be outlined in the company’s sales compensation plan. Actual earnings may vary based on performance.

raw.title: Lead Vulnerability Operations Associate
raw.excerpt: As a Lead Vulnerability Operations Associate at QXO, you’ll lead the day-to-day execution and continuous improvement of vulnerability and exposure management across QXO’s systems.
raw.description:
As a Lead Vulnerability Operations Associate at QXO, you’ll lead the day-to-day execution and continuous improvement of vulnerability and exposure management across QXO’s systems. You’ll serve as the technical escalation point, set remediation priorities, and drive accountable action across infrastructure, cloud, and application teams. You’ll remain hands-on with AI and automation, and measure success through risk reduced and validated remediation.

QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best-in-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second-largest distributor of roofing products, the second-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit QXO.com.

What you'll do:

  • Lead vulnerability operations end to end, from intake and triage through prioritization, remediation, and validated closure; set operating standards, coordinate daily priorities, and resolve complex escalations.
  • Own the correlation and deduplication of findings across vulnerability, CNAPP, EDR, and attack surface tools; use AI and automation to produce a reliable, prioritized view of exposure.
  • Define and apply risk-based prioritization and remediation timelines using the CISA BOD 26-04 decision model: asset exposure, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) status, exploit automation, and technical impact, informed by EPSS, threat intelligence, and asset criticality.
  • Design, implement, and improve AI-assisted remediation workflows covering fix guidance, ticket creation, owner routing, patch deployment, and automated validation, with testing and production change controls.
  • Lead remediation planning with infrastructure, cloud, and application owners; resolve ownership gaps, negotiate achievable action plans, and escalate overdue or high-risk exposures with clear business impact and recommended next steps.
  • Prioritize and deliver automation with engineering for repeatable fixes such as patching, configuration drift, image rebuilds, and dependency upgrades; measure improvements in remediation time and manual effort.
  • Establish review standards for AI agents and LLM tooling used to research vulnerabilities, assess impact, and draft remediation or compensating control guidance; require human review of production changes.
  • Set asset inventory and coverage requirements across internet-reachable assets and the internal attack surface, including acquired environments; drive resolution of ownership, tagging, and visibility gaps.
  • Lead the vulnerability response workstream for critical exposures through QXO’s incident response process, coordinating scoping, containment recommendations, remediation, validated closure, and after action reporting with Cybersecurity Operations.
  • Serve as the vulnerability escalation point for Cybersecurity Operations during active events; direct exposure scoping and forensic triage support, identify threat hunting leads, and coordinate detection coverage with incident responders.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation for critical cybersecurity response, including off-hours work, and provide lead-level escalation support for urgent exposures.
  • Lead technical evaluation of exceptions with GRC; recommend compensating controls and time-bound remediation plans, and route risk acceptance to authorized decision-makers with expiry and reassessment tracked.
  • Own vulnerability metrics and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), including mean time to remediate, SLA adherence, exposure aging, and automation coverage; explain trends, blockers, and recommended actions to leadership.
  • Define data quality checks and integration requirements across asset and findings tools; resolve systemic data issues so prioritization, reporting, and automated decisions can be trusted.
  • Use breach and attack simulation and penetration test results to validate controls and remediation effectiveness; translate recurring findings into prioritized engineering improvements.
  • Lead preparation of vulnerability operations evidence for internal and external audits and coordinate remediation of identified process or control gaps.
  • Set and maintain vulnerability operations procedures, runbooks, and automation playbooks; mentor analysts, review complex assessments, and reinforce consistent triage and closure standards.
  • Assess emerging vulnerabilities, attacker TTPs, and AI security tooling; recommend and deliver practical improvements to exposure coverage, prioritization, and remediation performance.

What you'll bring:

Skills and Experience

  • 7+ years in vulnerability management, security operations, systems administration, or infrastructure engineering, including substantial hands-on vulnerability operations experience and 2+ years leading technical workstreams or complex remediation initiatives.
  • A demonstrated track record of leading remediation at enterprise scale, setting priorities across competing business needs, and delivering measurable reductions in exposure and time to fix.
  • Experience leading critical vulnerability response workstreams alongside a SOC or incident response team, including exposure scoping, containment recommendations, and validation of remediation during active events.
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing AI, LLM, or agent-assisted security workflows for triage, prioritization, ticketing, or fix generation, with validation and human review controls.
  • Deep hands-on experience with risk-based vulnerability and exposure management platforms (e.g., Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Wiz), including API integrations, coverage validation, data normalization, and complex finding analysis.
  • Ability to build, test, and maintain automation and orchestration using SOAR, Python, PowerShell, or REST APIs and integrate remediation workflows with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or Jira.
  • Strong practical knowledge of patch and configuration management (e.g., Microsoft Intune, SCCM), infrastructure-as-code, and production change practices, with experience guiding teams through complex remediation.
  • Strong technical understanding of Windows, Linux, networking, and cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP), with the ability to assess exploitability, attack paths, and operational impact across environments.
  • Ability to apply CISA BOD 26-04 and BOD 22-01, CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK, and software development lifecycle knowledge to defensible prioritization and remediation decisions.
  • Experience mapping vulnerability operations practices and evidence to at least one compliance framework: NIST CSF, PCI DSS, SOX, ISO 27001, or CMMC.
  • Ability to communicate exposure, business impact, remediation tradeoffs, and performance trends to technical owners and leadership, with clear recommendations and accountable action plans.

Additional Qualifications

  • A track record of integrity, pride in your work, curiosity, and adaptability.
  • A builder mindset supported by delivered process improvements and automation that reduces manual work while improving reliability.
  • Sound technical judgment on when automation can run unattended, when human review is required, and when risk or production impact requires escalation.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence remediation owners without direct authority, resolve competing priorities, and secure follow-through on risk reduction commitments.
  • Ability to independently lead complex workstreams, mentor analysts, review technical assessments, and establish consistent operating practices with minimal supervision.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information assurance, MIS, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Certification Requirements

  • Preferred, not required: GIAC (GCED, GCIH, GPEN), CompTIA CySA+, CISSP, AI security or automation coursework, or equivalent.

What you'll earn

  • Base pay range: $101,300 - $172,000
  • Annual performance bonus
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • PTO, company holidays, and parental leave
  • Paid Time Off/Paid Sick Leave: Applicants can expect to accrue 15 days of paid time off during their first year (4.62 hours for every 80 hours worked) and increased accruals after five years of service.
  • Paid training and certifications
  • Legal assistance and identity protection
  • Pet insurance
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)

To comply with Pay Transparency laws, employers must disclose an annual salary range. Actual offers depend on factors such as location, experience, skills, and market data. This position may also offer variable compensation.

Please contact if you have any questions related to this job posting.

QXO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender or sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

Req ID:398007

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Senior Data Scientist - Healthcare AI & Data Harmonization - Remote to join our team in Philadelphia, Plano, Pennsylvania (US-PA), United States (US).

Senior Data Scientist – Healthcare AI & Data Harmonization

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist to lead the architecture, development, and scaling of an enterprise data harmonization platform focused on transforming large volumes of complex healthcare and medical data into standardized, structured, and actionable information.

This individual will serve as a senior technical subject matter expert, designing and implementing intelligent AI-driven pipelines to ingest, interpret, normalize, and map heterogeneous structured and unstructured datasets, including clinical, genomic, pathology, and operational data.

The role will leverage advanced Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), semantic search, and biomedical ontologies to automate complex data mapping and schema alignment at enterprise scale.

The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in machine learning architecture, transformer models, distributed computing, and AI infrastructure, including optimization and deployment across specialized hardware accelerators such as NVIDIA GPUs and Google TPUs. They will work closely with Data Engineering, Bioinformatics, and Regulatory/Compliance teams to deliver scalable, production-ready AI and MLOps solutions.

Key Responsibilities

AI Architecture & Data Harmonization

  • Define the technical architecture and roadmap for an enterprise-scale data harmonization and intelligent mapping platform.
  • Design and develop AI-powered pipelines to ingest, process, normalize, and map heterogeneous clinical, genomic, biomedical, and operational datasets.
  • Automate complex schema alignment, semantic matching, and data transformation across structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Establish scalable approaches for processing multi-terabyte datasets while maintaining data quality, accuracy, and performance.

LLM, NLP & AI Model Development

  • Architect, fine-tune, and deploy domain-specific Large Language Models, transformer architectures, and embedding models for healthcare data interpretation and semantic alignment.
  • Develop advanced NLP capabilities, including Named Entity Recognition (NER), entity linking, relation extraction, and clinical information extraction.
  • Implement semantic search and retrieval-based approaches to improve medical terminology recognition, contextual understanding, and automated data mapping.
  • Evaluate and optimize model performance, accuracy, inference latency, and computational efficiency.

GPU/TPU Acceleration & Distributed AI Computing

  • Lead the optimization and deployment of complex AI/ML workloads using specialized hardware accelerators, including NVIDIA GPUs and Google TPUs.
  • Leverage acceleration and distributed computing technologies to support high-throughput model training, fine-tuning, and inference.
  • Optimize transformer and NLP workloads using technologies such as CUDA, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, DeepSpeed, and vLLM.
  • Establish scalable infrastructure and deployment patterns to support enterprise-level AI processing requirements.

Medical Ontology & Semantic Data Mapping

  • Lead the development of automated mapping solutions that align diverse healthcare data sources with established biomedical vocabularies and ontologies.
  • Establish standardized approaches for schema mapping, terminology normalization, semantic validation, and data quality assurance.
  • Work with healthcare data standards and models, including OMOP CDM, FHIR, UMLS, SNOMED CT, RxNorm, and LOINC.
  • Develop validation frameworks and quality controls to ensure consistency, traceability, and accuracy across mapped datasets.

MLOps, Platform Engineering & Technical Leadership

  • Partner with Data Engineers, Bioinformaticians, and Regulatory/Compliance teams to deliver production-ready AI and data processing solutions.
  • Design and implement scalable MLOps pipelines supporting model deployment, monitoring, versioning, evaluation, and continuous retraining.
  • Establish development standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices for enterprise AI model development.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to mid-level Data Scientists and ML Engineers.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to improve automation, scalability, and model performance.

Required Qualifications

  • 6–8+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning Engineering, or Applied AI, with demonstrated experience developing and deploying production-grade AI/ML solutions.
  • 3+ years of dedicated experience in Healthcare, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Informatics, or a related domain.
  • Strong practical understanding of healthcare data complexities, including clinical data, medical terminology, unstructured medical records, and applicable privacy requirements such as HIPAA and GDPR.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting and scaling AI-driven data processing, harmonization, or semantic mapping solutions.
  • Strong experience with advanced NLP, transformer architectures, LLMs, and embedding models.
  • Experience deploying and optimizing machine learning models in distributed, enterprise-scale environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and collaborate across multidisciplinary engineering and data science teams.

Technical Skills & Expertise

AI Infrastructure & Hardware Acceleration

  • Advanced experience with NVIDIA GPU architectures, including A100/H100 Tensor Core GPUs, and/or Google TPUs.
  • Hands-on experience with CUDA, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, DeepSpeed, and/or vLLM.
  • Experience optimizing distributed training, model fine-tuning, and high-throughput inference workloads.

Machine Learning & Generative AI

  • Expert-level Python programming and strong experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face.
  • Experience developing, fine-tuning, and deploying domain-specific LLMs, transformer models, and embedding models.
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and vector-based semantic search.
  • Strong understanding of NLP, information extraction, entity recognition, semantic similarity, and knowledge representation.

Healthcare Data Standards & Ontologies

  • Strong knowledge of healthcare data standards, biomedical vocabularies, and semantic data models, including:
    • OMOP Common Data Model (OMOP CDM)
    • HL7 FHIR
    • UMLS
    • SNOMED CT
    • RxNorm
    • LOINC
  • Experience with clinical terminology mapping, medical ontology alignment, and healthcare data normalization.

Big Data, Cloud & Distributed Computing

  • Experience designing and implementing large-scale distributed data processing solutions using PySpark, Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent platforms.
  • Familiarity with AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data and AI infrastructure.
  • Experience processing and harmonizing large volumes of structured and unstructured data.

MLOps & Deployment

  • Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, model monitoring, model versioning, and automated retraining.
  • Strong understanding of production ML architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance optimization.

Education

  • Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Informatics, Computational Biology, Machine Learning, or another related quantitative discipline.

Pay Transparency

Where required by law, NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for specific roles. The starting pay range for this remote role is $116,775-$216,250. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications.

This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits.

Job brief

Join Elite Escapes and turn your passion for travel into your next career.

As a Remote Cruise Planner (Sales-Focused),

you'll help clients turn we should take a cruise someday into a confirmed sailing they cannot wait to board. You'll combine destination knowledge, great service, and a consultative sales approach to match travelers with the right ship, itinerary, cabin, and onboard experience—whether they are planning a romantic escape, multigenerational family vacation, celebration at sea, group sailing, or bucket-list voyage.

What You'll Do

  • Connect with clients to understand their preferred destinations, travel style, budget, dates, group size, and cruise must-haves.
  • Recommend the right cruise line, ship, itinerary, stateroom, dining package, shore excursions, and add-ons based on each traveler's needs.
  • Turn inquiries into confirmed cruise vacations through email, chat, and phone with energy, accuracy, and a client-first approach.
  • Explain cruise options clearly, including cabin categories, deposits, payment plans, travel protection, onboard packages, and port requirements.
  • Handle booking details, special requests, changes, payments, upgrades, and pre-cruise questions with professionalism and care.

  • Interest in cruises, ocean travel, river cruising, expedition voyages, or helping people explore the world by sea.
  • Travel-industry, sales, hospitality, customer-service, or booking experience is preferred—but not required. Zero experience is welcome.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to guide clients toward a decision.
  • Strong organization skills and comfort managing multiple quotes, reservations, follow-ups, and client details.
  • Comfort with technology, online booking platforms, CRM systems, and AI tools—we will train you on the rest.

Cruise planning has plenty of moving parts—but if you enjoy helping people choose between ocean views and balconies, island stops and bucket-list ports, relaxation and adventure, you will thrive here. Your work will transform questions into bookings and cruise dreams into unforgettable days at sea.

Who We Are

We curate journeys that turn travel dreams into reality. We believe travel and adventure should create transformative, lifelong memories — that's why we partner with advisors who share that passion.

Sound Like You?

Apply today—we look forward to welcoming you aboard.

raw.description:
About TaskUs:TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.


The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.


It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment’s notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.


What We Offer:At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.

The Mission: As a Senior Data Engineer, you are the engine room of our data strategy. You don't just "move data"; you build resilient, self-healing systems that transform raw, into high-fidelity data products. You will take the Architect’s blueprints and turn them into production-grade code, ensuring there is clean and reliable data.

Work mode : Remote

What the Senior Data Engineer will own:

  • Pipeline Engineering: Build and maintain high-throughput ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from various sources into our Lakehouse.

  • Code Quality & Tooling: Drive the adoption of dbt for transformation and PySpark for heavy lifting. You will be responsible for writing modular, reusable code that follows strict CI/CD practices.

  • Observability & Reliability: Implement "Data SLAs." You will build the monitoring and alerting systems that notify the team of data drift or pipeline failures before the business notices.

  • Data Productization: Work closely with the BI team and Data Scientists to prepare "feature-ready" datasets.

  • Performance Tuning: Deep-dive into SQL and Spark query plans to optimize slow-running jobs, reducing cost and latency.

  • Local Development Advocacy: Implementing a workflow where engineers can develop and test complex SQL transformations locally using DuckDB, drastically reducing "waiting-for-cluster" time and lowering development costs.

  • Cost-Efficient Micro-Pipelines: Building specialized pipelines for specific client reporting or data-quality checks that run on single-node containers (e.g., Lambda or small ECS tasks) using DuckDB, avoiding the minimum billing cycles of larger warehouses.

  • Embedded Analytics: Exploring ways to use DuckDB as an embedded engine for internal tools or "edge" processing within the BPO’s local site offices where bandwidth to the cloud might be a constraint.

Technical Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ Years in Data Engineering: You’ve lived through the "on-call" life and know how to build systems that don't break at 3 AM.

  • The Power Trio: Expert-level proficiency in Python, SQL, and PySpark.

  • Modern Lakehouse Stack: Hands-on experience with Databricks (Delta Lake) or Snowflake. You understand the nuances of the Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold).

  • Transformation & Modeling: Advanced experience with dbt (Data Build Tool). You treat data models like software, including version control, testing, and documentation.

  • Orchestration: Experience with Apache Airflow or Prefect, specifically building complex, idempotent DAGs.

  • Streaming Experience: Familiarity with Kafka, Kinesis, or Spark Streaming is a huge plus—our BPO operations move in real-time.

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Comfort with Terraform or CloudFormation to manage your own data infrastructure.

  • In-Process Analytics (DuckDB): Proven experience using DuckDB for high-speed local development, unit testing data transformations, or as a query engine for "small-to-medium" datasets (up to 100GB) without the overhead of a distributed cluster.

  • Hybrid Execution Patterns: Ability to identify when to use heavyweight compute (PySpark/Databricks) versus lightweight compute (DuckDB/Python) to minimize cloud costs and reduce job latency.

  • Parquet/Iceberg Interaction: Experience using DuckDB to directly query data stored in S3/Azure Blob (via Parquet or Iceberg files) for rapid ad-hoc analysis or local dashboarding.

  • Orchestration:Kubernetes (K8s). Deep understanding of Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and Secrets management.

How We Partner To Protect You: TaskUs will neither solicit money from you during your application process nor require any form of payment in order to proceed with your application. Kindly ensure that you are always in communication with only authorized recruiters of TaskUs.

DEI:In TaskUs we believe that innovation and higher performance are brought by people from all walks of life. We welcome applicants of different backgrounds, demographics, and circumstances. Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities. If you need reasonable accommodations in any part of the hiring process, please let us know.

We invite you to explore all TaskUs career opportunities and apply through the provided URL.

raw.description:
Over the next 50 years, the noise in our systems will grow—amplified by reactive decisions, environmental disruption, and shifting political and economic realities. These pressures will come from within and beyond our borders. Making decisions based on hard evidence has become the imperative of our times.

With approximately 100 economists and researchers Signal49 Research provides Canadians with the accurate data and rigorous unbiased research they need to navigate complex issues across eight critical arenas—Economics, Education & Skills, Health, Human Resources, Indigenous & Northern Communities, Innovation & Technology, Immigration, and Sustainability. As Canada’s leading applied research organization, we publish over 500 research outputs a year, helping to advance education on the critical issues facing our communities, our organizations and our country. Our Executive Councils bring leaders together to share real-world insights and support evidence-based decision-making. All in service of a stronger more prosperous Canada.

For more than 70 years, Signal49 Research is where Canada has turned for applied, independent research and meaningful connections. Leaders trust us because we stand apart: objective, credible, and connected. To learn more about Signal49 Research and our history, check out our website:

We are seeking a Senior Council Manager to join the Convening team.

Our ideal candidate will display credibility, leadership, and professionalism in all aspects of their role. They will have experience working in a professional customer-focused environment, be enthusiastic about delivering high-quality events and services, possess strong interpersonal and networking skills, and enjoy thinking outside of the box to discover and deliver new, impactful ways of adding value to the organization and its members.

The ability to successfully work within a membership-based business model where fostering, managing and building relationships, delivering on the councils’ value-propositions, and driving thought-leadership are key.

A strong understanding of Canada’s Human Capital landscape and the evolving issues affecting workplaces and the workforce is highly desirable. This includes areas such as workplace inclusion, employee health and well-being, talent and workforce strategy, leadership, organizational culture, skills, productivity, and the changing nature of work. The successful candidate will demonstrate a natural curiosity and commitment to staying informed and ahead of trends in this dynamic space.

We are a virtual organization and as a remote worker you must be comfortable and able to work 100 per cent of the time from a home office in Canada, with the exception of the requirement to travel to attend regular council meetings and events hosted by Signal49 Research. To be successful as a remote worker you need to have a self-starter attitude, possess strong organizational and time management skills and be a proactive communicator. Having a home office environment that provides for a productive, professional, and safe work environment during regular working/business hours is a requirement of this role. This includes internet service and a reliable connection.

Please note this role does require travel to council meetings across the country.

About the Role

  • Content and program management for Executive Councils within the Human Capital Knowledge area, including:
    • developing strategic annual program plans
    • identifying timely and relevant meeting themes
    • developing thoughtful and strategic meeting agendas
    • designing and facilitating members-only virtual discussions
    • securing speakers/content experts to present at meetings
    • facilitating meetings and executive-level discussions;
    • planning webinars and other opportunities for member engagement; and
    • conducting annual one-on-one conversations with members
  • Lead the development and programming of the Better Workplace Conference, including:
    • establishing the annual conference theme and programming direction;
    • developing the overall program structure, session themes, and agenda;
    • identifying and securing speakers, moderators, and subject-matter experts;
    • developing session descriptions, objectives, and speaker briefing materials;
    • facilitating or moderating conference sessions, as appropriate;
    • working with speakers and moderators to prepare them for effective virtual delivery;
    • collaborating with internal teams to support the planning, promotion, and delivery of the conference; and
    • reviewing participant feedback and event results to continuously strengthen the conference program.
  • Work collaboratively with research staff to ensure that ideas and insights are flowing to and from the councils.
  • Work closely with the council coordinators to ensure smooth day-to-day operations
  • Manage the councils’ finances, ensuring that each council’s annual revenue and expense targets are met.
  • Work with the business development team and current members to identify prospects and recruit new members.
  • Build and strengthen relationships with existing council members staying connected to their levels of satisfaction.
  • Connect with the councils’ Advisory Committees several times per year to gather input on member priorities, programming, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen the councils.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to producing high-quality work and upholding professional values in all aspects of work and interactions with colleagues, members, speakers, and partners.

About You

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • A minimum of 10 years of experience in a professional, customer-oriented environment, with responsibility for managing projects or programs from inception to completion.
  • Significant experience leading stakeholder-engagement activities and building partnerships.
  • A bachelor’s degree in business, Human Resources, organizational development, social sciences, or a related field. A master’s degree is preferred.
  • Strong content knowledge in Human Capital and workplace-related areas: talent and workforce strategy, skills, and the changing nature of work; leadership and organizational culture; and workplace inclusion and employee health and well-being.
  • Broad working knowledge of leadership practices and the current and emerging trends affecting organizations, workplaces, and employees.
  • Demonstrated experience developing content and programming for conferences, executive events, professional communities, or other knowledge-based experiences.
  • Demonstrated business development skills and experience applying customer relationship management techniques to achieve results.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of adult-learning principles and meeting design, including facilitation and a variety of meeting formats for in-person and virtual delivery.
  • Experience delivering formal presentations and facilitating discussions with executive-level audiences.
  • A natural ability and willingness to share ideas and learnings with members and colleagues.
  • Strong project-management skills and the ability to manage multiple programs, relationships, and timelines simultaneously.
  • An accomplished networker and relationship builder.
  • Advanced communication skills with the ability to influence and engage a variety of internal and external audiences.
  • Advanced writing skills and proficiency in synthesizing complex concepts and information from a variety of sources.
  • Strong judgment, initiative, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
  • French-English bilingualism is an asset.

Benefits

At Signal49 Research, we believe that putting People First is key to our success and attracting the best people. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive work environment where everyone can thrive and we are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Virtual First – work from home anywhere across Canada with a budget to set up your home office.
  • A workplace where your hard work is not just valued, but actively celebrated. We take pride in our commitment to recognizing and rewarding the exceptional talent that drives our success through our Recognition programs.
  • Healthcare benefits from Day One to support your physical and mental wellbeing, including a $2,500 benefit for Psychologist, Social Worker or Psychotherapist services
  • Work/Life Balance: In addition to 20 days annual vacation, we close between Christmas Day and New Year’s Day, observe 13 holidays per year and offer Friday afternoon closures.
  • A modern, defined benefit (DB) pension plan: We care about your future and offer a pension plan with a 5% match from Day One
  • Employee Family Assistance Program (EFAP): We understand that life can be unpredictable and challenging and EFAP supports you and your family during difficult times.
  • Maternity and parental leave top-up plan

raw.description:
Job Description:

CLUB CADDIE

Every course, one move ahead

Head of Enterprise Sales (MCO)

Sales & Marketing | Reports to: President/Chief Revenue Officer | Travel: ~50% | Full-Time


ABOUT CLUB CADDIE

Club Caddie is a fast-growing golf course management software (GMS) company and a member of the Jonas Software family, a division of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU). Our platform is the operating system for golf — unifying point of sale, tee sheet, member management, food and beverage, and payments into a single connected system for public, semi-private, and multi-course operators.

We are built by operators, for operators, and our brand is anchored in four commitments: Unified Operations, Intelligent Action, Revenue Momentum, and Hospitality Memory. As Club Caddie scales its footprint with the country's largest multi-course operators (MCOs), we're investing in the enterprise sales leadership to match that ambition.


THE ROLE

The Head of Enterprise Sales owns Club Caddie's go-to-market motion for Multi-Course Operators (MCO) — management companies and ownership groups operating multiple golf facilities across the country. This is a hunting, value-building, and relationship-building role for a seasoned enterprise sales leader who knows how to navigate long, complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and close large agreements.

You will report directly to the Chief Revenue Officer and work in close partnership with Marketing, Product, Implementation, and Customer Experience to build a durable pipeline of MCO logos, from first conversation through signed agreement and a clean handoff to post-sales. The base salary range for this role is between $110,000 - $120,000.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the MCO Sales Motion

  • Build and execute a strategic account plan targeting the top multi-course operators in the U.S. and Canada, prioritizing accounts by fit, size, and strategic value.
  • Manage a complex, multi-stakeholder sales pipeline in the CRM with rigor — accurate staging, next steps, forecasted close dates, and clear next steps on every opportunity.
  • Lead the full sales cycle: prospecting, discovery, solution design, ROI/business case development, procurement, contracting, and close through an enterprise level sales methodology.

Build Executive Relationships

  • Develop value-based relationships with C-suite and operations leaders (CEO, COO, VP of Golf Operations, CIO) at management companies and ownership groups.
  • Represent Club Caddie at industry events — NGCOA, the MCO Retreat (MCOR), and other regional and national golf industry gatherings — to build pipeline and deepen existing relationships.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, bringing a point of view on how technology can solve real operational and financial challenges across a multi-course portfolio.

Negotiate and Close Complex Deals

  • Lead commercial negotiations on multi-year, multi-property agreements, balancing win rate, margin, and long-term account health.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, and Implementation to structure deals that are commercially sound and operationally deliverable.
  • Manage competitive displacement deals against incumbent point-of-sale and tee sheet providers with a clear, defensible value narrative.

Drive Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Partner with Marketing and the Director of Digital on MCO-specific campaigns, collateral, and messaging that support the pipeline.
  • Work closely with the Executive, Product, Customer Experience, and Sales teams to translate enterprise buyer feedback into product improvements, market awareness, and competitor insights.
  • Ensure a clean, well-documented handoff from sales to implementation for every closed account, protecting the customer experience from contract to go-live.

Forecasting & Performance

  • Own MCO segment forecasting and pipeline reporting, contributing accurate inputs to company-wide revenue scorecards and QBRs.
  • Track and report on key metrics: pipeline coverage, deal velocity, win rate, average contract value, and sales cycle length.
  • Manage deals through a formal sales methodology e.g. MEDDIC, MEDDPIC, etc… to ensure internal and external alignment.
  • Continuously refine MCO sales playbooks, pricing strategy, and competitive positioning based on what's working in the field.
  • Achieve or exceed the annual targets for MCO sales including new logo and back-to-base revenue targets.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 7+ years of enterprise or complex B2B sales experience, with a track record of closing large, multi-stakeholder agreements; SaaS, hospitality, or golf/club industry experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success selling into complex organizations with long sales cycles and layered decision-making (procurement, ops, IT, finance, executive) leveraging enterprise sales methodologies.
  • Previous success creating value and desire across an entire organization including decision makers and deal champions.
  • Strong commercial negotiation skills, with experience structuring multi-year, enterprise-wide contracts.
  • Exceptional value-building instincts — comfortable and credible in a room with C-suite executives and front-line operators alike.
  • Highly organized and data-driven; disciplined about CRM hygiene, pipeline accuracy, and forecasting.
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% of the time for industry events, on-site customer meetings, and prospect visits.
  • Self-directed and resilient — comfortable building a territory and a pipeline largely from the ground up.
  • Genuine interest in or connection to the golf industry is a strong plus, but not required.

WHY JOIN CLUB CADDIE

  • Own a high-impact, high-visibility segment of the business, with a direct line to the CRO and executive team.
  • Sell a genuinely differentiated, unified platform into an industry that is actively consolidating around modern technology.
  • Competitive base plus uncapped commission, benefits, and the backing of Jonas Software and Constellation Software's scale and stability.
  • Be part of shaping the next chapter of Club Caddie's MCO strategy, not just executing an existing playbook.

Club Caddie is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Business Unit:

Club Caddie

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Number of Openings Available:

1

Worker Type:

Regular

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

raw.description:
NCG Medical is seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Medical Biller to join our growing team. This position is responsible for supporting the day-to-day medical billing and revenue cycle processes, ensuring claims are submitted accurately and timely, following up on outstanding claims, resolving billing discrepancies, and helping maximize reimbursement.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of general medical billing practices, insurance claims processing, accounts receivable, and revenue cycle management. This individual should be organized, proactive, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare, review, and submit accurate medical claims to insurance companies and third-party payers.
  • Verify patient insurance information and eligibility as needed.
  • Review claims for accuracy and completeness prior to submission.
  • Monitor claim status and follow up on unpaid, delayed, or denied claims.
  • Investigate and resolve claim denials, rejections, and payment discrepancies.
  • Process insurance payments, adjustments, and contractual write-offs.
  • Maintain and manage accounts receivable to support timely reimbursement.
  • Identify billing trends and recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Communicate with insurance companies and internal team members to resolve billing questions.
  • Maintain accurate billing records and documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA requirements, payer guidelines, and applicable billing regulations.
  • Meet established productivity, accuracy, and collection goals.

Qualifications & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education or certification in medical billing is a plus.
  • 3+ years of experience in medical billing, insurance claims processing, or revenue cycle management.
  • Strong knowledge of general medical billing procedures and insurance claims processing.
  • Experience with claim denials, appeals, payment posting, and accounts receivable follow-up.
  • Familiarity with CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS coding terminology.
  • Working knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance billing requirements.
  • Proficiency with electronic health records (EHR) and practice management/billing systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently.

Work Environment

  • Full-time, fully remote position.
  • Must have a reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with a remote team.
  • Must maintain confidentiality and adhere to HIPAA privacy and security requirements.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits.
  • 401(k) retirement plan.
  • Paid holidays and additional company benefits.

NCG Medical is an equal opportunity employer.
