Job brief

Join Elite Escapes and turn your passion for travel into your next career.

As a Remote Travel Planner (Sales-Focused), you'll turn travel dreams into booked itineraries by pairing destination expertise with a consultative, client-first sales approach. You'll design custom trips while guiding clients from their first what if? to a confirmed reservation — whether it's a solo escape, a group getaway, a destination wedding, or a family travel experience.

What You'll Do

  • Craft personalized travel plans: flights, stays, tours, cruises, and packages built around each client's budget, style, and must-haves.
  • Connect with clients to uncover their ideal trip, present tailored options, and confidently close the sale.
  • Resolve questions and concerns promptly and professionally (payments, date changes, room upgrades, add-ons, etc.).
  • Add value with insider knowledge: hidden gems, top photo spots, local experiences, and timely deals that make each trip special.
  • Stay with clients from start to finish — pre-trip planning and payment coordination, on-trip support, and post-trip follow-ups and reviews.

What You Bring

  • Strong communication and people skills; comfortable leading conversations, handling objections, and guiding clients to a decision.
  • Ability to juggle multiple quotes, itineraries, and bookings without dropping details.
  • Fast learner when it comes to new tools — CRMs, booking engines, analytics dashboards, and collaboration platforms.
  • Background in sales, customer service, hospitality, or travel is a bonus, but not required — we provide full training.
  • Genuine love for travel and helping others explore with confidence

What You Get

  • Fully remote role part time or full time
  • Comprehensive onboarding and ongoing coaching on products, suppliers, and sales-driven planning techniques.
  • A collaborative, supportive team culture.
  • Room to grow and specialize

This role moves quickly, but if you're the person who keeps itineraries, bookings, group trips, and collaborations running smoothly — turning conversations into confirmed trips and memorable experiences — you'll thrive here.

Ready to see where this path could take you?
Apply now — we'd love to meet you.

Greenhouse is the first Orchestrated Hiring Ecosystem: a single place that brings the right person and the right role together at the right time. Our mission is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

Greenhouse is looking for a Recruiting Operations Consultant, Managed Services to join our team! This role offers a unique opportunity to make a meaningful and widespread impact across Greenhouse's most strategic customers while helping shape and scale a high-impact Managed Services model.

As a Recruiting Operations Consultant, Managed Services, you'll act as a trusted advisor across a portfolio of complex Enterprise customers, combining hands-on execution with strategic consulting. You'll manage a book of business, lead system and process improvements, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business value.

This is an ideal role for someone with deep Greenhouse expertise, a passion for operational excellence, and a desire to drive outcomes at scale - all within a fast-growing, customer-centric team.

Who will love this job

  • A trusted advisor – balances consultative problem-solving with hands-on configuration, data hygiene, and in-app support
  • Recruiting Operations expert – enjoys working with top-tier TA teams and can jump into systems and processes to make quick, meaningful improvement
  • Systems thinker – translates complex recruiting workflows into scalable, efficient processes using Greenhouse and integrated tools
  • Relationship builder – thrives in customer-facing roles and enjoys fostering long-term partnerships
  • Process optimizer – embraces standardization, documentation, and automation to drive consistent value
  • Team player – excited to collaborate with Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, Sales and more to help define best practices as we scale

What you’ll do

  • Serve as the dedicated Recruiting Operations Consultant for a portfolio of Enterprise accounts across industries and levels of complexity, delivering within each customer's agreed weekly capacity.
  • Run a regular cadence with every customer: kick off the engagement, review their strategic initiatives, prioritize the work, and consult on product features, roadmap, and best practices.
  • Complete in-app configuration, including job template creation and updates, CRM data cleanup and deduplication, standard bulk actions, permission reviews, and updates within Configure settings.
  • Build and maintain standard and custom reports and dashboards using Greenhouse Recruiting's native reporting tools.
  • Guide structured hiring, workflow redesign, and adoption of new features, so customers get full value from Greenhouse as it evolves.
  • Contribute to department KPIs, including renewal retention, customer satisfaction (CSAT), quarterly Positive Business Outcomes, referenceable customers, and productive utilization.
  • Additional projects and responsibilities as business needs require

You should have

  • Greenhouse experience — 5+ years of hands-on work across GHR implementations or in-house administration, ideally with multiple orgs
  • Recruiting Operations or Consulting background — proven track record of delivering value in recruiting operation, managed services, or advisory work
  • Greenhouse recruiting operations fluency — experience with structured hiring, permissions auditing, reporting workflows, and in-app admin
  • Autonomy and prioritization — ability to manage multiple accounts and deliver high-quality work across competing priorities
  • Hands-on configuration skills — comfortable troubleshooting in-app configuration and working alongside integration and technical partners (you don't need to design integrations)
  • Communication skills — articulate, proactive, and confident leading calls, presenting to stakeholders, and managing expectations
  • Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of transferable skills that aren't always in alignment with a given role - but those are qualities we value at Greenhouse. If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply

Travel to customer and prospect sites, industry events, and Greenhouse offices is an essential function of this role. Travel is expected to be approximately 10-15% of working time and may include overnight stays and domestic or international travel. Travel frequency and destinations may vary with territory, account needs, and business priorities.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linkedhere.

The national pay range for this role is $116,900 - $149,000. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and qualifications. Certain roles may be eligible for additional compensation, including stock option awards, bonuses, and merit increases. Additionally, certain roles have the opportunity to receive sales commissions that are based on the terms of the sales commission plan applicable to the role.

Greenhouse provides a variety of benefits to employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, basic life insurance, mental health resources, financial wellness benefits, and a fully paid parental leave program. For US-based employees, we offer short-term and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan and company match. U.S. based employees also receive, per calendar year, up to 14 scheduled paid holidays and up to 80 hours of paid sick leave. Non-exempt employees accrue up to 20-25 days of paid vacation time annually, depending on tenure, and exempt employees have flexible paid time off (PTO).

The anticipated closing date for this role is December 18, 2026.

Who we are

At Greenhouse, we live by our mission through using our own product to help us hire the right person for the job, every time. We’re committed to designing and responsibly using AI tools to transform how we work while keeping people at the center. We are a remote-first company and have shared office spaces in New York City and Ireland, and optional co-working spaces that give us flexibility to do our best work anywhere. We take an active role in our growth through a performance review program that’s committed to providing actionable feedback, and a bonus structure that rewards great performance. We believe that bringing together a variety of perspectives makes us a stronger company – and we nurture leaders who create an inclusive culture and invest into employee resource groups that celebrate our differences and life experiences. We’re proud to have built an award-winning culture that’s been recognized as Fortune’s Best Places to Work and Inc.’s Best Workplaces multiple years in a row.

Internal Opportunity – Trial Program Specialist III

At PRC-Saltillo, our mission is to provide voices to children and adults who are unable to communicate effectively with their natural voices. Each year, we support thousands of individuals through specialized communication devices and software that empower people with Autism, ALS, Cerebral Palsy, Aphasia, and other conditions. Our work opens doors to education, employment, and fuller participation in life. As a Trial Program Specialist III, you’ll support customers throughout the communication device trial process while taking on additional responsibilities that help strengthen the Trial Device Program. You’ll assist teams across regions and divisions, manage return escalations and trial-related exceptions, conduct quality assurance audits, support TPS training, and work with management to identify opportunities for process improvement.

Why You’ll Love This Opportunity

  • Expand Your Impact: Take on additional responsibilities that support customers, team members, and the overall Trial Device Program.
  • Support & Develop Others: Assist with onboarding, training, process changes, and identified training needs for TPS staff.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Provide support across regions and divisions during staffing shortages, backlogs, volume changes, and other business needs.
  • Drive Process Improvement: Identify trends and pain points, participate in AFP user testing, and help identify opportunities to improve the Trial Device Program.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Perform all Trial Program Specialist I and II duties, including supporting customers throughout the trial process and processing purchase applications through the pre-submission stage.
  • Complete the trial return escalation process in a timely manner to help reduce the number of devices removed from inventory.
  • Support trial-related exception processes, including extensions, repairs, and other assigned exceptions.
  • Assist and fill in as needed during staffing shortages, backlogs, volume changes, and other division needs.
  • Complete quality assurance audits and use findings to identify and report potential training needs.
  • Assist management with onboarding and training new and current TPS staff, including new processes, process changes, and identified training gaps.
  • Help improve the Trial Device Program by identifying trends and pain points, participating in AAC Funding Portal (AFP) user testing, and providing feedback on work instructions and other documentation.
  • Suggest process changes and help prioritize improvement opportunities.
  • Work collaboratively with team members and management across regions and divisions.

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or general equivalency degree (GED) required.
  • At least one year of customer service experience required.
  • At least one year of previous experience as a TPS II with PRC-Saltillo required.
  • Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook is strongly recommended.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including comfort conducting customer-facing phone calls and proactively following up with customers and their teams.
  • Excellent organization and time management skills with the ability to prioritize responsibilities and meet deadlines.
  • A service mindset focused on delivering an excellent customer experience.
  • Detail-oriented, patient, process-oriented, and able to adapt to fast-paced and changing circumstances.
  • Ability to maintain a positive and professional attitude during high-stress situations.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively across divisions.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills and the ability to present information to others.
Salary: $25- $32

About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.
As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. Position summary

raw.description:
Company Overview

If you are passionate about water and technology, Trinnex is the place for you! Trinnex is a visionary company that is transforming the way water resources are managed and protected. By combining cutting-edge digital technologies, such as sensor/IoT data, models, geospatial data, and AI/machine learning, we create innovative, smart, and scalable solutions that make a difference. Whether it's optimizing water supply and demand, detecting leaks and anomalies, or enhancing water quality and resilience, Trinnex delivers value and impact to public sector clients across the country.


Job Description

Trinnex is seeking a Senior Data Science Specialist. This individual, with limited supervision, derives actionable business insights through the application of statistical, mathematical, predictive modeling and machine learning data analytics of moderate to high complexity.

  • Analyzes data patterns and trends, and provides insights to enhance decision making capabilities in business planning, process improvement, solution assessment, etc. Identifies new data requirements and translates into data architecture. Provides interpretative results to the business to identify value; communicates findings to business and information technology (IT) leaders.
  • Compiles, samples, and prepares data for statistical model creation, monitoring, and deployment. Applies data mining skills to manage and manipulate complex high-volume data from a variety of sources.
  • Designs meaningful visualizations that communicate findings and create business impact.
  • Ensures adequate internal control adherence and processes around model development, implementation and validation are established. Qualifies where information can be stored or what information, external to the organization, may be used in support of the use case.
  • Performs other duties as required.

Skills & Abilities

  • Possesses excellent written and oral communication skills and ability to interact with varying levels of staff, as well as vendors.
  • Proficiency in using query languages.
  • Understanding of machine-learning and operations research.
  • Advanced data mining techniques.
  • Advanced knowledge data cleansing, validation and general quality control principles.
  • Advanced analytical, quantitative, and statistical skills.
  • Advanced knowledge of and ability to use data modeling software.
  • Advanced experience with data preparation, data manipulation languages, libraries, and visual ETL (extract, transform, load) tools in support of data science use-cases is required.
  • Advanced experience with statistical computing and programming languages (ex: R, Python, Java, Scala, etc.) is required.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • 5 years of related experience.

Equivalent additional directly related experience will be considered in lieu of a degree. Domestic and/or international travel may be required. The frequency of travel is contingent on specific duties, responsibilities, and the essential functions of the position, which may vary depending on workload and project demands.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Agile Development: Demonstrated experience working effectively within Agile/Scrum methodologies. Includes active participation in Agile sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
  • Architecture & DevOps: Familiarity with model deployment practices (MLOps, Docker) and CI/CD pipelines, supplemented by hands-on experience utilizing Azure DevOps.
  • Cloud Platforms: Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP preferred), including proficiency in Vertex AI.
  • ML Frameworks:Practical experience with popular machine learning and deep learning toolkits (e.g., Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face).

No Travel is required

raw.description:
About AllShore Talent

AllShore Talent partners with growing organizations to build high-performing technology and consulting teams. We connect skilled professionals with meaningful, long-term engagements across web technologies, digital experience platforms, and enterprise software delivery — offering competitive compensation, flexible engagement models, and a collaborative, remote-friendly culture.

About The Role

The Data Architect provides hands-on data architecture and technical delivery expertise for Adobe Campaign Classic to Adobe Journey Optimizer modernisation. The role assesses the customer’s Campaign data model, workflows and integrations, defines the Adobe Experience Platform and AJO target data architecture, maps legacy data and processes to the new platform, and guides implementation, validation and transition.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery covering current data collection, data models, identities, integrations and platform configuration.

  • Document the current-state architecture and define a scalable target-state architecture based on Adobe Experience Platform.

  • Translate business and migration requirements into schemas, datasets, identity designs, data flows and integration specifications.

  • Map legacy implementation components and data structures to the target platform, identifying what should be migrated, redesigned or retired.

  • Work with technical consultants and customer engineering teams to implement the agreed architecture.

  • Define data quality, governance, privacy, security, retention, validation and reconciliation requirements.

  • Investigate source-to-target discrepancies and guide their resolution.

  • Produce clear architecture, design, mapping and implementation documentation, and identify dependencies, assumptions and risks early.

  • Support architecture governance and technical quality throughout implementation.

  • Understanding of AEP guardrails and licensing constraints, including recognising when a design is technically possible but not available under the customer’s licence.

  • lead workshops, present and recommend solutions, document designs and gain customer agreement.

Requirements

Experience and Skills

Essential

  • Strong technical experience with Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC).

  • Understanding of Campaign schemas, recipient and broad-log data, workflows, typologies, deliveries, integrations and custom extensions.

  • Strong Adobe Experience Platform experience, including XDM schema design, datasets, batch and streaming ingestion, identity namespaces, identity resolution, Real-Time Customer Profile, audience design, data governance and consent.

  • Practical experience with Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO).

  • Experience designing the data foundation required for AJO journeys, audiences, decisioning and message personalisation.

  • Ability to assess existing Campaign data and workflows and determine what should be migrated, redesigned or retired.

  • Experience mapping Campaign customer, interaction, campaign and delivery data into appropriate AEP schemas and datasets.

  • Experience integrating AEP and AJO with enterprise data sources and downstream activation or messaging services.

  • Experience facilitating customer-facing technical discovery and design workshops.

  • Ability to define validation and reconciliation approaches for migrated data and integrations.

Highly desirable

  • Previous delivery of an Adobe Campaign Classic-to-AJO migration or modernisation program.

  • Experience with Campaign custom schemas and complex workflow-based data processing.

  • Experience redesigning Campaign capabilities as AEP audiences, AJO journeys or platform integrations.

  • Understanding of AJO journeys, channel configuration, content, offers, decisioning and message execution.

  • Knowledge of consent, suppression, frequency-management and customer-preference patterns.

  • Experience supporting coexistence and transition between Campaign Classic and AJO.

  • Familiarity with APIs and event-driven integrations used to initiate journeys or update customer profiles.

  • Working knowledge of SQL, JSON, REST APIs and data-query or validation tools.

Expected deliverables

  • Current-state Campaign data model, workflow and integration assessment.

  • Target-state AEP and AJO data architecture.

  • Source-to-target mappings and XDM schema and dataset designs.

  • Identity, profile, audience, consent and governance design.

  • Batch, streaming, API and event-driven integration designs.

  • Migration and coexistence assumptions, dependencies and risks.

  • Validation, reconciliation and acceptance plan.

  • Technical implementation and operational handover documentation.

Engagement profile

This is a delivery-focused data architecture role. The successful contractor must be able to move between architecture and implementation-level detail, work effectively in a blended Adobe, customer and partner team, and provide clear evidence of personal ownership of relevant designs and delivery outcomes.

Engagement details section

  • Contract role.

  • Starts soon; a two-week notice period is acceptable.

  • Lasts 1–3 years.

  • Remote anywhere in EMEA, preferably Central Europe.

  • Occasional business travel, with expenses covered.

Program context: two migration paths built on AEP (AA → CJA and Campaign Classic → AJO). Customers are mostly B2C, across the UK, France, Spain, Germany, Norway and Italy.

Languages: strong professional English is required. German, French or Italian is highly valued.

Pay: $80,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Why This Is a Great Opportunity

  • Join a rapidly growing CPA firm focused on modern, technology-enabled audit and assurance services.
  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the United States.
  • Take ownership of audit engagements while gaining exposure to both public and private companies.
  • Lead fieldwork, coach junior auditors, and build valuable engagement leadership experience.
  • Work with modern tools including cloud technology, data analytics, and AI-supported processes.
  • Gain exposure to a variety of industries while developing deeper technical expertise in U.S. GAAP, auditing standards, internal controls, and risk assessment.
  • Join a collaborative team that values quality, professionalism, stability, and long-term career growth.

Location: Fully remote nationwide. This role can be performed from anywhere in the United States, giving you the flexibility to build your audit career without relocating.

Note: Candidates must have a Bachelor's degree in Accounting, 3+ years of public accounting audit experience, and an active CPA license. Stable employment history is strongly preferred.

About Us

We are a rapidly growing CPA firm delivering high-quality audit and assurance services to public and private companies across a variety of industries. Our team combines experienced professionals with modern technology, data analytics, cloud-based tools, and innovative processes to deliver efficient, reliable financial reporting solutions. We value technical excellence, collaboration, professional growth, and trusted relationships.Confidential Employer.

Job Description

  • Lead audit fieldwork and help keep engagements progressing efficiently from planning through completion.
  • Perform audit planning, risk assessments, substantive testing, and financial statement analysis.
  • Evaluate and document internal controls, audit risks, and key financial reporting processes.
  • Prepare accurate, complete, and review-ready audit workpapers and supporting documentation.
  • Audit financial statement areas including revenue, expenses, assets, liabilities, equity, and taxes.
  • Assist with preparation and review of financial statements and related disclosures.
  • Communicate audit findings, engagement status, and potential issues to managers and engagement leadership.
  • Coordinate directly with client contacts, internal specialists, and other engagement team members.
  • Supervise and coach junior auditors while providing practical feedback and guidance.
  • Follow applicable auditing standards, U.S. GAAP, independence requirements, firm methodology, and quality standards.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting required.
  • 3+ years of public accounting audit experience required.
  • Active CPA license required.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and professional auditing standards.
  • Experience with audit planning, risk assessment, substantive testing, internal controls, and financial statement audits.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Experience supervising or mentoring junior audit staff is helpful.
  • Big 4 or large public accounting firm experience preferred.
  • SEC and PCAOB audit experience preferred.
  • Stable employment history strongly preferred.

Why You Will Love Working Here

You will have the flexibility of a fully remote role while still gaining meaningful ownership of sophisticated audit engagements. Our growth creates opportunities for advancement, broader responsibilities, and continued professional development. If you enjoy technical accounting, working collaboratively with experienced professionals, and helping deliver high-quality audit work, this is an opportunity to make an immediate impact.

  • Dental insurance

Location

  • Knowledge of SaaS, B2B, or enterprise software environments

Minimum Education Requirement

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field or equivalent practical experience

raw.description:
The American Lung Association has an excellent opportunity for a Specialist, HelpLine.Working as a member of the HelpLine department, you will join an outstanding group of professionals dedicated to our mission: to save lives by improving lung health and preventing lung disease through research, education, and advocacy.

The Specialist, HelpLine will be responsible for working within the American Lung Association grant funded program, Illinois Tobacco Quitline, the incumbent will provide information or guidance regarding tobacco/smoking cessation counseling to the general public.

Location: Remote

This position is home-based, and we encourage candidates in any location in the United States to apply.

Responsibilities:

  • Answer Quitline incoming calls related to those who are seeking assistance in stopping tobacco use – providing reactive and proactive counseling.
  • Complete and maintain documentation in the database for each call – logging message left on voicemail, performing counseling and follow ups on designated calls as appropriate.
  • Provide information or guidance on all questions regarding tobacco cessation via Quitline technology (telephone, chat, text, email).
  • Participate in course and become certified as a tobacco treatment specialist; maintain CEU requirement for certification.
  • Follow Quitline protocol on all responses.
  • Assure all information is collected and entered into the database.
  • Participate as a member of the resource evaluation committee to assure continual updating of resources.
  • Assist in indexing new materials.
  • Be familiar with current smoking cessation and tobacco intervention techniques for the purpose of counseling.
  • Understand and implement protocols for dealing with special groups or projects.
  • Become familiar with all issues concerning tobacco prevention and environmental issues.
  • Coordinate and implement mission related activities.
  • Coordinate, implement and monitor deliverables.
  • Complete reports as assigned.
  • Staff committees and work groups as assigned.
  • Continually seek innovative ALA growth

Qualifications:

  • Associate's degree required, bachelor's degree or certification as an addiction counselor and/or experience in counseling preferred.
  • A minimum of 3 years' experience in counseling, community health education, or social work is preferred. Previous experience with tobacco cessation or health behavior change, preferred.
  • Ability to communicate effectively on the telephone and online via chat and demonstrate good customer service.
  • Ability to relate to persons with diverse educational, socioeconomic and ethnic backgrounds.
  • Ability to handle a “call center” environments; manage large amounts of inbound and outbound calls in a timely manner.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule - training hours; weekdays – daytime first 4 weeks and transition to afternoons next 4 weeks; after training work afternoon/evening hours of 1:30 pm – 9 pm Central Time and one designated weekend day from 9 am – 5 pm Central Time.
  • Critical skills required including analytical decision making, customer resource knowledge, organizing and coordinating, position-specific expertise, interpersonal understanding, teamwork/internal partnership, individual accountability, initiative, versatility and self-management.
  • Knowledgeable in Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point and Outlook. Good typing skills.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems and practices.
  • Hold valid driver's license and be able/willing to attend events as requested. (Travel/mileage reimbursed according to ALA policy).
  • Ability to lift and carry 25 lbs. (event supplies).
  • Consistent with its mission, the American Lung Association maintains a tobacco-free workplace, all employees must abstain from use of tobacco in any form, including vaping.

Compensation: Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. The target hiring rate for this position is $50,000 per annum.

Benefits: The Lung Association offers a comprehensive benefits package including:

  • Paid Leave - 10 vacation days in the first year (15 days thereafter), 2 personal days and 15 sick days per year, as well as 12 company-paid holidays per year. We also offer Paid Parental Leave for eligible employees.
  • Insurance - Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in our medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as voluntary plans for critical illness, accident, hospital indemnity, short-term disability and supplemental life/AD&D insurance. Employees will be enrolled in company-paid life/AD&D and long-term disability Insurance coverage.
  • Retirement Plan - Eligible employees can participate in our 401(k) Defined Contribution Retirement Plan, which offers matching employer contributions (up to 4%) and year-end discretionary non-elective contributions.

Equal Employment Opportunity

The American Lung Association is an equal opportunity employer. It is the policy of the American Lung Association to prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type and to provide equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants, without regard to their race, color, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, religion, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, genetic predisposition or carrier status, or physical and/or mental disabilities, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

raw.excerpt: About the RoleWe are looking for a Senior Gen AI Video & Motion Designer to join our global Creative Capability team and lead the production of high-quality video content across multiple client accounts.
raw.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Gen AI Video & Motion Designer to join our global Creative Capability team and lead the production of high-quality video content across multiple client accounts.

This is a hands-on creative role combining video editing, motion design, storytelling, and generative AI production. You will take projects from brief and storyboard through to final delivery, using traditional video craft alongside Gen AI tools to create high-quality, scalable content for paid media, social, and digital platforms.

A key part of the role is developing repeatable workflows and automation that allow the team to produce multiple platform, market, and audience-specific video variations efficiently, while maintaining a high creative and technical standard.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop storyboards and video concepts based on creative briefs, audience insights, and performance objectives.
  • Edit and produce video content across multiple formats, from hero assets to short-form paid social and 6-second cuts.
  • Create and integrate Gen AI video using text-to-video, image-to-video, generative extension, scene creation, object removal, outpainting, and other AI-assisted techniques.
  • Combine AI-generated content with traditional footage and professional post-production to ensure seamless, polished results.
  • Create motion graphics, kinetic typography, transitions, lower thirds, end frames, and other branded elements.
  • Adapt and version video content for different platforms, markets, languages, audiences, and aspect ratios.
  • Develop scalable video production workflows, templates, and automation processes to increase production efficiency.
  • Maintain prompt libraries, references, presets, and other systems that support consistent Gen AI output.
  • Ensure all final content meets creative, technical, brand, and platform standards, identifying and correcting AI artefacts and continuity issues.
  • Work closely with Creative Directors, Strategists, Designers, and other teams across the global Creative Capability.
  • Incorporate performance insights into creative decisions and future video concepts.
  • Share knowledge and help upskill other designers in Gen AI video tools and workflows.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in video editing and motion design.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience using Generative AI video tools in real production environments.
  • Mandatory: Portfolio/showreel demonstrating Gen AI video work.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.
  • Strong knowledge of Photoshop and Illustrator.
  • Experience with DaVinci Resolve or an equivalent editing/color-grading tool.
  • Strong storytelling and storyboarding skills.
  • Experience creating video for performance marketing, paid media, social, or digital advertising.
  • Experience producing high volumes of video variations and adapting content for different platforms and markets.
  • Strong understanding of video formats, aspect ratios, codecs, compression, and digital platform specifications.
  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when reviewing AI-generated content for artefacts, continuity, and brand consistency.
  • Ability to explain and defend creative decisions to both creative and non-creative stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ComfyUI, Figma Weave, or other node-based AI workflows.
  • Python, JavaScript, ExtendScript, or other scripting/automation experience.
  • Experience with LoRAs, ControlNet, fine-tuning, or other methods for maintaining consistency in AI-generated content.
  • Experience with creative automation and dynamic video templating.
  • Advanced Figma knowledge.
  • 3D or virtual production experience with tools such as Blender, Cinema 4D, or Unreal Engine.
  • Understanding of AI content provenance, licensing, synthetic likeness, and brand-safety considerations.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality video output that combines strong creative craft with effective use of Gen AI.
  • Scalable workflows that significantly increase video production capacity.
  • Consistent, brand-safe, and technically compliant video across platforms and markets.
  • Creative decisions informed by performance data and audience behaviour.
  • Reusable systems and workflows that can be adopted by other members of the creative team.
  • A higher standard of Gen AI video production across the Creative Capability.

Why Incubeta?

You will join a global, collaborative and entrepreneurial environment where you can have a direct impact on how media is delivered across the Americas.

This is an opportunity to shape the standards, processes and operating model behind a growing media execution function, while working alongside senior media leadership and a global media capability team.

Important: A portfolio or showreel containing demonstrable Gen AI video work is mandatory. Candidates without relevant Gen AI video examples will not be considered.

Mach aus vielen Release Schritten einen verlässlichen Ablauf


Als Product Operations Specialist – Release & Delivery (m/w/d) übernimmst du die zentrale Koordination unserer Software Releases und damit einen Bereich, der bisher auf verschiedene Rollen verteilt ist. Du verbindest technische Themen mit klarem Prozessdenken, verbesserst bestehende Abläufe und arbeitest dabei überwiegend mit internen Stakeholdern sowie punktuell mit unseren Kund:innen.

Was du bewirkst

  • Koordinierst gemeinsam mit den Product Ownern Inhalte und Umfang unserer Softwareversionen
  • Steuerst Release Termine und die notwendigen Schritte bis zur Veröffentlichung
  • Behältst Abhängigkeiten im Blick und bringst die beteiligten Stakeholder zusammen
  • Prüfst bestehende Releaseprozesse und machst sie einfacher und verlässlicher
  • Identifizierst Möglichkeiten, wiederkehrende Abläufe sinnvoll zu automatisieren
  • Begleitest Betaphasen hauptsächlich mit unseren Pilotkund:innen
  • Nimmst Kundenfeedback auf und bringst relevante Erkenntnisse an die richtigen internen Stellen
  • Unterstützt die koordinierte Auslieferung unserer On Premise Lösungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Verstehst operative und bereichsübergreifende Prozesse und kannst sie strukturiert koordinieren
  • Kannst relevante Kennzahlen rund um Releases und Softwareversionen entwickeln, kontinuierlich erheben und auswerten
  • Bringst eine hohe technische Affinität mit, idealerweise aus einem Softwareumfeld
  • Hast bereits mit einem Ticketing System gearbeitet
  • Kannst Software Releases und mehrere Stakeholder gleichzeitig koordinieren
  • Kommunizierst sicher und professionell mit Kund:innen

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Kennst den Pflegebereich, den Pflegesoftwaremarkt oder Produkte von MEDIFOX DAN
  • Hast bereits Beta oder Pilotkund:innen bei Software Releases begleitet
  • Kennst Jira, Confluence oder vergleichbare Tools

Das zeichnet dich aus

  • Eigenverantwortung Du übernimmst Themen, bringst Struktur hinein und hältst sie zuverlässig zusammen
  • Kommunikationsstärke Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und sorgst dafür, dass alle Beteiligten wissen, wo sie stehen
  • Verbesserungswille Du akzeptierst Prozesse nicht einfach, sondern erkennst, wo sie einfacher oder effizienter werden können
  • Sicheres Auftreten Du fühlst dich sowohl im internen Austausch als auch im Kontakt mit Kund:innen wohl

Unsere Benefits für dich

  • Du entscheidest: Hansefit, EGYM Wellpass, Kinderbetreuung oder JobRad – wir unterstützen Dich flexibel mit einem Zuschuss von bis zu 60 € monatlich. Zusätzlich profitierst Du von exklusiven Vergünstigungen mit Corporate Benefits
  • Du kannst auf uns zählen – TELUS Health stärkt Dich mit individuellen Angeboten für Deine mentale Gesundheit
  • Wir gestalten Deine Entwicklung – mit LinkedIn Learning hast Du Zugriff auf inspirierende Lerninhalte und praxisnahe Weiterbildung, die Dich wirklich voranbringen
  • Wir denken an Deine Zukunft – mit unserem Aktienkaufprogramm kannst Du direkt am Unternehmenserfolg teilhaben, und durch unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) sicherst Du Dir finanzielle Stabilität für die Zukunft
  • Du hast 30 Tage Urlaubsanspruch, um ausreichend Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Interessen zu haben

MEDIFOX DAN Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Hildesheim gehört zur Resmed Corp. und beschäftigt über 900 Mitarbeitende an neun Standorten. Wir setzen auf Teamgeist, Kundenorientierung und Leidenschaft und arbeiten an zukunftsweisenden Softwarelösungen im Gesundheits- und Sozialwesen, um Innovationen voranzutreiben. Seit über 30 Jahren revolutionieren wir die Pflegebranche und suchen Menschen, die eine Leidenschaft für Technik in einer starken Unternehmenskultur teilen.

raw.description:
Position:Seasonal Global Navigator Scholarship Evaluator- Temp

Reports to:Associate Manager, Sales Operations

Department:Global Navigator Programs, High School Summer Study Abroad

Location:US Remote

Who we are:

CIEE is a nonprofit study abroad and intercultural exchange organization that transforms lives and builds bridges between individuals and nations through study abroad and international exchange experiences that help people develop skills for living in a globally interdependent and multi-cultural world.

Why work with us:

  • You will change the world. CIEE builds bridges between people, countries, and cultures. We help young people participate in high-quality international exchange and study abroad programs that bring the world together. We change lives, our alumni change the world. Be part of the change!
  • You will be part of a fast-paced, international, and collaborative team of professionals. CIEE operates the largest nonprofit network of study abroad locations, with facilities and staff in over 30 countries. Additionally, we help international participants from over 140 countries come to the USA each year. Committed to excellence and solving whatever problem the world throws at them, CIEE professionals work on international teams, and are dedicated to advancing our almost 80-year-old mission to make the world a more peaceful place.

Who you are:

The Seasonal Global Navigator Scholarship Evaluator will support the review and evaluation of Global Navigator Scholarship applications during the scholarship review season. This role is responsible for objectively assessing applications, financial documentation, and supporting materials using established rubrics, eligibility criteria, and standard operating procedures. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable completing high-volume, repetitive work while maintaining accuracy, consistency, confidentiality, and established deadlines.

What you’ll do:

  • Review and score a high volume (approximately 1000-2000) of Global Navigator Scholarship applications using established rubrics, criteria, and standard operating procedures.
  • Evaluate application components, including written responses, student information, and financial documentation, and assign scores according to established guidelines.
  • Review and audit financial documentation to identify missing information, discrepancies, or items requiring additional review.
  • Accurately record scores, review outcomes, and required information in designated systems and tracking tools.
  • Maintain consistent, objective scoring across applications and meet established productivity, accuracy, and review deadlines.
  • Participate in required training and calibration activities and apply feedback to improve scoring consistency and accuracy.
  • Escalate questions, documentation concerns, and situations not addressed by established procedures to the appropriate team member.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality when handling student, family, academic, financial, and scholarship information.
  • Depending on workload, skills, and availability, assist with additional administrative or operational projects within the High School Study Abroad team.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What you’ll bring

  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong reading comprehension.
  • Ability to objectively apply established rubrics, criteria, and procedures without allowing personal opinions to influence evaluations.
  • Strong critical-thinking and analytical skills, including the ability to identify discrepancies, missing information, and documentation that does not meet established requirements.
  • Ability to maintain accuracy and focus while performing repetitive, high-volume work.
  • Strong organization and time-management skills, with the ability to independently manage workload and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to receive and apply feedback related to accuracy, quality, and scoring consistency.
  • Strong written communication skills and ability to clearly document questions or concerns.
  • Comfort working with written, numerical, and financial information.
  • Basic technical aptitude and ability to learn online application systems, databases, spreadsheets, and other technology-based tools.
  • Basic Microsoft Excel skills preferred.
  • Previous experience in application review, assessment, grading, auditing, quality assurance, education, administration, financial aid, or related work preferred but not required.
  • Experience reviewing scholarship, admissions, academic, grant, or similar applications is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a remote environment.
  • Professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Availability to work full or part-time during the designated scholarship review period.

Schedule & Hours:

This is a full-time, hourly position offering up to 40 hours per week. The standard schedule is Monday–Thursday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM, with flexibility on Fridays to choose either a 9:00 AM–5:00 PM or 12:00 PM–8:00 PM shift. All shifts are based on your local time zone. Each daily shift includes a 30-minute unpaid, uninterrupted break, resulting in a consistent 37.5 paid hours per week, with a hard cap of 40 hours. Employees will not be scheduled to work on CIEE-observed holidays.

CIEE believes that professionals with varied backgrounds bring unique approaches and ideas to solving problems and advancing our mission to bring the world together. Qualified candidates from underrepresented groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

Due to federal regulations and CIEE policies, a background check, and education and employment verification will be conducted as conditions of employment.

You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. Job brief

Join Elite Escapes and turn your passion for travel into your next career.

As a Work from Home Travel Specialist (Sales-Focused), you'll turn travel dreams into booked itineraries by pairing destination expertise with a consultative, client-first sales approach. You'll design custom trips while guiding clients from their first what if? to a confirmed reservation — whether it's a solo escape, a group getaway, a destination wedding, or a family travel experience.

What You'll Do

  • Craft personalized travel plans: flights, stays, tours, cruises, and packages built around each client's budget, style, and must-haves.
  • Connect with clients to uncover their ideal trip, present tailored options, and confidently close the sale.
  • Resolve questions and concerns promptly and professionally (payments, date changes, room upgrades, add-ons, etc.).
  • Add value with insider knowledge: hidden gems, top photo spots, local experiences, and timely deals that make each trip special.
  • Stay with clients from start to finish — pre-trip planning and payment coordination, on-trip support, and post-trip follow-ups and reviews.

What You Bring

  • Strong communication and people skills; comfortable leading conversations, handling objections, and guiding clients to a decision.
  • Ability to juggle multiple quotes, itineraries, and bookings without dropping details.
  • Fast learner when it comes to new tools — CRMs, booking engines, analytics dashboards, and collaboration platforms.
  • Background in sales, customer service, hospitality, or travel is a bonus, but not required — we provide full training.
  • Genuine love for travel and helping others explore with confidence

What You Get

  • Fully remote role part time or full time from home
  • Comprehensive onboarding and ongoing coaching on products, suppliers, and sales-driven planning techniques.
  • A collaborative, supportive team culture.
  • Room to grow and specialize

This role moves quickly, but if you're the person who keeps itineraries, bookings, group trips, and collaborations running smoothly — turning conversations into confirmed trips and memorable experiences — you'll thrive here.

Leidos is seeking a motivated Junior Network Vulnerability Remediation Engineer to support the Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) program.

This is an exciting opportunity to build your network engineering and cybersecurity skills while helping protect and modernize the Army's global enterprise network.

In this remote role, you'll focus on identifying, analyzing, and remediating security vulnerabilities across enterprise network devices. You'll work alongside experienced network engineers and cybersecurity professionals to implement security patches, configuration updates, and risk mitigation solutions.

We're looking for someone with hands-on networking experience, knowledge of network security practices, and the ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.


What You'll Do

  • Identify, analyze, and help remediate security vulnerabilities affecting enterprise network devices.
  • Review vulnerability findings, vendor security advisories, patches, and recommended fixes.
  • Develop, test, and implement network security patches, configuration updates, and mitigation solutions.
  • Execute approved network changes through established ASI and change-management processes.
  • Perform network device upgrades, patching, configuration management, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Troubleshoot network connectivity, performance, and security issues.
  • Support DoD security requirements, including STIG implementation and network hardening.
  • Work with Information Assurance teams and the AGUN Cybersecurity Service Provider (CSSP) to address security risks.
  • Support vulnerability assessments, remediation planning, and corrective actions.
  • Develop patch/upgrade analyses, mitigation configurations, test results, and production release plans.
  • Document remediation activities, configuration changes, implementation results, and ticket closure evidence.
  • Maintain network diagrams, configuration records, and technical procedures.
  • Work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating with senior engineers on complex technical issues.

What We're Looking For

  • Active DoD Secret security clearance and U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Network Engineering, or a related field with 2–4 years of relevant experience, or approximately 3 years of relevant experience without a degree.
  • DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (such as Security+) and an approved Computing Environment (CE) certification.
  • Hands-on experience with network device patching, upgrades, configuration management, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Knowledge of LAN/WAN, BGP, TCP/UDP, IPSec, VPNs, Layer 2/Layer 3 routing, and firewalls.
  • Experience with at least one network management tool, such as:
    • Palo Alto Panorama
    • Cisco Prime
    • Cisco DNA
    • Junos Space
  • Hands-on experience with at least two of the following:
    • Cisco
    • Juniper
    • Palo Alto
    • Dell Networking
    • Remote Access VPN (RAVPN)
    • GlobalProtect
    • AppGate
  • Experience supporting DoD STIGs and network security hardening.
  • Familiarity with SFTP, SSH, SCP, MPLS, SNMP, and NTP.
  • Ability to troubleshoot network issues independently or with senior engineering support.
  • Strong communication, teamwork, and technical documentation skills.
  • Flexibility to work nonstandard shifts when needed.
  • Willingness to travel up to 10%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting U.S. Army, DISA, or other DoD enterprise networks.
  • CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent networking certification.
  • Experience with network migrations, modernization, or infrastructure transformation.
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco SD-WAN.
  • Experience with Palo Alto Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW).
  • Familiarity with virtualized network infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of Git, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet.
  • Basic Python scripting experience for network automation.
  • Experience supporting geographically dispersed enterprise networks.
  • Familiarity with DoD cybersecurity standards and compliance requirements.
  • Experience creating network diagrams, configuration records, and technical documentation.

Why Join Leidos?

At Leidos, you'll have the opportunity to develop your network engineering and cybersecurity expertise while supporting a mission that directly impacts the U.S. Army's global operations.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers, gain exposure to enterprise networking technologies, and contribute to securing critical military infrastructure.

If you're a cleared Network Engineer with hands-on patching, vulnerability remediation, and network security experience who wants to grow your skills, we'd like to hear from you!

Join Leidos and help secure the Army's global network. Apply today!

About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

CoLab is hiring a highly motivated VP of Enterprise Sales to scale our enterprise sales team and the process behind it during a critical phase of growth. You will report to our SVP of Sales and lead enterprise teams, whose Account Executives sell deals from $25K to $500K and upwards of $1M to Fortune 500 manufacturers in automotive, industrial, heavy machinery, medical device and consumer products.

CoLab sells into engineering and design teams, not just procurement or supply chain. These are complex, multi-stakeholder deals with long cycles and no pre-existing budget line, so this person needs to be a strong closer and a stronger coach.

What you'll do

You will own enterprise new-logo and expansion revenue and build the repeatable system that lets the team scale.

  • Lead and coach enterprise teams. Run a weekly coaching cadence, review deals in depth, and sit in on key calls to raise how reps run complex, multi-threaded cycles.
  • Recruit, develop, and retain top talent. Provide effective coaching, career development, and performance management, and set clear expectations and scorecards.
  • Own the number. Set quotas and territories, drive pipeline coverage, and deliver an accurate forecast to the SVP of Sales.
  • Inspect and refine the sales process. Dive into the pipeline, drive daily improvements, and enforce consistent stage criteria, mutual action plans, and deal reviews using a methodology such as MEDDPICC.
  • Be a hands-on player/coach. Lead by example: jump on intro calls, step into enterprise negotiations, and help close the largest accounts.
  • Expand within existing customers. Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities to grow business with the current client base.
  • Sell value to engineering buyers. Help reps build business cases around design error cost, review cycle time, and quality, and engage engineering leaders and executive sponsors.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally. Work with BDRs and Marketing on pipeline and account targeting, and Customer Engineering and Product on technical selling.
  • Report with accuracy. Use Salesforce (and other tools) to report sales performance, pipeline movement, and forecasts to the senior leadership team.
  • Share market feedback and experiment. Monitor customer, market, and competitor activity, feed insights to internal partners, and test new sales strategies to improve ARR and sales efficiency.

What you'll bring

  • 10+ years of B2B SaaS sales, including 4+ years leading enterprise sales teams (Director or VP level), ideally with experience multiple teams and managers ( frontline managers to Director).
  • A track record of closing six-figure deals, ideally $500K+ and up to $1M, with multiple stakeholders and long sales cycles.
  • Experience selling into technical buyers and complex organizations, using consultative methods in undefined product categories where educating the buyer and creating budget is essential.
  • Experience scaling a sales organization through a high-growth phase and building process that outlasts you.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to build trust quickly with skeptical C-suite and VP-level stakeholders.
  • A disciplined forecaster with a working command of Salesforce and a formal methodology (MEDDPICC, Challenger, or similar), and the judgment to adapt it.
  • A coach first: you can step into an existing team of experienced reps and earn credibility by improving how they sell, including in remote or hybrid environments.
  • A builder’s mindset: you see what’s missing, create it, and don't wait for a playbook or permission.
  • No ego, high drive, and a fast learner who seeks feedback and works well cross-functionally. Values of Kindness & Respect, One Team One Mission, and Better Everyday come naturally.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling into manufacturing, aerospace and defense, automotive, or industrial customers, and comfort with engineering buyers (CAD, PLM, design review).
  • Experience selling AI, engineering software, or design-collaboration tools.
  • Experience selling a mix of SaaS, services, and hardware.
  • Prior experience inheriting an established team, not only building one from scratch.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gong, and a modern sales-tech stack.

Why CoLab and the details

This is a chance to lead the enterprise sales team at a company already selling complex deals to Fortune 500 manufacturers, at a critical phase of growth. You will shape the team, the process, and how CoLab sells to engineering organizations.

We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don’t meet every single qualification—your potential is what matters most to us.

raw.description:
About WRS Health

WRS Health builds an Electronic Health Records (EHR) system that medical practices rely on every day to care for patients. Our platform runs on Linux servers in AWS with a PHP application stack, and it holds some of the most sensitive data there is: protected health information.
We are now investing heavily in AI agents that work alongside clinicians and staff. That shift opens new ground for our product and new attack surfaces for our security program. We are hiring a Security Engineer to help us protect both.

The role

As our Security Engineer, you will find and fix security risks before attackers do, across our AWS infrastructure, our PHP application, and our growing fleet of AI agents. You will look ahead to emerging threats, especially those unique to LLMs and autonomous agents, and build defenses before they are needed.
This is a hands-on, collaborative role. You will work directly with our development and AI teams, helping them understand issues, prioritize fixes, and ship secure code. We want someone who teaches and enables, not someone who only files tickets.

What you'll do

Application security
  • Review PHP code and architecture for vulnerabilities such as injection, broken authentication, insecure deserialization, and access-control flaws.
  • Run and tune SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning (e.g., Composer packages) in our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Lead threat modeling for new features and work with developers to fix findings, with clear guidance and secure code examples.
Cloud and infrastructure security
  • Harden our AWS environment: IAM least privilege, network segmentation, encryption at rest and in transit, and secrets management.
  • Monitor and respond to findings from tools such as GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, and AWS Config.
  • Secure and patch Linux servers, and define hardened baselines for new infrastructure.
AI and agent security
  • Assess AI agents for risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, excessive permissions, insecure tool use, and model supply-chain issues.
  • Define guardrails for what agents can access and do, especially where PHI is involved, including logging, human-in-the-loop controls, and output validation.
  • Partner with the AI team to build security into agent design from the start, using frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
Threat management and response
  • Track emerging threats to healthcare, cloud, and AI systems, and turn that intelligence into concrete defenses.
  • Coordinate penetration tests and vulnerability management, from discovery through verified fix.
  • Help build and run our incident response plan, including tabletop exercises.
Compliance and culture
  • Support HIPAA and HITECH compliance.
  • Run secure-coding training and build security awareness across engineering.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years in security engineering, application security, or a closely related role.
  • Hands-on experience securing AWS environments, including IAM, VPC design, KMS, and AWS security services.
  • Strong Linux administration and hardening skills.
  • Experience with vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and driving findings to resolution.
  • Working knowledge of LLM and AI agent risks, such as prompt injection, data exfiltration through tools, and over-permissioned agents.
  • Scripting or automation skills in Python, Bash, or similar.
  • Clear communication, and the ability to explain risk to developers and leadership in practical terms.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA or other regulated-data environments.

Nice to have

  • Experience in healthcare IT or with EHR systems and standards such as HL7 or FHIR.
  • Prior work securing AI agents, RAG pipelines, or LLM integrations in production.
  • Infrastructure-as-code security (Terraform or CloudFormation) and container security.

What success looks like in your first year

  1. First 90 days: You have assessed our AWS, Linux, and PHP environments and our AI agent designs, and you have a prioritized risk roadmap.
  2. By six months: Automated security scanning runs in every pipeline, and developers fix critical findings quickly with your guidance.
  3. By one year: Every new AI agent passes a security review before launch, our incident response plan has been tested, and security is part of how engineering works day to day.

Details and how to apply

  • Location: Remote
  • Employment type: Full-time - Independent Contractor
  • Reports to: CTO
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


AI Forward Deployed Engineer

LOCATION

US or Canada - Remote

U.S. LOCATIONSMAY INCLUDE

Indianapolis, IN; Arizona; Colorado; Michigan; North Carolina; Ohio; Texas; Virginia

Role Overview

The AI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is the technical owner for strategic customer AI engagements, responsible for turning high-value business problems into working, production-ready AI solutions. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, AI engineering, solution architecture, and hands-on delivery. The FDE works directly with customer business and technical teams to identify the right problem, rapidly build and validate a solution, deploy it into real operating environments, and continuously optimize it against measurable business outcomes.

This is a builder role. Success requires equal comfort with executive discovery, architecture whiteboarding, writing and debugging code, integrating enterprise systems and data, evaluating agent behavior, and resolving blockers with Product and Engineering. The FDE maintains end-to-end accountability from discovery through production and converts lessons from each engagement into reusable assets that accelerate the next customer.

Key Responsibilities

· Own customer outcomes end to end. Partner with customer business and technical leaders to identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases, define measurable success criteria, and own the technical outcome from discovery through prototype, live test, production, and optimization.

· Build hands-on. Rapidly prototype, code, configure, integrate, test, and deploy AI solutions using customer systems, APIs, data, workflows, and cloud services.

· Engineer agentic AI systems. Design and optimize agent behavior, prompts, context, tool invocation, orchestration, grounding, retrieval, memory, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns.

· Connect AI to the enterprise. Develop secure integrations across APIs, webhooks, enterprise applications, data platforms, identity systems, and legacy environments so AI agents can act reliably within real business workflows.

· Validate with engineering rigor. Build evaluation and observability approaches that test accuracy, safety, latency, reliability, and business outcomes; diagnose failures and edge cases and iterate rapidly.

· Move prototypes into production. Apply sound software engineering, security, governance, CI/CD, version control, monitoring, and operational practices to deliver maintainable production solutions.

Job brief

Join Elite Escapes and turn your passion for travel into your next career.

As a Remote Group Travel Planner (Sales-Focused), you'll help groups turn we should all go somewhere together into a confirmed trip that everyone is excited about. You'll combine destination knowledge, group logistics, and a consultative sales approach to match teams, companies, families, and friend groups with the right destination, accommodations, activities, and travel experience—whether it's a sports team tournament, corporate retreat, incentive trip, family reunion, milestone celebration, or friends' getaway.

What You'll Do

  • Connect with group leaders to understand trip goals, group size, budget, preferred dates, destination ideas, and must-have experiences.
  • Recommend destinations, hotels or resorts, room blocks, transportation options, meeting spaces, team-building activities, and group excursions that fit the group's purpose and budget.
  • Turn group inquiries into confirmed trips through email, chat, and phone with energy, accuracy, and a client-first approach.
  • Explain group travel details clearly, including deposit structures, payment schedules, cancellation policies, rooming lists, name changes, and travel requirements.
  • Coordinate group logistics: room allocations, special requests, group rates, contracts, deposits, final payments, and pre-trip communication.
  • Handle changes, questions, and concerns quickly and professionally so group leaders and participants feel supported from first quote through return home.
  • Share valuable insights on destinations, group-friendly resorts, team activities, corporate meeting facilities, family experiences, and seasonal opportunities.
  • Build post-booking relationships that encourage repeat group trips, referrals, testimonials, and long-term partnerships.

Nice to Have

  • Interest in group travel, sports travel, corporate meetings and incentives, family reunions, or destination celebrations.
  • Travel-industry, sales, hospitality, event planning, customer-service, or booking experience is preferred—but not required. Zero experience is welcome.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to guide group leaders toward decisions.
  • Strong organization skills and comfort managing multiple group quotes, rooming lists, contracts, follow-ups, and client details.
  • Comfort with technology, online booking platforms, CRM systems, and AI tools—we will train you on the rest.
  • A genuine passion for bringing people together through travel and creating memorable shared experiences.

What You Get

  • Fully remote work with the flexibility to build your schedule around your life.
  • Comprehensive onboarding and training on group travel, supplier platforms, negotiation and sales conversations, and travel planning.
  • A collaborative, supportive team atmosphere with colleagues who want to see you succeed.
  • The opportunity to grow into specialties such as sports team travel, corporate meetings and incentives, family reunions, milestone celebrations, or luxury group getaways.
  • Clear paths toward leadership and higher earning potential.

Group travel has many moving parts—but if you enjoy coordinating room blocks, planning team activities, designing corporate retreats, and bringing families and friends together in amazing destinations, you will thrive here. Your work will transform group ideas into confirmed itineraries and shared travel memories that last long after the trip ends.

Apply today—we look forward to welcoming you to the team.

Who are we?

TripledotStudios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: Lion Studios

Lion Studios is a mobile games publisher that works with mobile developers to get their games discovered by players around the world. Headquartered in San Francisco, Lion Studios’ creative and strategy teams utilize their expertise to help game developers break through the noise and grow their businesses.

Since launching in 2018, Lion Studios has driven 90% of its games to the Top 10 in the App Store and Google Play and helped drive 16 games to #1 in the US App Store’s Top Free chart.

Role Overview

As our SeniorAd Monetisation Analyst, you’ll take ownership of the ad monetisation strategy for a diverse portfolio of games, guiding them from their initial prototype phase all the way to a full launch. Your responsibilities will include building and optimizing ad waterfalls, managing all ad monetisation setups, and conducting A/B tests to continuously improve performance. You will be expected to consistently generate and test new ideas for monetisation innovations.

A key part of the role is to foster strong relationships with external partners to secure the best deals and ensure robust business relations. Internally, you will work closely with the product and growth teams to ensure a cohesive strategy and maximize ad revenue across the portfolio..

Key Responsibilities

  • Own ad monetisation strategy for a portfolio of games: build, optimize, and manage monetisation setups to maximize revenue across Lion Studios.
  • Design and execute monetisation-related product decisions.
  • Lead integration, testing, and rollout of new monetisation partners.
  • Manage relationships with ad providers.
  • Propose and drive new monetization initiatives, partnering with engineering to scope and build the solutions behind them
  • Track eCPM, fill rate, ARPDAU, and other core KPIs, and report performance and insights to Product, UA, and leadership
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for ad network — technical troubleshooting, escalations, and holding partners accountable to commitments
  • Comfort designing and reading A/B tests with statistical rigor
  • Collaborate with Product, QA, and User Acquisition teams to share insights, enhance workflows, and drive efficiency

Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • More than 3 years of experience in ad monetisation in gaming.
  • Hands-on experience with MAX mediation platform.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to new tools, dashboards, or analytical frameworks.
  • Self-sufficient, autonomous, and able to juggle multiple projects in a fast-changing environment.
  • Knowledge of Looker for analytics and reporting is a plus
