Please read "How to apply". Incomplete applications will not be considered.

We are on a mission to help improve access to high-quality, affordable child care and we are looking for an SEO Manager / Technical SEO specialist / Growth marketer to help us accelerate our organic user acquisition! This is an amazing opportunity to make a real impact on our company, but also on our customers: families, and children’s early education. You will be responsible for optimizing website architecture and implementing technical strategies to improve our site performance and search engine rankings.

We operate in a highly autonomous environment, and you’ll be the first SEO hire, so this channel is yours to own and grow (there’s room for career growth, by hiring other SEO team members: link building outreach specialists, content writers and more!) You’ll be responsible for everything SEO-related: Site Audit & Analysis, Keyword Analysis, Content, Link Building, Website Architecture (XML sitemap, robots.txt files, canonical tags), Technical Troubleshooting and On-page Optimization (Page load speeds, Schema markup, Tags, Featured Snippets, etc.)

What you’ll be doing

You must be comfortable getting your hands dirty and doing everything (at least initially, until we hire other SEO team members that you can delegate work to):

• Site audit: conduct thorough technical SEO audits of our website to provide recommendations for optimization.
• Analytics: monitor and analyze website traffic, keyword rankings, and other metrics to identify opportunities.
• Reporting: provide regular, clear, and detailed reporting on important metrics and performance.
• Keyword research: identify valuable search terms to grow our user acquisition and traffic.
• Technical SEO & On-page Optimization: optimizing website structure, improving speed and mobile friendliness.
• Content Strategy: develop content strategy to rank for valuable search terms, and collaborate with content team.
• Technical Troubleshooting: find and fix all errors (duplicate content, crawling & indexing errors, etc.
• SEO Tools Management: be responsible for Google Search Console, Google Analytics GA4, SEMrush.
• Link Building: develop and implement strategy to acquire backlinks to increase website authority.
• Work closely with our engineering & web development team to implement technical SEO changes.
• Create and maintain technical SEO documentation and guidelines for internal team.
• Stay up to date with the latest trends and best practices in technical SEO and search engine algorithms.

  • 5+ years of direct experience working in SEO (we’ll consider less, if you can show you’re amazing!)
    • Strong knowledge of HTML, CCS, JavaScript.
    • Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, Google Analytics GA4, SEMrush.
    • Deep understanding of search engine algorithms to determine what governs crawlers’ behavior and page ranking.
    • Strong knowledge of site architecture, schema markup, URL structure, redirect management.
    • Expertise in troubleshooting and debugging SEO issues, as well as optimizing site speed and performance.
    • Strong communication skills to collaborate with developers, content creators, and marketers.
    • Data-driven, analytical mindset and excellent attention to detail.
    • Owner mentality: you are self-motivated, use data to evaluate success and deliver results working independently.

Compensation/Benefits
We’re a small team with a big mission to help improve access to safe, affordable, quality child care and early education. You’ll work in a collaborative setting, directly with the executive team. Benefits include competitive pay and a flexible environment, fully remote. We’re looking for long-term team members and if you contribute to the team & company, you’ll have plenty of room for growth!

How to apply?
Incomplete applications will not be considered. Send an email to jobs @ carelulu.com with the email subject: "Your Next SEO Specialist (Your Name)". In your email, include your resume in PDF, and explain:
1) how you heard about us and why you want to join CareLuLu instead of another company.
2) why you will be awesome in this role and why we absolutely need YOU over everybody else.
3) include links to ALL your profiles (LinkedIn, Facebook, and if available: Upwork, X).
4) answer this question (using personal experience!): Explain how you have used structured data to enhance search engine visibility and user experience. Provide a specific example.

Looking forward to hearing from you :)

CareLuLu is on a mission to help improve access to safe, affordable, quality child care and early education. We help parents find the right child care or preschool program, by providing all the information in one place (photos, program information, cost, verified reviews, etc.) CareLuLu also helps child care programs grow their business while saving time for what truly matters: children!

raw.description:
Description

SUMMARY

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​The Senior Clinical Data Manager will lead and manage multiple clinical studies, ensuring that data are collected, managed and reported clearly, accurately and securely. In addition, this position is required to conduct all these activities in conformance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry guidelines, and Innovaderm standard operating procedures (SOPs) while respecting Indero’s commitment to sponsor’s requirements and timelines

.

RESPONSIBILITIES

More specifically, the Senior Clinical Data Manager must:

· Adhere and promote company organizational values and related expected behaviors, follow company SOPs and processes for all deliverables, and ensure all trainings assigned to oneself are completed on time.

  • Be the data management liaison to the project team, sponsor and external vendors, as needed.
  • Be able to manage three to four concurrent studies independently, with minimal supervision.
  • Be able to take decision with minimal support from manager.
  • Attend meeting with sponsor and answers Data Management related question.
  • Provides input for timelines and monitor scope of work to ensure timely and within budget completion of assigned tasks.
  • Be responsible for the development of electronic case report form (eCRF) specifications (including data capture screens and edit check specifications) needed to build a study-specific clinical database/electronic data capture (EDC) system.
  • Be responsible for or assist in the programming and ongoing maintenance of the clinical database.
  • Be responsible for the validation and testing of the clinical database (e.g. User Acceptance Testing).
  • Be responsible for the development of eCRF completion guidelines and other training material required to train site users and monitors.
  • Conduct training for site users/monitors on the clinical database.

· Develop data transfer agreements and specifications with vendors providing external data (e.g. laboratory results).

  • Conduct reconciliation between external data and data in the EDC system to ensure consistency, including reconciliation with sponsor safety databases for adverse events/serious adverse events data (if needed).
  • Provide support to study team in the development of external systems capturing clinical data, e.g. ePRO or IWRS, and ensuring that any data transfer requirements between these systems and EDC are documented and tested appropriately.
  • Be responsible for the development of the data management plan (DMP), and other clinical data management related documentation.
  • Be responsible for ongoing data review/cleaning during study conduct and also during preparation for database lock/close.
  • Code medical terms in the clinical database, as required.
  • Generates data listings and reports needed for data review by the project manager (or other study team members) in preparation for database close/lock.
  • Monitor study status (e.g. enrollment, CRFs monitored/approved, etc.) on an ongoing basis and provides data status reports to the project team, as needed.
  • Ensure that data management documentation is complete and up-to-date in the trial master file (TMF).
  • Respond to users requiring assistance with the EDC system.
  • Be responsible for archiving of the clinical database and related documents.
  • Participate in the definition, writing and updating of data management Work Instructions
  • Mentor and train Clinical Data Coordinators, as needed.
  • Provide basic support to less experienced Clinical Data Managers, as needed.

· For any studies where any of the above activities have been outsourced to an external service provider:

    • Oversee/manage the vendor to ensure that timelines and deliverables meet with sponsor and protocol requirements;
    • Ensure that their work is done in accordance with effective work orders and Innovaderm SOPs (if applicable).

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

· B.Sc. or in a related field of study.

· M. Sc. or in a related field of study is an asset;

· 5 to 8 years of clinical data management experience in clinical research in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or contractual research organization (CRO) industry.

· Understanding of the drug development process and of applicable regulations, including Good Clinical Practices, ICH Guidelines.

· Extensive experience working with EDC systems, and/or database structures.

· Demonstrated skills in database programming an asset.

· Good understanding of CDISC SDTM/CDASH standards;

· Highly organized and detail-oriented with effective project planning and time management skills.

· Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, French an asset.

· Good knowledge of MS Excel.

· Knowledge of SAS or similar, an asset;

· Excellent problem solving abilities;

· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated agility to organize and prioritize multiple competing demands.

· Knowledge of MedDRA and WHODrug dictionaries.

· Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability, and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Flexible schedule
  • Vacation
  • Home-based position
  • Ongoing learning and development

About Indero

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

raw.description:
Position Overview

Providing quality training since 1996, Rhodes Wellness College is recognized as a leader in counselling, wellness, and coaching education.

We offer a warm and vibrant environment with a team committed to their own growth and wellness, as well as that of our students. Our students are diverse, curious, and engaged with their learning.

This is not your typical educational institution. We use an experiential learning model that emphasizes active participation. Through practice, reflection, demonstration, discussion, and real-world application, students develop new skills, attitudes, and approaches to working with clients.

If you are an experienced counsellor and passionate educator looking for a dynamic and meaningful teaching environment, you could be a great fit for our faculty.

The Opportunity

We are seeking experienced, qualified counsellors who are strong facilitators and educators to join our faculty as Clinical Supervisors for students entering the final two semesters of our Counselling Diploma Program.

Clinical Supervision plays an important role in helping students transition from classroom learning into professional counselling practice. As a Clinical Supervisor, you will support students in developing their clinical skills, applying counselling theory to practice, engaging in reflective learning, and developing their professional identity and competencies.

We are looking for counsellors who enjoy teaching, facilitating groups, and creating an engaging and supportive learning environment for adult learners.

Position Details

Clinical Supervision is delivered over a 12-week semester, with approximately 48 instructional hours per semester.

  • Schedule: Fridays, 9:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m. Pacific Time (Vancouver time)
  • Duration: 12 weeks per semester
  • Teaching format: Synchronous online instruction via Zoom
  • Blended opportunity: We are also seeking faculty members who are available to teach both online and in person from our Vancouver campus.
  • Course materials: All course materials and instructional resources are provided. No curriculum development is required.

Rhodes Wellness College operates four semesters per year, with teaching opportunities depending on program scheduling and faculty availability.

What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate is an experienced counsellor who is also an engaging educator and facilitator. You bring warmth, professionalism, curiosity, and a collaborative approach to teaching, and you enjoy supporting emerging counsellors as they develop their clinical skills and professional identity.

Ideal Candidate Qualifications & Experience:

  • A Master’s degree in Counselling Psychology or equivalent education.
  • Six years of professional counselling experience following graduation.
  • Current registration or membership with a recognized Canadian counselling organization, such as CPCA, ACCT, BCACC, CRPO, or another recognized professional counselling association.
  • Designated as a clinical supervisor: have completed a recognized qualified supervisor training program or be registered with a recognized professional counselling association as a qualified supervisor.
  • Experience supervising other counsellors
  • Familiar with the Code of Ethics and Standards of Practice of either ACCT or CPCA, or a willingness to become knowledgeable in the applicable standards.
  • Strong clinical experience and a demonstrated commitment to professional counselling practice.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience or familiarity with experiential learning and facilitation.
  • Experience teaching or facilitating online education with adult learners.
  • Post-secondary teaching experience is preferred.
  • A reliable internet connection suitable for synchronous teaching via Zoom.

Specific Duties and Responsibilities

The Clinical Supervisor will:

  • Facilitate clinical supervision sessions that support students in developing their counselling skills, clinical judgment, and professional competence.
  • Support students with their client work through case discussion, clinical guidance, and feedback.
  • Provide direct observation and constructive feedback on students’ counselling practice, where applicable.
  • Review students’ clinical documentation and case conceptualizations, providing feedback to support effective and professional clinical practice.
  • Support students in identifying and addressing clinical, ethical, and professional issues that arise in their counselling practice.
  • Facilitate reflection and discussion that helps students integrate counselling theory, clinical experience, and professional development.
  • Assess and provide feedback on student clinical work and required course assignments, as applicable.
  • Maintain appropriate records of student progress and submit evaluations, marks, and required documentation within established timelines.
  • Comply with Rhodes Wellness College policies, procedures, and guidelines.

Why Teach at Rhodes Wellness College?

At Rhodes, you will be joining a community that values growth, wellness, experiential learning, and meaningful connection. Our faculty bring their professional expertise into a learning environment where students are encouraged to participate actively, explore new perspectives, practice their skills, and develop their confidence as future counsellors.

If you are an experienced counsellor who is passionate about education and enjoys facilitating experiential learning, we invite you to consider joining our faculty.

We look forward to hearing from you. Please send your cover letter and resume to Tova at

Salary: DOE

This role serves as the primary technical authority for all SAP Basis activities across a complex, multi-system SAP landscape spanning on-premises, private, and public cloud environments. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in SAP HANA, SAP BTP, cloud infrastructure (primarily Azure), and system integration — and is equally capable of leading projects independently and collaborating across cross-functional teams.

Cloud & Infrastructure Collaboration

Linux & High Availability

SAP BTP & Integration

Architecture, Documentation & Leadership

.

Preferred Qualifications:

raw.description:
Crisis Analyst, Real-Time Coverage (Remote, Canada)

When a crisis breaks, our analysts are often among the first people in the world to know about it.

samdesk uses AI to detect emergencies around the world as they happen, from shootings and bomb threats to severe weather and conflict, and alerts organizations that need to act fast. As a Crisis Analyst on our Real-Time Coverage (RTC) team, you will be the human in the loop behind our AI-first alerts. You will gather, corroborate and curate social media and open-source information as events unfold.

The alert you send about an active shooter at a shopping mall may prompt a user to tell customers and employees to seek shelter, lock down stores and reroute deliveries. On a busy shift you may assess hundreds of incidents, sometimes with only 10 seconds to decide: do our users need to react to this?

This is a full-time, fully remote role open to candidates anywhere in Canada. Shifts are 8 hours, typically between 10am and 7pm Eastern Time, with one weekend shift a week for roughly one month in every three.

Who We Are

samdesk is a real-time risk detection and situational awareness platform that delivers real-time crisis alerts 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, powered by AI. We make sense of the world’s most valuable real-time data sources with the purpose of creating a safer world. samdesk is proudly headquartered in Alberta, Canada, with team members located all over the world. Check us out: www.samdesk.io

What You’ll Do

Reporting to a Lead Analyst, you will:

  • Assess incoming incidents quickly and decide which ones our users need to know about, using your judgement and our playbooks
  • Gather and corroborate information from social media and open sources in real time, and build out our coverage as a crisis unfolds
  • Make sure every alert we send is accurate, timely and relevant
  • Work alongside analysts around the world on a shared audio call throughout your shift
  • Join a working group on geopolitics, forward planning or climate, and contribute to the resources the team relies on

What You’ll Need

  • A relevant degree (political science, international relations, journalism, etc.) or equivalent experience. This could include work as a security operations centre (SOC) analyst, intelligence analyst, or emergency dispatcher, or as a reporter in breaking news or open-source intelligence (OSINT)
  • A close interest in breaking news and current affairs, and an understanding of how social media is used for newsgathering and fact-finding
  • The ability to track several developing incidents at once and work quickly without losing attention to detail
  • Calm, sound judgement under pressure
  • Confidence working independently and remotely as part of a globally distributed team
  • The right to work full time in Canada

Early in your career? We provide full training, so if you have the interest and instincts, we’d like to hear from you.

Bonus Points if You Have

  • Worked in corporate security, intelligence, a newsroom or an OSINT environment
  • Done your own OSINT or verification work, such as geolocation, student journalism or open-source investigations
  • Proficiency in other languages

Working Hours

This isn’t a typical remote role and may not be for everybody! We ensure continuous coverage of urgent emergencies, so you need to be plugged in and working on our dashboard during your shift. This can mean organized break schedules and set shift times. In exchange, you don’t need to take your work home with you and will rarely be asked to work additional hours.

You will also be part of our weekend rotation. For roughly one month in every three, your working week includes a Saturday or a Sunday (for example, in January and then again in April). You still work a five-day week during those months, such as Sunday to Thursday. Any public holidays worked are given back as time off in lieu.

Support on Shift

It can be high pressure, and some of what you monitor will be distressing. To help you succeed, we provide a friendly, supportive team alongside the tools and training you need. samdesk takes a trauma-informed approach, with wellbeing tools and debriefs on shift, and access to professional support through our company-funded health benefits.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote, from anywhere in Canada
  • A rare way into OSINT and crisis intelligence, with full training and no prior industry experience required
  • Work that matters: your alerts help some of the world’s most notable brands keep their people safe
  • A supportive team you are connected to throughout every shift
  • Predictable hours: your roster is planned a month in advance, with no on-call and no work to take home
  • Company-funded health benefits
  • A salary of 60,000 to 65,000 CAD per annum (commensurate with experience)

A note on using AI to apply

This role will involve working with AI-generated data, but please don’t use AI to apply. The application and interview process is intended to let us learn more about you as an individual and how you make decisions.

Diversity and Inclusion

samdesk is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a safe, diverse and inclusive environment. We encourage qualified applicants of all backgrounds including ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation, family status, age, nationality, and education levels to apply. If you are contacted for an interview and require accommodation during the interviewing process, please let us know.

Salary: CAD 60-65k per annum, (commensurate with experience)

We are seeking a Risk Engineer with strong technical acumen and practical experience in the vulnerability management space to design, prioritize, and enable risk-reducing technical solutions across complex cloud and enterprise environments. As a Cyber Security Engineer, you should have a strong technical background and demonstrate experience in vulnerability management, security architecture, and control engineering. This role emphasizes solution engineering over process engineering—using vulnerability intelligence, risk frameworks, policies, and controls as inputs to architect practical, automatable, and scalable technical safeguards.

Responsibilities include the end-to-end engineering of vulnerability risk solutions, from exposure discovery through remediation workflow design and executive risk reporting, working within mixed-skill teams and in close partnership with platform, cloud, security, and SRE stakeholders. By leveraging deep technical expertise and a risk-informed engineering mindset, you will deliver impactful security solutions that reduce operational, cyber, and resilience risk at scale.

  • Engineer technical vulnerability risk solutions that reduce operational, cyber, and resilience risk through architecture, automation, and control design.
  • Translate vulnerability risk requirements, policies, and standards into implementable technical patterns, guardrails, and reference architectures.
  • Prioritize and influence solution design decisions based on risk impact, blast radius, and recovery dependencies.
  • Partner with platform, cloud, security, and SRE teams to embed risk controls directly into infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Evaluate control effectiveness using technical signals and evidence, not just procedural compliance.
  • Support initiatives such as vulnerability discovery, exposure analysis, remediation workflow design, secure cloud architectures, isolated recovery environments, identity and access hardening, and infrastructure resilience.
  • Provide technical guidance on risk tradeoffs, recovery sequencing, and dependency-aware system design.
  • Work across broad vulnerability management capabilities, including scanners, asset and exposure data sources, prioritization models, remediation tracking platforms, exception workflows, and executive risk reporting.
  • Contribute to lightweight process definition where needed—but always in service of enabling better technical outcomes.

We recognize that no one person will embody every single quality or skill listed below. If you are passionate about cybersecurity and have a strong foundation in vulnerability management and security engineering, we encourage you to apply.

Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Master's Degree in a related field is preferred

Experience:

  • 7+ years in engineering, security engineering, platform engineering, SRE, vulnerability management, or technical risk roles
  • Proven ability to design and influence technical solutions across cross-functional teams
  • Hands-on experience with vulnerability management practices, including discovery, prioritization, remediation coordination, exception handling, and risk reporting
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills, analytical thinking, and the ability to explain complex technical risk concepts to non-technical audiences without losing fidelity
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, operating comfortably between engineering teams and risk stakeholders

Required Technical Experience:

  • Strong understanding of how risk manifests in distributed systems, cloud platforms, and automation environments
  • Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform
  • Configuration management and automation experience using Ansible
  • Programming and scripting proficiency in Python
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, specifically Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and/or Azure
  • Ability to design and implement scalable, automatable security controls and remediation workflows across enterprise technology stacks

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and policy-as-code implementation
  • Knowledge of cloud IAM, networking, and control plane security
  • Experience with backup, recovery, and resilience architectures
  • Familiarity with observability, logging, and evidence automation for control validation
  • Experience with vulnerability scanners, exposure management platforms, and remediation workflow tooling
  • Knowledge of ITIL-based IT Service Management (ITSM) practices

The Opportunity

You’ll lead with sound judgment, drive outcomes, and confidently engage partners at all levels. You will be responsible for managing, growing, and strategically aligning existing accounts to deliver maximum value for both native and our partners.

What you’ll be working on

Strategic Relationship Management

Product Enablement & Advocacy

Conflict Management & Risk Mitigation

raw.description:
The HR Advisor, Career serves as a trusted HR partner to managers and employees, delivering consistent, practical, and employee-focused support throughout the employee lifecycle. Based in Brazil, this role combines hands-on HR operations with advisory responsibilities across employee relations, talent management, compensation and benefits, performance management, and organizational change. The position helps leaders navigate people matters effectively while fostering a positive, inclusive, and high-performing employee experience.

Working closely with local, regional, and global HR teams, the Senior HR Advisor helps translate business priorities and HR programs into effective local practices. The role requires strong knowledge of Brazilian employment practices, including the CLT, and employee data privacy requirements, while also supporting HR activities across other countries where the company operates. The successful candidate will bring sound judgment, discretion, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to balance business needs with fair and consistent people practices.

A Typical Day in the Life Includes:

  • Partner with managers and employees to provide guidance on HR policies, employee relations, workforce needs, team effectiveness, and day-to-day people matters.
  • Manage employee relations concerns, support conflict resolution, and partner with HR leadership and Legal on investigations, disciplinary processes, documentation, and complex cases.
  • Support compliance with Brazilian labor requirements, including the CLT, internal policies, and applicable employee data privacy requirements.
  • Coordinate key employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, employee changes, leaves, transfers, offboarding, payroll inputs, benefits, vacation, and working-time records.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers on recruitment activities.
  • Support performance management, talent reviews, employee development, compensation reviews, job leveling, engagement initiatives, and manager training.
  • Maintain accurate HRIS data, prepare workforce reports, identify trends and opportunities for process improvement, and support employee-data practices aligned with LGPD requirements.
  • Partner with regional and global HR teams to implement organizational changes and HR programs, adapting processes and communications to local business and regulatory requirements.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Progressive HR generalist or HR advisory experience in Brazil, including independent support to managers and employees and experience handling employee relations matters.
  • Practical knowledge of Brazilian employment and labor practices, including the CLT, and employee data privacy requirements.
  • Experience supporting employee lifecycle activities, payroll inputs, benefits administration, performance management, and other core HR processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential matters with discretion, sound judgment, accurate documentation, and appropriate escalation.
  • Communication, stakeholder management, conflict resolution, analytical, and organizational skills, with proficiency using HR information systems, spreadsheets, and workforce reporting.
  • Full professional proficiency in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with local, regional, and global stakeholders.
  • Legal authorization to work permanently in Brazil for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in a multinational, technology, or matrix organization and partnering with regional or global HR teams.
  • Experience supporting organizational change, employee relations, and HR process improvement.
  • Experience with compensation processes, including salary reviews, job leveling, internal equity considerations, and market benchmarking.
  • Working knowledge of HR data-management practices and Brazil's LGPD requirements.
  • Spanish language skills and/or relevant postgraduate education or professional HR certification are a plus.

raw.description:
Our Company

The Kraft Heinz Company is the fifth largest food and beverage company in the world, with eight $1 billion+ brands and global sales of approximately $25 billion. We are a globally trusted producer of delicious foods for 150 years, and we provide high quality, great taste and nutrition for all eating occasions whether at home, in restaurants or on-the-go. The Kraft Heinz Company manufactures and markets food and beverage products in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, Australia and throughout Asia-Pacific. Our products include condiments and sauces, cheese and dairy, meals, meats, refreshment beverages, coffee, and other grocery products, as well as infant and nutrition products.
As one of the world’s largest food and beverage companies, we are proud to spark joy around mealtimes with a global portfolio of more than 200 brands. Our iconic brands include Kraft, Oscar Mayer, Heinz, Philadelphia, Lunchables, Velveeta, Maxwell House, Capri Sun, Kool-Aid, Jell-O, and Classico, among others. We sell products through our own sales organizations and through independent brokers, agents, and distributors to convenience stores, drug stores, value stores, bakeries, pharmacies, mass merchants, club stores, foodservice distributors, and institutions (e.g., hotels, restaurants, hospitals, health care facilities, and certain government agencies) as well as to chain, wholesale, cooperative, and independent grocery accounts.
No matter the brand, we are united under one vision: To Be the Best Food Company, Growing a Better World. Bringing this vision to life are our 39,000+ teammates around the world, making food people love. Together, we help provide meals to those in need through our global partnership and commitment with Rise Against Hunger. And we also stand committed to sustainability, and the health of our planet and its people. Every day, we are transforming the food industry with bold thinking and unprecedented results. If you share our passion -- and are ready to create the future, build on storied legacy, and participate as a conscientious global citizen -- there’s one thing to do: join us.
Our culture of Ownership, Meritocracy and Collaboration
We’re not afraid to think differently. Embrace new ideas. Dream big. We empower our people at every level – from entry intern to senior leader -- to own their work. We believe that we share a responsibility to think like Owners – to be mindful of the collective and sustained success of Kraft Heinz – and we apply this to every situation, every day. As part of Kraft Heinz, you’re supported to grow and achieve. You’re recognized and rewarded for outstanding performance at every level. You’re given opportunity to leave a mark and build a legacy. But you won’t do it alone. You’ll be supported by a thriving group of teammates in over 40 countries around the world, and our collective, collaborative spirit fuels our incredible progress every day.

Position Summary

This role/position ensures effective implementation and execution of the Kraft Heinz Supplier Quality Management System across an assigned ingredient or packaging category. The position provides visible quality leadership ensuring that KHC supplier quality standards are understood and met through on-site assessments as well as desk top audit as determined by the Kraft Heinz supplier management policy. This position also ensures that best practices are replicated across the category. This position requires travel between 50 – 70%.

Role / Title : Supplier Quality Sr. Analyst

  • This role/position ensures effective implementation and execution of the Kraft Heinz Supplier Quality Management System across an assigned ingredient or packaging category. The position provides visible quality leadership ensuring that KHC supplier quality standards are understood and met through on-site assessments as well as desk top audit as determined by the Kraft Heinz supplier management policy. This position also ensures that best practices are replicated across the category. This position requires travel between 50 – 70%.
  • This role is responsible for providing program support and data analysis for the US and Canada supplier quality program. This position requires some quality technical depth and applicant should be comfortable with learning and working with internal systems, technology and reporting. As there is a significant amount of supplier compliance and performance data for ~ 3,000 KHC, the position requires exceptional organizational skills. It is important that the person is detailed oriented to make sure data is accurate in the system. Organization and communication skills are also needed to support the KHC audit strategy and working with external partners.
  • In this role, the individual will evaluate the 2nd party audit reports for the KHC NA suppliers as well as support global compliance reporting, which is a very important KPI to support strategic growth. The individual will work with outside audit companies (examples NSF and DNV) weekly to 2nd party audits are complete and include supplier corrective and preventive actions. In addition, the person will track and trend data for reporting purposes.
  • This person will support plants in achieving Quality KPIs through participation in root cause activities, corrective and preventive action, and customer complaint related to suppliers. This position works closely with cross functional partners (Examples include but not limited to Procurement, specification management, FSM, R&D, Category Quality, Material management, Plant Quality) .
  • Candidate should be comfortable with working with virtual tools to conduct audits if needed.
  • Travel required 50-70%.

Key Components of the role

  • Manage assigned portfolios/Categories of suppliers against KHC Supplier expectation Manual and Supplier management policies
  • Support KHC business teams and factories to address supplier performance concerns or complaints; perform follow-up visits (“tech assessments”), as needed
  • Provide FSQ input into Procurement sourcing strategy and supplier business review meetings
  • Conduct Supplier Quality Audits on behalf of KHC
  • Maintained compliance to FSMA and to KHC Internal Policy
  • Schedule new audits requested by the business
  • Train cross functional partners on Supplier Quality WOW
  • Ensure that audit trackers and data are up to date
  • Become knowledgeable on functional Quality systems (Agile, SAP and Intelex)
  • Maintain communication with suppliers in your portfolio
  • Maintain communication with internal KHC factories and cross functional partners
  • Review 2nd party audit program for NA
  • Prepare monthly tracking documents
  • Support Supplier Verification as it relates to FSMA (regulations FDA and CFIA) where applicable
  • Build organizational capacity and monitor Food Safety events across the supply chain for assigned portfolio
  • Maintain Food Fraud Vulnerability register using software and technology available to the team.
  • Support NA Supplier Quality team to deliver against key KPIs and business objectives to meet overall NA Zone FSQ and organizational deliverables and strategic commitments

Proficiency:

  • HACCP Compliance and Execution; Compliance with KHC and FSMA Requirements
  • Auditing
  • Communication
  • Relationship building
  • Integrity and Trust
  • Organization skills
  • Ability to work autonomously
  • Results driven
Communication:
  • Communicate effectively verbally and in writing by adopting appropriate communication style to Senior Leaders and individuals at all levels of the organization to promote and embed risk monitoring process.
  • Skilled in standing alone and delivering tough messaging (i.e., related to audit observations or supplier performance)
  • Establish key relationships and lead discussions with cross functional teams to understand and collaborate on complex business issues.
  • Ability to interact and exercise strong judgment in communicating issues internally and to senior management.
  • Articulate understanding of business areas under review and demonstrate thorough analysis and solid rationale for potential issues.
  • Update Manager, Sr. Manager and/or Head of Supplier Quality on progress and potential issues in a timely manner.
Leadership:
  • Develop an open and honest working relationship with Senior Leaders and those being audited and maintain a professional approach at all times.
  • Share best practices, tools and testing methodologies with all members of the audit team, members of the business and contribute to departmental projects.
  • Be able to work with multiple organizations and teams, consistently meet deadlines and work well under time constraints and be able to quickly learn and understands diverse business areas/systems.

Qualifications:

  • BS Degree in Food Science, Animal Science, Microbiology or other related field
  • Food safety and regulatory requirements (PCQI preferred)
  • Supplier expectations in Food Safety, Regulatory and Quality
  • Fundamental statistics (DMAIC Process/DFSS/Lean/Metrology/MSA/Sampling Procedures)
  • 3-5 years of experience in food or CPG
  • Experience in plant and/or corporate quality
  • Experience in RDQI
  • Working knowledge of quality systems and policies, HACCP, and ISO/GFSI systems
  • Lean Six Sigma to support Supplier Integration
  • Excellent computer skills in Microsoft office suite (i.e., Excel and PowerPoint) a must
  • Understanding of the procurement processes a plus
  • Experience or education in food science, food safety or packaging a plus
Preferred location is Glenview, IL, but remote is acceptable.
Our Total Rewards philosophy is to provide a meaningful and flexible spectrum of programs that equitably support our diverse workforce and their families and complement Kraft Heinz’ strategy and values.

$89,800.00 - $112,200.00
Bonus: This position is eligible for a performance-based bonus as provided by the plan terms and governing documents.
The compensation offered will take into account internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors
Benefits:Coverage for employees (and their eligible dependents) through affordable access to healthcare, protection, and saving for the future, we offer plans tailored to meet you and your family’s needs. Coverage for benefits will be in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and associated governing plan documents.
Wellbeing: We offer events, resources, and learning opportunities that inspire a physical, social, emotional, and financial well-being lifestyle for our employees and their families.
You’ll be able to participate in a variety of benefits and wellbeing programs that may vary by role, country, region, union status, and other employment status factors, for example:
  • Physical - Medical, Prescription Drug, Dental, Vision, Screenings/Assessments
  • Social - Paid Time Off, Company Holidays, Leave of Absence, Flexible Work Arrangements, Recognition, Training

raw.description:
Energy Solutions Associate

About the Role

We are looking for a Energy Solutions Associate to join our Technical Solutions team, working at the intersection of Commercial, Product and Technology.

This is a client-facing role combining technical implementation, analytical thinking and problem-solving. You will work directly with clients to understand their business needs, design tailored solutions and manage the technical implementation and integration of our SaaS platform.

You will ideally have 3–5 years of relevant professional experience and may have previously worked in finance, energy consulting or a similar industry, where you developed strong analytical, technical and problem-solving skills.

You will collaborate closely with commercial, product and engineering teams, playing an important role in delivering successful client solutions and improving our products and services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work directly with clients to understand their business activities, technical requirements and operational needs.
  • Design, document and implement tailored solutions and data integrations between client systems and our SaaS platform.
  • Manage technical onboarding and ensure successful implementation and adoption.
  • Act as a technical point of contact for clients, providing guidance, troubleshooting and ongoing support.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible language for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Monitor integrations, processes and automations to ensure smooth platform operations.
  • Identify challenges, develop solutions and communicate project progress and key insights to internal stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Commercial, Product and Engineering teams to support business development and product improvements.

What We're Looking For

Essential Experience & Skills

  • 3–5 years of relevant professional experience, ideally as an energy consultant, business analyst or in a similar analytical, technical or client-facing role.
  • Previous relevant jobs could be Analyst, Energy Analyst, Energy Originator or previous experience from an energy graduate programme.
  • Degree in a STEM-related discipline or equivalent relevant technical experience.
  • Degree in Energy Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Finance or similar would also be highly relevant to the role.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complex challenges and develop practical solutions.
  • Excellent analytical skills and confidence working with data and complex processes.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to engage with a range of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Interest in the energy industry, ideally with some existing sector knowledge such as PPAs, energy trading solutions or similar
  • Knowledge of a scripting language, preferably Python (VBA or R also beneficial).
  • Familiarity with AI-powered coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex or equivalent.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
  • Fluency in English.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in the energy industry.
  • Experience with SaaS platforms, APIs, data integrations or enterprise software implementations.
  • Experience in consulting or client project management.

Location & Working Arrangements

This is a fully remote position, and you can be based near London, Paris, Brussels or Amsterdam. No sponsorship is available for this position, you must have the right to work.

Why Join?

You'll have the opportunity to work directly with clients, solve complex technical and business challenges, and collaborate across commercial, product and engineering teams. This role offers significant exposure to different areas of a growing business and the opportunity to make a tangible impact on its products and customers.

raw.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Lead SAP CRM-analist neem je binnen een multidisciplinair agile productteam een inhoudelijke trekkersrol op. Je helpt het team om complexe businessbehoeften te vertalen naar samenhangende, haalbare en toekomstbestendige CRM-oplossingen.

Je bewaakt de end-to-end samenhang tussen processen, functionele analyses, data, integraties en architectuur. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met de Product Owner, functioneel analisten, developers, architecten en collega's uit andere productteams. Je brengt expertises samen, bewaakt de oplossingsrichting en maakt keuzes, risico's en afhankelijkheden tijdig zichtbaar.

End-to-end oplossingsrichting bewaken

Je doorgrondt complexe businessbehoeften, stelt kritische vragen en helpt het team om die te vertalen naar passende CRM-oplossingen.

  • Je bewaakt de samenhang tussen processen, data, integraties en CRM-functionaliteit.
  • Je kijkt verder dan één requirement, user story, functionaliteit of applicatie.
  • Je bevraagt behoeften en aannames wanneer dit tot een betere oplossing kan leiden.
  • Je onderzoekt samen met het team verschillende oplossingsrichtingen.
  • Je maakt voor- en nadelen, risico's en afhankelijkheden inzichtelijk.
  • Je bewaakt dat oplossingen aansluiten bij de productvisie en voldoende toekomstbestendig zijn.

Complexe refinements inhoudelijk trekken

Bij complexe roadmapinitiatieven help je het team om voldoende duidelijkheid te creëren voordat de ontwikkeling start.

  • Je structureert complexe onderwerpen voorafgaand aan de refinement.
  • Je brengt functionele en technische onzekerheden in kaart.
  • Je detecteert afhankelijkheden met andere systemen en productteams.
  • Je helpt alternatieve oplossingsrichtingen onderzoeken en vergelijkt ze op haalbaarheid, impact, risico's en toekomstbestendigheid.
  • Je maakt openstaande beslissingen expliciet.
  • Je betrekt tijdig de juiste analisten, developers, architecten en andere experten.
  • Je helpt oplossingsvragen en afhankelijkheden samen met het team uitklaren.

Samenhang met architectuur bewaken

Je herkent wanneer oplossingskeuzes een bredere architecturale impact hebben en zorgt ervoor dat die tijdig met de juiste architecten en experten worden afgestemd.

  • Je brengt architecturaal relevante vraagstukken tijdig naar voren.
  • Je stemt oplossingsrichtingen af met architecten.
  • Je vertaalt architectuurprincipes en beslissingen naar concrete gevolgen voor CRM.
  • Je bewaakt samen met het team dat oplossingen aansluiten bij geldende richtlijnen, standaarden en best practices.
  • Je helpt beslissingen en hun impact helder vastleggen.
  • Je vertegenwoordigt het productteam waar nodig in relevante inhoudelijke overlegfora.

Over productteams en systemen heen werken

CRM-oplossingen staan zelden op zichzelf. Daarom kijk je actief naar processen, systemen en productteams buiten het eigen team.

  • Je identificeert cross-teamafhankelijkheden vroegtijdig.
  • Je werkt samen met analisten, lead analisten en architecten van andere productteams.
  • Je organiseert waar nodig inhoudelijke afstemming over teamgrenzen heen.
  • Je bewaakt de end-to-end samenhang wanneer een oplossing verschillende systemen of teams raakt.
  • Je voorkomt dat lokaal optimale oplossingen verderop in de keten problemen veroorzaken.

Product Owner en team ondersteunen bij de roadmap

Vanuit je inhoudelijke expertise ondersteun je de Product Owner bij het realiseren van de productroadmap.

  • Je maakt technische en functionele afhankelijkheden zichtbaar.
  • Je adviseert over haalbaarheid en oplossingscomplexiteit.
  • Je helpt risico's vroegtijdig identificeren.
  • Je adviseert over een logische fasering van grotere roadmapinitiatieven.
  • Je helpt bepalen welke analyses of architecturale beslissingen vooraf nodig zijn.
  • Je geeft input over de benodigde analyse- en ontwikkelcapaciteit.

Functioneel analisten coachen en ondersteunen

Je helpt functioneel analisten bij complexe analyses en bewaakt de samenhang tussen verschillende oplossingsonderdelen.

  • Je fungeert als inhoudelijk klankbord.
  • Je helpt complexe functionele vraagstukken uitklaren.
  • Je reviewt analyses en oplossingsvoorstellen.
  • Je detecteert inconsistenties en hiaten tussen verschillende analyses.
  • Je stimuleert hergebruik en consistente oplossingen.
  • Je bevordert kennisdeling binnen het team.
  • Je coacht en ondersteunt minder ervaren collega's en helpt hen groeien in hun rol.

Betrokken blijven tijdens de realisatie

Ook nadat de development is gestart, blijf je actief betrokken bij de oplossing.

  • Je bent beschikbaar voor complexe functionele of solutiongerelateerde vragen.
  • Je helpt onduidelijkheden voor analisten, developers en testers uitklaren.
  • Je bewaakt samen met het team dat de gerealiseerde oplossing aansluit bij de afgesproken oplossingsrichting.
  • Je signaleert nieuwe risico's of afhankelijkheden wanneer die tijdens de realisatie zichtbaar worden.
  • Je helpt het team oplossingskeuzes opnieuw te bekijken wanneer nieuwe inzichten ontstaan.

Hoe werk je samen?

Als CRM Lead Analist toon je leiderschap vanuit expertise, overzicht, initiatief en overtuigingskracht.

  • Je neemt initiatief en ownership zonder verantwoordelijkheden van anderen over te nemen.
  • Je brengt mensen samen rond een gemeenschappelijke oplossingsrichting.
  • Je communiceert helder over keuzes, risico's en afhankelijkheden.
  • Je durft behoeften, aannames en bestaande oplossingen constructief te challengen.
  • Je stimuleert samenwerking tussen business, analyse, development en architectuur.
  • Je deelt actief kennis, coacht collega's en stimuleert hun autonomie.
  • Je denkt over de grenzen van het eigen team en de eigen applicatie heen.
  • Je zoekt samen met het team naar de beste oplossing in plaats van zelf alle antwoorden te willen bepalen.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt ervaring met SAP CRM of gelijkaardige technologie.
  • Je kan medewerkers coachen en opleiden in SAP CRM-materie.

raw.description:
Position: Chief Revenue Officer

Company: Solen Software Group

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: US, Canada, UK

About Solen Software Group

Solen Software Group is an evergreen holding company that acquires and operates proven software businesses that have significant growth potential in a variety of vertical markets, enabling them to be market leaders in their niche industry. Solen owns several software companies in various market spaces: Human Resource Technology, Fleet Telematics, Asset Management, E-Health, Document Management, and other innovative software solutions in a variety of industries. Solen is backed by a group of advisors and investors that have built software businesses of material scale (10-100M in ARR) and advised many.

About The Role

The Chief Revenue Officer will own revenue growth across Solen's Hyper Growth Portfolio, starting hands-on at our anchor portfolio company, the fastest-growing business in the portfolio, and then scaling a proven go-to-market playbook across additional Portfolio Companies.

This role is responsible for building an engineered, predictable sales machine on a common RevOps stack, accelerating organic ARR growth, launching new sources of revenue, and making AI the default across every revenue function. The CRO will recruit and lead GTM leadership across sales, marketing, and customer success, and partner closely with portfolio company CEOs and founders.

This is a highly strategic, hands-on leadership role for a vertical-agnostic operator who builds systems, not heroics.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Growth

  • Accelerate organic ARR growth above target at the anchor portfolio company, then roll the same playbook out to other Portfolio Companies in scope.
  • Own pipeline coverage, net revenue retention (NRR), gross revenue retention (GRR), and CAC payback across the Portfolio Companies in scope.
  • Balance growth with efficiency, using Rule of 40 as a portfolio guardrail.
  • Lead Monthly Business Reviews on revenue performance with portfolio leadership.

Growth Opportunities

  • Identify, size, and launch new sources of revenue, each backed by an approved ROI case.
  • Drive internal growth through cross-sell and referral motions between Solen Portfolio Companies, upsell and expansion, and pricing and packaging improvements.
  • Drive external growth through new customer segments, channels, partnerships, and markets.
  • Track each new motion as a separate revenue source in the CRM from launch.

Engineered Sales Machine & RevOps

  • Build a vertical-agnostic Solen go-to-market playbook covering ICP and segmentation, sales stages, pricing guardrails, compensation plans, and forecasting cadence.
  • Stand up a common RevOps stack so every Portfolio Company in scope runs the same stages, metrics, and forecast cadence in one system.
  • Prove the playbook at the anchor portfolio company, then roll it out to additional Portfolio Companies, shortening rollout time with each one.
  • Deliver accurate forecasts and keep sales and marketing spend within plan.

AI-Driven Go-to-Market

  • Make AI the default across prospecting, lead scoring, deal coaching, forecasting, renewals, and customer success.
  • Raise revenue per GTM employee at each Portfolio Company while ARR grows at or above target.
  • Build a shared AI GTM toolkit on the Solen RevOps stack that is reused across Portfolio Companies rather than rebuilt in each one.

Talent Density

  • Own recruitment and development of GTM leadership (sales, marketing, and customer success leaders) across the Portfolio Companies in scope, with a reporting line to the CRO.
  • Place A-Players in Key Seats and apply the Unlock, Replace, Redeploy, Expand, and Duplicate framework.
  • Improve quota attainment and reduce new-rep ramp time through coaching, enablement, and process.
  • Lead portfolio company CEOs and founders through influence as well as authority.

What We're Looking For

  • Builds sales machines, not heroics: You work hands-on first, then design the process, compensation, metrics, and tooling that make revenue predictable and repeatable across companies. You have proven this in more than one company.
  • Efficient growth operator: You have a track record of hitting ARR growth targets while improving NRR, GRR, and CAC payback in B2B SaaS.
  • Growth hunter: You find and size new growth opportunities, inside and outside a portfolio, and back each with an ROI case.
  • Vertical-agnostic operator: You learn a new market fast and run one playbook across different businesses, adapting only where it matters.
  • Data- and AI-native: You run the business from the numbers and are an early, practical adopter of AI and RevOps tooling that makes revenue teams measurably more productive.
  • Talent magnet and multi-company leader: You recruit, coach, and retain A-player GTM leaders, hold a high bar across several companies at once, and win the support of CEOs and founders.
  • Lives the Solen-isms: You operate by the Solen-isms and the Solen Principles of Transformation.

What Success Looks Like

  • Organic ARR growth at the anchor portfolio company accelerates above target within 12–18 months.
  • Portfolio Companies in scope deliver 20%+ annual organic ARR growth, with NRR ≥ 110%, GRR ≥ 90%, CAC payback ≤ 18 months, and a Rule of 40 score ≥ 45.
  • Within 18 months, 15%+ of new ARR across the Portfolio Companies in scope comes from new growth motions.
  • The Solen GTM playbook is proven at the anchor company within 6 months and rolled out to at least 3 more Portfolio Companies within 18 months, with rollout time falling from 6 to 4 to 3 months.
  • Forecast accuracy is within ±10%, and sales and marketing spend stays within plan.
  • Revenue per GTM employee rises 25%+ within 18 months, powered by a shared AI GTM toolkit.
  • GTM Talent Density reaches 90%+, with 70%+ of quota-carrying reps at or above plan and new-rep ramp time down 25%+.

Solen-isms (How We Operate)

  • Ownership Mindset: We own the mission. We don't wait to be told. We lead, fix, and build as if it were ours. When problems arise, we run toward them, not away.
  • Benchmark to Best: We seek out excellence. We measure ourselves against the best and adapt quickly, always looking for the edge that moves us forward.
  • Openly Self-Critical: Leaders go first: they surface their misses early, ask for direct feedback, and turn “game film” into better decisions and better systems.
  • Disagree & Commit: Leaders disagree openly and constructively, regardless of title or tenure, because truth is how we avoid bureaucracy and benchmark to best.
  • Figureitoutiveness: Embracing challenges, fostering growth, and taking initiative, leaders thrive on hard work and high failure tolerance.
  • Mutual Elevation: Committed to growth, elevating teams, developing future leaders, and removing barriers to mastery and joy.
  • Learn-it-alls: Learn-it-alls, not know-it-alls, embracing failure as part of growth and progress.
  • Pioneering: Pioneering driven by opportunity, using first principles thinking and unbound by tradition or rules.
  • Will to Win: Leaders relentlessly pursue potential, reject mediocrity, and get what they tolerate.
  • Dialectical: We learn through conversation. We ask, listen, question, and evolve — valuing disagreement as a tool for alignment and deeper understanding.
  • Frugality: Achieving more with less, focusing on quality, long-term value, and company-wide responsibility.
  • Candor: We communicate with integrity, transparency, and respect in all conversations.
  • Kaizen: Kaizen is continuous improvement as a way of life. Leaders make hundreds of small upgrades that compound, turning lessons into standards and standards into durable systems.

Recruitment Disclaimer

Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels.

We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

raw.title: Amazon Ad Specialist
raw.excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for an Amazon Advertising Specialist who will be responsible for driving advertising performance and growth across a portfolio of brands on Amazon.
raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an Amazon Advertising Specialist who will be responsible for driving advertising performance and growth across a portfolio of brands on Amazon. This is a hands-on, client-facing position focused on building, managing and optimizing campaigns, analyzing performance data, and identifying opportunities to improve results. The role owns day-to-day advertising execution, including campaign strategy, keyword targeting, bidding, budget management and ongoing optimization, while partnering closely with clients to communicate performance and recommendations. Success requires balancing the details of campaign execution with a broader understanding of each brand’s business goals to deliver measurable, sustainable growth.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

  • Own Amazon advertising strategy and execution for a book of client accounts across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and Amazon DSP.
  • Build, structure, and optimize Sponsored Ads campaigns, including keyword and ASIN targeting, search term harvesting and negation, bid and budget management, and placement adjustments.
  • Plan, launch, and manage Amazon DSP campaigns across the funnel, including audience strategy, prospecting and retargeting, and inventory selection.
  • Use Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) to answer questions the ad consoles can’t, such as path to conversion, new-to-brand, reach and frequency, and Sponsored Ads/DSP overlap, and turn those insights into audiences and optimizations.
  • Monitor account performance daily against client KPIs (e.g., ROAS, ACoS, TACoS, CPA, new-to-brand, total sales growth) and act quickly on what you find.
  • Own the advertising relationship on client calls: lead regular performance discussions, present recommendations, and set clear expectations on what media can deliver.
  • Build and present quarterly business reviews, forecasts, and budget recommendations for each account in your book.
  • Recommend budget allocation across Sponsored Ads and DSP based on performance data and client goals.
  • Break down performance by meaningful segments (e.g., branded vs. non-branded, product line, new-to-brand) to find where spend is working and where it isn’t.
  • Design and run structured tests on bidding, placements, targeting, and creative, and document the results for the team.
  • Partner with internal and external creative teams on ad assets, and flag listing or retail-readiness issues that hold back ad performance.
  • Stay current on Amazon Ads product releases and industry trends, and share what you learn with the team.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • 2–4 years of hands-on Amazon Advertising experience, ideally managing multiple brands at an agency.
  • Strong working knowledge of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display, plus hands-on Amazon DSP campaign management.
  • Working knowledge of Amazon Marketing Cloud; ability to write or adapt SQL queries is a strong plus.
  • A track record of improving KPIs such as ROAS, TACoS, new-to-brand, and total sales growth for the brands you’ve managed.
  • Confidence leading client conversations and presenting performance and recommendations to brand stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to speed up analysis, reporting, and campaign management, and curiosity about where AI can improve how ad accounts are run.
  • Excellent organization and the ability to manage multiple accounts and deadlines at once.
  • Amazon Ads certifications (Sponsored Ads, DSP, AMC) are a plus.
REMOTE

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on:

We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers.

What’s unique about management at Miaplaza:

Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice:

  1. You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important.

  2. We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer.

  3. We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you.

  4. One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports' work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output.

  5. Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader, of which:

    • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering, of which:

  • 3+ years running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE preferred)

  • 3+ years of experience with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code. GCP is our primary cloud and we expect senior-level knowledge of IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, CloudSQL and Secret Manager

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operations

  • Experience with GitOps (FluxCD or ArgoCD)

  • Experience working directly with engineering teams and other managers as your customers on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience leading incident response, including running postmortems

What makes you stand out:

Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

Experience with consumer platforms at scale

Experience building in regulated environments

Experience operating self-hosted observability stacks (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry)

Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling

Experience supporting .NET/C# application deployments

Experience with database operations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ)

Experience with Istio or other service meshes

Responsibilities

  • Work with your team to design, build, and operate the infrastructure the rest of engineering depends on: clusters, pipelines, databases, edge, and observability

  • Your customers are the other engineering teams. Work with the other Engineering Managers and product development leadership to scope and prioritize platform work

  • Set the quality bar for your team. Lead by example.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean infrastructure-as-code, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

  • Application and CV Review - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update.

  • Initial Technical Screen (20 minutes) - A quick screening call to answer some administrative questions and confirm your basic technical knowledge. You'll be asked some administrative questions and 7 short technical questions related to the role.

  • Behavioral Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of our HR team to discuss your experience and share your approach throughout your career so far.

  • 1st Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team to answer focused technical questions tailored to our work.

  • Scenario-based Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team and the team's engineering manager to work through two hypothetical DevOps scenarios and how you would tackle them.

  • Leadership Interview (1 hour) - With our head of engineering and executive leadership.

  • Reference check - We'll reach out to the 3 references you provided, at least one being a former or current manager and any former or current direct reports.

  • Offer & background check - Once you sign your offer, we'll run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation and setup

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area.

Miaplaza is a growing, self-funded EdTech company. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally

About The Role

CoverGo is hiring an Application Security Engineer to use AI to find and prevent vulnerabilities before they reach production, and to give engineering teams the tools and guardrails that stop vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place. The Security team is small and growing, and works AI-first: everyone uses AI to automate their own work and to scale security across a large engineering organisation.

What You Will Do

  • Use AI tools such as Claude and OpenAI models to find and triage vulnerabilities in code, dependencies and designs before changes are merged.
  • Embed security checks into developer workflows and CI/CD pipelines so issues surface as code is written.
  • Select, configure and tune code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk and Checkmarx, keeping the signal high enough that engineers act on the findings.
  • Build self-service tools, guardrails and guidance that help engineering teams prevent common vulnerability classes.
  • Partner with engineering leads and security champions across product teams to prioritise and fix findings.
  • Review security-relevant designs and changes, ranking risk by what an attacker could realistically reach.
  • Track and report on application-security risk and remediation progress.

What We Need

  • 3+ years in application security or a closely related security role.
  • An AI-native approach to securing software: you already use LLMs to find, detect and explain vulnerabilities.
  • Enough fluency in at least one modern programming language to read, understand and fix vulnerable code. A software-engineering background is not required.
  • Hands-on experience with code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk or Checkmarx.
  • A solid grasp of common vulnerability classes, such as the OWASP Top 10, and how to prevent them.
  • A practical, enabling style of working with engineers.

Nice to have

  • Experience building custom security tooling or automations on LLM APIs.
  • Experience securing applications on AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated SaaS environment.

  • Annual Performance Bonus
  • Health Insurance
  • Remote Work Allowance
  • Anniversary Bonus
  • Company activities and events
  • Learning and development plan

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.


You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.


As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.
