The Director of Regulatory Affairs, Hematology/Urinalysis is responsible for driving the regulatory strategy for new product and sustaining programs within the hematology and urinalysis product portfolios. S/he directs a team through the regulatory submission process, preparing registrations and engaging with the FDA, notified bodies, and other health authorities. This position is also responsible for talent development and growth and contributing to the vision and evolution of the broader Global Regulatory Affairs function. This role also works closely with cross-functional partners, such as R&D, clinical affairs, and project management, to drive new product registration and sustaining activities.

This position reports to the Vice President, Global Regulatory Affairs and is part of the Global Regulatory Affairs organization.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Provide accountability for regulatory timelines and management of regulatory submissions for hematology and urinalysis solutions. Provide regulatory oversight, including leading all communications and submissions with regulatory agencies throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Drive regulatory activities related to sustaining initiatives to ensure continued compliance of on-market products.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

Pronunciation: a:rine [uh-reen]. Noun: Arine is a name of Basque origin meaning "light." Arine illuminates the possibilities with medication management to deliver comprehensive economic and health outcomes.

Based in San Francisco, Arine is a rapidly growing healthcare technology and clinical services company with a mission to ensure individuals receive the safest and most effective treatments for their unique and evolving healthcare needs.

Frequently, medications cause more harm than good. Incorrect drugs and doses costs the US healthcare system over $528 billion in waste, avoidable harm, and hospitalizations each year. Arine is redefining what excellent healthcare looks like by solving these issues through our software platform (SaaS). We combine cutting edge data science, machine learning, AI, and deep clinical expertise to introduce a patient-centric view to medication management, and develop and deliver personalized care plans on a massive scale for patients and their care teams.

Arine is committed to improving the lives and health of complex patients that have an outsized impact on healthcare costs and have traditionally been difficult to identify and address. These patients face numerous challenges including complicated prescribing issues across multiple medications and providers, medication challenges with many chronic diseases, and patient issues with access to care. Backed by leading healthcare investors and collaborating with top healthcare organizations and providers, we deliver recommendations and facilitate clinical interventions that lead to significant, measurable health improvements for patients and cost savings for customers.

Why is Arine a Great Place to Work?:

Outstanding Team and Culture - Our shared mission unites and motivates us to do our best work. We have a relentless passion and commitment to the innovation required to be the market leader in medication intelligence.

Making a Proven Difference in Healthcare - We are saving patient lives, and enabling individuals to experience improved health outcomes, including significant reductions in hospitalizations and cost of care.

Market Opportunity - Arine is backed by leading healthcare investors and was founded to tackle one of the largest healthcare problems today. Non-optimized medications therapies which cost the US 275,000 lives and $528 billion annually.

Momentum That Matters - In just over eight years, Arine has grown into one of the fastest-growing healthcare AI companies, serving more than 45 million members through partnerships with leading health plans nationwide. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years, we're combining rapid growth with meaningful impact on the quality, cost, and outcomes of care.

The Role:

We are looking for a Lead Clinical Support Specialist to assist in leading one of the clinical teams that uses the Arine platform to deliver excellent outcomes for our customers.

The purpose of the Lead Clinical Support Specialist position is to assist in managing a patient engagement program that achieves five-star results across a variety of Medicare Part C and Part D measures. The Lead Clinical Support Specialist partners with the Lead Clinical Pharmacist to achieve these results by setting a strategic approach with Arine leadership and with other Clinical Care Leads, by managing a dedicated Clinical Care Support team that engages patients, providers and pharmacists to drive excellent medication outcomes, and engaging client teams and Arine Customer Success to align expectations and communicate roadblocks and progress.

What You’ll be Doing:

  • Support oversight of goals, progress, and resource allocation of an Arine full-service clinical project
  • Develop intervention strategies to optimize medication utilization, achieve quality measures, and other established goals
  • Manage team productivity and timelines to ensure goals are met
  • Ensure quality assurance standards are met
  • Represent Arine’s Clinical Care team at customer meetings, as well as lead internal staff meetings
  • Hire, train, and schedule team members and help lead in the growth and development of the team
  • Manage and conduct performance reviews for assigned team members
  • Respond to questions by patients, providers, and other professional personnel and team members

raw.description:
GROW WITH US:
Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.

STAY AWESOME:
Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

The Data Analyst II supports data-driven decision making by transforming complex data into actionable insights, reports, and analytical solutions. This role partners with stakeholders across the organization to understand business needs, integrate and prepare data from multiple sources, and deliver analyses that improve operational effectiveness and business outcomes. This position combines business analytics, data wrangling, and technical development skills using SQL, Python, and modern analytics platforms.

Data Analyst II's are also responsible for:

  • Uses SQL, Python, and analytics platforms to prepare, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
  • Ensures data quality through validation, investigation, and documentation of data sources and methodologies.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders across Tandem’s business units to define user needs and develop proof-of-concept analyses, datasets, and visualizations that inform solution design.
  • Analyzes data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable business insights.
  • Develops reports, dashboards, visualizations, and analytical datasets that support business decision-making.
  • Presents findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Identifies opportunities to automate and improve reporting and analytical processes.
  • Ensures compliance with company policies, including Privacy/HIPAA, and other legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHEN & WHERE YOU’LL WORK:

Remote: This position is fully remote and is open to candidates throughout the United States, with a preference for those located in San Diego, California. Equipment for the role will be provided, and training will be conducted remotely.


Schedule: This position will work Monday - Friday from 8:00 AM - 5:00 PMPST.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

1. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Experience with SQL and relational databases.
  • Experience using Python for data preparation, analysis, and automation.
  • Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Strong data wrangling and data modeling skills.
  • Ability to work with large, complex datasets.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Minimum Certifications/Educational level:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field
  • Master's degree in a related field may substitute for the required experience.

Minimum Experience:

  • Two (2) years of related experience in Data Analytics.
  • Preferred experience in any of the following areas:
    • Experience translating business questions and stakeholder needs into analytical requirements, metrics, and reporting solutions.
    • Experience working in a regulated industry, such as medical device, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or healthcare.
    • Experience with Databricks or other cloud-based analytics platforms.
    • Experience integrating data from multiple business systems
    • Experience supporting cross-functional business initiatives.
    • Experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and supporting team backlog management using tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
    • Knowledge of statistical analysis and modeling techniques preferred.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

The base pay for this position is $82,000 - $100,000 annually. Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes incentive compensation, equity, and a robust benefits package.


Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!


YOU SHOULD KNOW:

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information.


Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders.


SPONSORSHIP: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:
At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at .

BE YOU, WITH US!

We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us.

Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.

REFERRALS:
We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share!

APPLICATION DEADLINE:
The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.

Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow.

raw.title: Principal Quality Engineer
raw.excerpt: Let’s Tango!  Where Innovation Meets Impact. At Tango Analytics, we're all about helping businesses make smarter decisions through powerful technology, insightful data, and a whole lot of collaboration.
raw.description:
Let’s Tango! Where Innovation Meets Impact.

At Tango Analytics, we're all about helping businesses make smarter decisions through powerful technology, insightful data, and a whole lot of collaboration. Whether you're a creative thinker, a strategic planner, a tech wizard, or a customer champion, there's a place for you on our team. We believe work should be meaningful and fun — so if you're ready to make a difference while enjoying the journey, come join us and let's Tango!

About the role

Tango is looking for a Principal Quality Engineer (E6) to define and drive our company-wide Quality Engineering strategy, architecture, and technical standards. As the most senior individual contributor in Quality Engineering, you will operate across products and engineering teams to shape how quality is designed, measured, and delivered throughout the software development lifecycle.

You'll translate Tango's long-term business and technology strategy into a multi-year Quality Engineering roadmap spanning test architecture, automation platforms, continuous integration and delivery, test environments, production quality signals, and AI-powered testing. You'll partner with engineering and product leadership to ensure our systems are testable, observable, secure, performant, and reliable by design. You'll establish technical standards, guide critical architectural decisions, and help senior engineers and technical leads raise the quality bar across the organization.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll remain deeply engaged in engineering through architectural design, code reviews, prototypes, technical investigations, and the development of reference implementations that demonstrate how quality engineering should work at scale. You'll also play a pivotal role in shaping Tango's approach to AI in Quality Engineering and establishing the evaluation frameworks needed to deliver trustworthy AI-powered products.

What You'll Do

Technical Strategy and Execution

  • Define the Quality Engineering roadmap. Translate Tango's business objectives and technology strategy into a multi-year roadmap for test architecture, automation, environments, test data, release confidence, and production quality.
  • Architect scalable quality solutions. Design and evolve the frameworks, platforms, and engineering practices that enable teams to validate complex, multi-tenant SaaS applications efficiently and consistently.
  • Make quality a design principle. Influence system architecture and technical decisions to improve testability, observability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability from the outset.
  • Accelerate the software delivery lifecycle. Drive initiatives that improve feedback loops, enable shift-left testing, strengthen continuous quality validation, and support faster, safer releases.
  • Establish engineering standards. Define pragmatic, organization-wide standards for test automation, test design, coverage, test data, environments, CI/CD quality gates, and release readiness.
  • Solve the hardest technical problems. Lead investigations into systemic quality issues, complex failures, flaky tests, environment instability, performance bottlenecks, and production defects.
  • Stay hands-on. Build prototypes, develop reference implementations, review critical code and designs, and demonstrate engineering practices that teams can adopt and scale.
  • Measure and improve quality outcomes. Establish meaningful quality metrics and feedback mechanisms that help engineering teams identify risk, prioritize improvements, and make data-driven decisions.

Technical Leadership and Organizational Influence

  • Influence engineering strategy. Partner with engineering, product, architecture, to prioritize quality investments and align technical initiatives with business outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional programs. Drive complex, multi-team initiatives that require technical alignment, coordinated execution, and sustained organizational change.
  • Build a strong QE technical community. Coach members of the quality team through architecture reviews, technical mentoring, and shared quality engineering practices.
  • Enable distributed quality ownership. Help development teams take responsibility for quality throughout the SDLC by providing the frameworks, tools, standards, and guidance needed to succeed.
  • Raise the technical bar. Establish reusable patterns and engineering principles that improve consistency without creating unnecessary process overhead.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies. Assess industry developments, testing approaches, and engineering tools, identifying opportunities to improve Tango's engineering capabilities and long-term competitiveness.

AI Strategy and Quality Engineering Innovation

  • Define the AI strategy for Quality Engineering. Establish a multi-year vision for incorporating AI into test engineering, automation, defect analysis, and quality decision-making.
  • Scale AI-assisted engineering. Identify and implement opportunities for AI-assisted test generation, test maintenance, failure triage, root-cause analysis, and other activities that improve engineering productivity.
  • Establish AI evaluation frameworks. Define repeatable approaches for validating AI-powered features, including agentic workflows, non-deterministic behavior, multi-step reasoning, and tool interactions.
  • Define AI quality standards. Establish evaluation criteria, test methodologies, and measurable acceptance thresholds for accuracy, reliability, consistency, robustness, and task completion.
  • Address AI-specific risks. Ensure appropriate testing for hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe behavior, data leakage, privacy, security, and other risks relevant to Tango's AI capabilities.
  • Enable continuous AI quality monitoring. Develop approaches for regression evaluation, production feedback, model or prompt changes, and ongoing monitoring of AI quality.
  • Connect innovation to business value. Measure the impact of AI-enabled quality practices on engineering productivity, defect prevention, feedback speed, and release confidence.

What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering, Quality Engineering, test architecture, or a related technical discipline, including several years operating at Staff, Principal, or equivalent quality engineering leadership scope.
  • Demonstrated success designing and scaling test architectures, automation frameworks, or quality engineering platforms adopted across multiple engineering teams.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one general-purpose language, with the ability to build prototypes, review implementation details, and solve complex technical problems.
  • Deep understanding of modern software delivery practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, test environments, test data management, and continuous quality validation.
  • Experience with multiple dimensions of software quality, including functional correctness, integration, performance, reliability, security, and production behavior.
  • Ability to design quality solutions for distributed cloud-based, multi-tenant SaaS applications.
  • Experience defining technical roadmaps and driving engineering initiatives that span multiple teams, products, or organizational boundaries.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards, reference architectures, and reusable practices that improve quality and consistency across teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor junior and senior quality engineers, facilitate technical discussions, and influence engineering leadership.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical challenges into clear recommendations, investment priorities, and business outcomes.
  • Practical experience applying AI/ML techniques to software products or using AI to improve software engineering and Quality Engineering practices.
  • Understanding of how to validate AI-powered systems whose outputs may be probabilistic, context-dependent, or non-deterministic.
  • Ability to design evaluation strategies that combine automated metrics, scenario-based testing, human judgment where appropriate, and production feedback.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks for LLM-powered applications, AI agents, or multi-step agentic workflows.
  • Experience with AI red-teaming, adversarial testing, model evaluation, or production quality monitoring.
  • Background in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), chaos engineering, distributed systems, or production observability.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms serving multiple customers, with complex configurations, integrations, and data boundaries.
  • Experience working in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments.
  • Experience leading quality strategy through a major platform migration, architectural transformation, or modernization initiative.
  • Experience evaluating and adopting emerging AI-powered development and testing tools.

What is Accenture & Avanade Microsoft Solutions Marketing?

Microsoft Solutions Marketing is on a mission to help our clients do what matters and use the power of the Microsoft platform to fuel frontier transformation powered by agentic AI. Solutions Marketing plays a pivotal role in our success, serving as the bridge between Accenture Microsoft Business Group (AMBG) and Avanade services and our clients. We are the driving force bringing our solutions to life through compelling messages that harness a collective of knowledge about market conditions, client challenges and behavior, competitive knowledge and subject matter expertise and fuels the rest of our go-to-market initiatives. If you thrive at the intersection of marketing innovative technology solutions, insights, and the creative application of technology to solve real business problems to drive material client demand, look no further.

Job Summary: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Solutions Marketing Manager to join our team. This role involves acting as a Marketing Subject Matter Expert (SME) and ensuring the effective implementation and optimization of go-to-market (GTM) initiatives and marketing programs. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading and coordinating marketing efforts across various functions and channels. They will be adept at navigating complexity, managing multiple initiatives simultaneously, and balancing strategic prioritization across multiple programs and campaigns.

Key Responsibilities:

  • GTM Perspective: Align with relevant business SME’s, Microsoft stakeholders, and senior executives across Avanade and Accenture where and when needed to create a holistic perspective married with product knowledge, services, compete, pricing, analyst, perspectives and align with relevant marketing teams to drive execution of the Solution Area agenda.

  • GTM Capability Readiness & Launch: Ideate, create and refine specific go-to-market messages for our Solution areas. Conduct market landscape analysis, competitive analysis and message testing to support GTM initiatives. Collaborate with campaigns and thought leadership teams to optimize launch activities. Oversee quality assurance across sales enablement materials and field-owned content, ensuring consistency in messaging.

  • Content Creation: Own the creation of multi-format content (digital, print, social, videos, long-form, short-form, etc.) aligned to Solution Area priorities and GTM offerings to drive demand generation across the top, middle and bottom of the marketing funnel. Identify and develop Leverage AI tools (primarily M365 Copilot) to scale content development.

  • Integrated Campaign Planning and Activation: Work collaboratively across various marketing functions, ensuring deep alignment with campaigns, field marketing, communications (media and social), analyst relations, events and other teams for seamless program execution. Involves coordinating efforts to develop and implement comprehensive go-to-market strategies that resonate with target audiences and drive demand. By fostering strong relationships and maintaining open communication channels with these teams, the Solutions Marketing Manager ensures that all marketing initiatives are cohesive, strategically aligned, and effectively executed to achieve the company's business objectives.

  • Optimize Discoverability of GTM Solutions: Map solutions to the GTM placemat. Create externally facing content for .com and Showcase, making sure that all solutions are accurately discoverable. Plus maintain relevant mapping between the Accenture Reinvention Console, where Microsoft is a "differentiating technology" and the most relevant AMBG/Avanade Solution landing pages in the Microsoft Showcase.

  • Annual Solution Marketing Plan: Develop and maintain GTM plans for solutions practices, aligning with global and regional marketing functions. Ensure the creation and maintenance of Bill of Materials (BOM) content and client stories across primary market-facing platforms. Support content development including joint research with Microsoft, GitHub or other third parties, relevant to your solution area. Manage the sunsetting and retirement processes for market-facing collateral.

  • Annual Market Development Plan: Interlock with business stakeholders to ensure GTM and demand generation planning are represented in the annual partner marketing plan for Microsoft. When applicable, support the creation of solution-centric Partner Investment Request plans and content to support GTM investments. Some management of solution-specific investment funds including alignment with Microsoft, development and execution of marketing plans, and Proof of Execution collection may be required.

  • Event Activation: Own the end-to-end development of event strategy, content build, audience acquisition, demand generation, and internal/external communications for solution-specific events such as Fabric Community Conference, M365, and Power Platform Community Conference. Align with Solutions leads and other teams to support new capability development and announcements at events to maximize market impact. Optimize expert speakers and partner opportunities in our events plan. Support creation of ‘event in a box’ content that can scale across regions for your category where and when possible.

  • For non-solution specific events, work with field business stakeholders, marketing team, and event leads to curate content and demos for use in event programs.

  • Area and Regional Marketing Activation: Work directly with areas and regions to support local market GTM plans and activation. Build and align GTM funding tactics and initiatives with regional teams. Support the creation of content BOMs needed for local market execution.

  • Analyst Engagement and Featured Report Support: Execute briefing cadences with key analysts, influence whitepapers, and share lighthouse wins. Write and commission content for analyst wave, quadrant, and other featured reports.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • GTM Initiative Success: Measure the effectiveness of GTM initiatives through metrics such as campaign performance, lead generation, and conversion rates.

  • Event Impact: Coordinate with field and industry marketing to evaluate the success of events based on attendance, engagement, and feedback from participants. Regional Activation: Coordinate with field marketing to assess the impact of regional marketing activation efforts through metrics such as regional campaign performance and local market engagement.

  • Analyst Relations: Monitor the success of analyst engagement activities through the number of briefings, whitepapers influenced, and featured reports.

  • Content Performance: Measure the effectiveness of BOM content through metrics such as content engagement, downloads, and usage.

  • Funding Usage: Providing POE proof and performance metrics to support of aligned funding for activation jointly with partners.

Job requirement: Ability to accommodate West Coast hours.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum of 5 years of marketing

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Degree with a focus in marketing or business
  • Solutions marketing in B2B environment
  • Experience with CRM systems and marketing automation tools.
  • Experience in creating and managing marketing content, including BOMs and sales enablement materials.
  • Experience working in a global marketing environment and collaborating with regional teams.
  • Experience in planning and executing events, including funding submissions and event promotion.
  • Familiarity with content creation and creative production processes.
  • Familiarity with the technology industry ideally around the topics of cybersecurity and cloud

Professional Skills Requirements:

  • Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Proven track record of successfully launching and managing marketing campaigns, preference for multi-channel demand generation.
  • Knowledge of market research and competitive analysis.
  • Ability to conduct market landscape analysis and message testing.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data to drive marketing decisions.
  • Experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders, including analysts and partners.

About RentSpree

Renting should be faster, fairer, and less stressful than it is. We're the infrastructure that makes that happen. Five million users. 300+ real estate company and MLS partnerships. Ten years of consistent growth. From applications and screening to payments and lease management, the full rental journey runs on RentSpree. Recognized by Forbes as a Best Startup Employer and by BuiltIn Seattle as a Best Place to Work.

Customer Support Specialist - Remote PST

This is a full-time, contract position with the opportunity to evolve into a permanent position. The contract will be for a minimum of six months.

RentSpree is currently seeking a Customer Support Specialist to join our team and deliver world-class customer support. In this role, you will provide vital assistance and guidance to agents, landlords, and renters, ensuring their rental journey is smooth and successful. We are seeking a candidate with strong communication skills, particularly in phone support, who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while driving growth through OKRs and project-based initiatives.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide Tier 2 support to users via phone by troubleshooting and resolving complex system-related issues, guiding users through challenges with proactive solutions, and exceptional customer service
  • Work on projects aligned with OKRs (Objectives and Key Results), focusing on continuous improvement and growth initiatives for both the company and your role
  • Participate in quality testing scenarios, consistently offering feedback to improve the user experience
  • Lead efforts to improve support processes, providing insights and recommendations to the team while maintaining exceptional communication with customers and stakeholders
  • Apply data-driven problem-solving and deep technical expertise in RentSpree’s platform to troubleshoot independently, optimize system functionality, and drive cross-team initiatives aligned with business objectives

Skills You Bring (Required)

  • 2+ years of experience in tier 2 customer support (emphasis in phone support)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience triaging issues with users and providing solutions; Remain professional in high-pressure situations
  • Familiar with PC and Mac operating systems and mobile devices
  • Ability to set priorities, problem-solve, multitask, and work independently
  • M-F business hours, weekend availability when needed

Skills You Bring (Desired)

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Experience using CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zendesk) to track support tickets and user interactions
  • Familiarity with OKRs and experience contributing to growth-oriented projects or initiatives
  • Experience in product testing and providing feedback on software updates & releases
  • Knowledge of Jira for project management
  • Fluency in Spanish

AI Compounds the Work

AI is a core skill. The people who thrive here are curious, take ownership, and use AI to compound their thinking, not replace it.

We are fueled by our Guiding Principles

How we work and who we are comes down to six guiding principles. These are the principles we hire for and hold ourselves to:

  • Customer obsession: Our customers' needs come first. Not eventually, not when it's convenient. Every decision runs through one question: does this make things better for the people who depend on us?
  • Take action, forge solutions: When there's a problem, we don't wait for permission to solve it. We move with urgency, think past the obvious fix, and build something that holds.
  • Be candid, yet respectful: Say what you think. Name the problem. Challenge the idea. We don't do polite silence, but we also don't do cheap shots. Honest, direct, respectful.
  • Disagree, then commit: The best decisions come from real debate. Say what you think, even if it's uncomfortable. Once we decide, we move together.
  • Be audacious, learn loudly: Take the big swings our mission demands, treat every outcome as impact or a lesson, and share what you learn openly and early so the whole company grows stronger.
  • Strive for excellence: We don't settle at "done." We ask whether it's right, whether it's better than last time, and whether it's something we'd be proud to put in front of a customer.

SpreeHours

RentSpree has teams in the US and Bangkok. Collaboration across that distance requires a shared window: Monday-Thursday, 5-7pm PT. How often you're in SpreeHours depends on your role, team, and projects. Any SpreeHours you work, you take back as flex time the same week. Outside of SpreeHours, your schedule is yours.

Why Join Us?

The work here is real, the problems are hard, and you'll have teammates who push you to do your best.

  • Compensation: $31.25 per hour
  • Rotating paid holidays
  • Team-First Culture: Join a group of talented, supportive teammates who inspire each other to do their best work and celebrate every win
  • Learning & Development: Ongoing support for your growth through resources, coaching, and career development opportunities

Ready to Build Something Big?

If you take ownership, move with urgency, and want to work on problems that matter, we'd love to hear from you. You don't need to meet every requirement. If this feels like the right place to do your best work, reach out.

EEO Statement

RentSpree is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law. This applies to all employment practices, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Hiring decisions are made on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Don't see the right role, but we're the right company?

We're always on the lookout for talented people. If you don't see a fit today, apply to Future Opportunities and we'll reach out when something matching your background opens up.

raw.description:
About us:

Branch is on a mission to empower workers with financial freedom. We do this by helping companies accelerate payments and providing working Americans with accessible, free financial services. We’re committed to building and delivering more inclusive, transparent, and frictionless financial products.

Our goal of empowerment extends to our own employees, too. Have a great idea? Share it today and it might just get implemented tomorrow. As a member of our team, your voice and creativity matter—and they can directly impact our products, company, and culture.

We not only focus on attracting great talent from across the country, but also on building teams that help that talent thrive. That means valuing a diversity of opinions and working styles, while creating a shared belief in innovation, initiative, and winning together.

Come join our team as we develop new ways to improve the lives of working Americans.

About the role:

Every risk control at Branch, whether for fraud, financial crime, disputes or collections, answers two questions. The first is detection: should this user, login or transaction be flagged? The second is treatment: once it is flagged, what happens to the user, how quickly, and how does a legitimate user get back to normal? Our rules team owns the first question. This role owns the second.

As Risk Controls Manager, you own the control paths users move through once a control fires: step-up verification, holds, locks, review queues, unlock and recovery, and the handoff to offboarding. You decide who goes down each path, when, and on what exit criteria, across onboarding, login and account takeover, money movement and card activity, for fraud, financial crime, disputes and collections alike, including how Branch treats scams and first-party fraud. You also build and run Branch's User Risk Score, the user-level view that decides which treatment each user gets. Then you make the changes happen.

The role exists to close the gap between a strategy decision and the frontline. You will take ideas from the Enablement Director and carry them through Product, Engineering, Operations and our BPO partner until they are live, measured and understood by the people working the queues.

This is an individual contributor role with program ownership. You will not have direct reports.

Responsibilities:Own the Control Paths and User Risk Score

  • Map and document every control path Branch uses today: the trigger, the treatment, the owner, the service level and the exit criteria for each
  • Set the standard for which treatment applies to which risk, so similar risks get similar treatment across products and channels
  • Keep the map current as rules, products and vendors change, and make it the reference Operations, Support and Product work from
  • Document each control path, with its rationale, approvals and change history, to a standard our partner banks, internal audit and examiners can follow, and support partner bank reviews, audits and exams of the control environment, working with Compliance
  • Build and run Branch's User Risk Score: a lifetime view of each user that starts at enrollment and moves with behavior, money movement, payouts and account changes. You own the factors, weights, risk bands and the treatment each band receives; the Enablement Director owns the score's results and approves material changes
  • Combine existing signals (device and login intelligence, transaction monitoring, disbursement and payout models, organization risk classification, dispute and collections outcomes) into a single user-level view, working with the Manager of Risk Rules and Monitoring and Data
  • Measure and tune the score on capture rate, false positive rate and approval-rate cost, and feed confirmed fraud back into it, so every user removed changes how the next one is scored
  • Set the identity verification and step-up standards for phone and chat contacts, including unlocks and ATO recovery, and close the social engineering gaps the Manager of Risk and Recovery Contact Operations surfaces from live contacts

Change Management & Operationalization

  • Use loss, friction and operational data to find the paths that cost the most in loss, user friction or manual work, and redesign them
  • Write the requirements for each change, sequence it with Product and Engineering, and run it from design through testing to live
  • Before a change goes live, map its upstream and downstream impacts on disputes, collections, Support and other control paths, so a fix in one place does not create loss, friction or volume in another
  • Measure each change after launch and report whether it did what it was meant to do
  • For every control change, update the operational side before it goes live: queue design, SOPs, BPO procedures and agent guidance, working with the Managers of Risk and Recovery Program Operations and the BPO partner
  • Write procedures that meet audit and partner bank requirements and that an agent can still follow in the middle of a live queue
  • Brief Operations on what changed and why, so the frontline understands the controls it works with
  • Consult on improvements that start inside Operations; those remain with the Managers of Risk and Recovery Program Operations

Protect Good Users

  • Own the friction legitimate users absorb from fraud controls: step-up pass and drop-off rates, time to unlock or resolve, and the volume of escalations controls create
  • Design recovery paths for account takeover victims and good users caught by a control, in partnership with Support
  • Track loss on users released from controls, so friction reductions are not paid for in fraud

Scams and First-Party Fraud

  • Design the treatment paths for scams: warnings and added friction on high-risk outbound payments (P2P, Branch Direct, instant transfer), protective holds when a user appears to be acting under a scammer's direction, and recovery paths for scam victims, in partnership with Support
  • Build first-party fraud factors into the User Risk Score, such as repeat or unsupported disputes, bust-out patterns, negative-balance abuse and payback failures. Set the treatment each band receives, from limits to dispute scrutiny to offboarding
  • Apply Branch's scam and first-party fraud definitions consistently across control paths. Set the standard, with Disputes Operations and Compliance, for separating authorized scam payments from unauthorized transfers at the handoff to disputes

Onboarding Guardrails

  • Bring Risk & Recovery's control requirements to the cross-functional onboarding review led by the User Onboarding Product Manager, who owns the onboarding experience end to end
  • Model the risk and conversion tradeoff of proposed step-up and verification changes; Product makes the final call, and agreed tradeoffs are documented

What We're Looking For:

Required

  • 4 to 6+ years in fraud strategy, fraud operations, account takeover or customer risk at a financial institution, fintech or payments company
  • Experience designing or changing fraud control flows: step-up authentication, holds, locks, review and recovery
  • Experience designing or owning a customer-level risk score or risk rating model: factor selection, weighting, banding and treatment design
  • A record of taking process and product changes from design to adoption across Product, Engineering and Operations
  • Able to size exposure and measure friction, false positives and loss from data; SQL and BI fluency
  • Working knowledge of Regulation E as it applies to unauthorized transfers, account takeover and scam claims, including the authorized versus unauthorized distinction
  • Clear writing; able to turn a control design into requirements an engineer can build and an SOP an agent can follow
  • Comfort operating with program accountability and no direct reports

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SEON, Persona, device intelligence or real-time card decisioning platforms
  • Experience in a BPO-supported operating model
  • Working knowledge of NACHA rules and Mastercard dispute and chargeback rules as they apply to ACH, debit card and push-to-card activity
  • Experience supporting partner bank oversight, internal audit or regulatory examinations of fraud controls
  • Exposure to earned wage access, gig or staffing platforms, or employer-verified onboarding
  • Experience designing protective treatment for scam and account takeover victims, or first-party fraud controls such as dispute abuse and bust-out
  • CFE or comparable industry certification

Compensation:

The base salary range for this role is $95-110k. The salary range displayed reflects an average base salary range for the position across all the U.S. The base salary offered to an applicant could be higher or lower based on each applicant's specific skill set, depth of experience, relevant education or training, etc.

Location:

This position is classified as REMOTEwithin the United States of America.

We are unable to hire candidates located outside of the domestic U.S.

Benefits:

  • Market-leading medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Stock options
  • Free Premium-Tier Origin Financial Wellness subscription
  • Monthly home-office stipend
  • 401k (TransAmerica)
  • 12-weeks paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents
  • Flexible time off + sick and safe time
  • 11 paid company holidays
  • Branch@Branch Same Day Pay Option

Identity VerificationAs part of our application process, you'll receive a separate email from Greenhouse shortly containing a unique identity verification link. This step, powered by Persona, helps us confirm applicant identities and keep our hiring process secure for everyone.

Upon identity verification, all biometric data is deleted. If you need support completing this application, please reach out to

Working at Branch

A remote-first company with employees located throughout the U.S., Branch emphasizes transparency, accountability, and trust to create a collaborative environment where our product, engineering, marketing, customer support, customer success, and sales teams can all thrive together. Learn more about what we do in this video!

Our collaborative spirit has helped us become an award-winning FinTech company, with Branch’s innovation and workplace recognized across industries. Branch has been honored by Inc., the Webby Awards, Benzinga FinTech Awards, FinTech Breakthrough Awards, Top Workplaces USA, Great Places to Work, and EY Entrepreneur of the Year, Heartland, among others.

Learn more about our culture, approach, technology, and people here:

Branch is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Must be currently authorized to work in the USA without sponsorship or transfer.

The Opportunity

As a Manager of Solutions Engineering for the NEMEA region at Grafana Labs, you will be responsible for all aspects of building and managing a team of high performing Solution Engineers. You will own the regional build-out with your sales leader counterparts, adopting existing OSS Specific GTM strategies and developing new ones as needed. You’ll work with your Customer Experience counterparts to ensure that your customers are successful after the sale, in their adoption and rollout of Grafana products through professional services, support, training and customer success. You’ll work with marketing to drive community and adoption programs in the region designed to broaden the adoption of both OSS and commercial/cloud versions of our products. You’ll also work closely with Product Management and Engineering to ensure that we are constantly delivering value to our customers by influencing the roadmap, based on your customers and team feedback, as well as leveraging your own experience in the Monitoring and Observability space. All of this will be required for you to hit and then exceed your region's financial targets and ultimately, our company's goals. Your impact will be felt globally when the job is done well.

What you'll be Doing:

  • Attract, recruit, ramp and mentor a team of great Presales SE’s from diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  • Get the best out of your team with a servant based leadership approach. Adopting a player/coach mentality will be critical here, ensuring that you balance your field responsibilities with the needs of your team. Mentoring and career development will be critical to your team's success over the long term
  • Direct the bulk of your day to day work based on guidance and goals from leadership, owning the planning, actions and outcomes of the region.

What Makes you a Great Fit:

  • Some experience leading a team, 5-10 years in the high tech industry having held roles such as Developer, Architect, Sales Engineer/Architect, Manager, etc.

  • Proven track record of mentoring, developing people and managing performance over time. Has successfully mentored individual contributors.

  • Direct experience selling monitoring/data/visualisation products.

raw.description:
Lead Model-Base Systems Engineer

Location: 100% Remote (US based location) with CONUS and OCONUS Travel

Clearance: DoD Secret security clearance


Leidos is seeking an experienced Systems Engineer with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) experience to act as a systems engineer and lead systems modeler. In this role, you will drive the development, maintenance, and integration of large-scale systems engineering models using DoDAF in support of our customers’ mission. This is an exciting opportunity to drive a model design and apply hands-on experience with SysML, Cameo Systems Modeler, and collaborative model management in a dynamic engineering environment.


You will be supporting the design and delivery of network services (subsea, terrestrial and Satellite Communication (SATCOM) backup) that will meet the requirement of the Tactical Multi-Mission Over-the-Horizon Radar (TACMOR) program. The network services will include the management, on-island communications, off-island communications, and an integration facility to be used to ensure consistent interfaces and end-to-end service delivery.


The successful candidate will work closely with the chief engineer, system design team, system modelers and other technical disciplines to develop and maintain authoritative system models, establish and maintain requirements traceability, validate model integrity, and support the adoption of MBSE practices across engineering teams. Qualified applicants must be self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively in an environment with evolving priorities and technically complex requirements.


This position is 100% remote (US based location) with travel to both CONUS and OCONUS locations.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and expand large-scale SysML models using Cameo Systems Modeler using DoDAF.
  • Develop and maintain system architecture and engineering artifacts including Block Definition Diagrams (BDD), Internal Block Diagrams (IBD), Requirements, Use Case, Activity, Sequence diagrams. Develop MBSE output from Cameo to include ICD, IDD, SDD, RVTM, and other engineering artifacts to support design reviews and testing processes using Cameo Report Wizard.
  • Manage collaborative model development using Cameo Teamwork Cloud.
  • Establish and maintain traceability between system requirements and model artifacts using Cameo.
  • Review models developed by other engineers for quality, consistency, completeness, and adherence to established modeling practices.
  • Support the development, documentation, and implementation of MBSE modeling standards, processes, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with systems engineers, software engineers, and other technical disciplines to translate engineering requirements and concepts into structured system models.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers adopting MBSE practices and modeling tools.
  • Support customer technical meetings, engineering reviews, demonstrations, and capability briefings as required.
  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes through expanded use of MBSE, modeling, simulation, and digital engineering practices.
  • Support requirements analysis, system integration, technical assessments, and other systems engineering activities as needed.
  • Provide engineering technical support to special projects as required.

Basic Qualifications:

  • BS engineering degree and 12+ years of prior relevant experience or Masters engineering degree and 10+ years prior relevant experience. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • US citizen with Active DoD Secret security clearance.
  • Experience in basic systems engineering and leading system design for a DoW customer.
  • Hands-on experience performing Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) using SysML.
  • Experience using Cameo Systems Modeler.
  • Experience developing and maintaining system models using multiple SysML diagram types.
  • Experience with requirements traceability and management within a systems engineering environment.
  • Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with Cameo Systems Modeler 2024x or later.
  • Experience with Cameo Teamwork Cloud.
  • Experience with Cameo Collaborator.
  • Experience developing or implementing MBSE modeling standards and processes.
  • Experience providing mentorship or technical guidance to other engineers adopting MBSE practices.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and tools such as Jira and Confluence/SharePoint.
  • Experience with Python, scripting, or other automation capabilities applied to engineering or modeling tasks.
  • Experience with systems integration, modeling and simulation, or digital engineering environments.
  • Previous experience working DAF systems.

Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes if an offer letter is extended to you.

raw.description:
Kopius is seeking a hands-on, quota-carrying Sales Director with a proven ability to personally source, pursue, and close new logos across the Central U.S. region.

You will own and scale a new-business engine—generating your own pipeline, opening doors through outbound effort and relationships, and closing profitable deals across end-to-end technology solutions—including data & AI, application management, managed services, staff augmentation, and embedded teams—leveraging nearshore (LATAM) delivery. Success in this role means consistently exceeding new-business revenue targets and building a repeatable path to growth, not managing inbound demand.

Key Responsibilities

  • Revenue & Pipeline Generation: Own and achieve company-wide and team new-business revenue targets, including direct accountability for team quota and overall sales performance. Personally source, develop, and close new business opportunities, leading by example in deal execution.
  • Go-to-Market Strategy: Build and scale a repeatable, predictable new-business engine, including processes, playbooks, and performance metrics. Identify, open, and expand into new markets and customer segments, developing outbound sales strategies beyond inbound and brand-driven opportunities.
  • Consultative Selling: Take a business-outcome approach: identify industry trends and implications for clients, uncover business pain points, and map Kopius solutions—such as data & AI, application management, and managed services—to solve them.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and manage a high-performing team of Account Executives as a player-coach (~60% sales leadership and coaching, 40% individual contribution), setting clear expectations around quota attainment and execution.
  • Deal Execution: Lead complex deal cycles, including negotiation and closing of enterprise-level agreements. Position LATAM-based delivery models effectively to U.S. buyers, articulating value beyond cost arbitrage.
  • Relationship & Ecosystem Building: Establish strong relationships with key prospects, clients, strategic partners, and internal cross-functional teams (marketing, recruiting, delivery). Represent the company at industry events and key networking opportunities.
  • Sales Operations & Analytics: Analyze pipeline health, sales performance, and market dynamics to continuously refine strategy, maintaining accurate forecasting in Salesforce.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years of sales experience, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role. Proven history of personally sourcing and closing new logos in competitive, commoditized markets where differentiation must be actively created.
  • Domain Expertise: Proven end-to-end technology solutions sales experience within IT services, systems integration, or consulting firms, including selling nearshore/offshore delivery models.
  • Track Record: Demonstrated success consistently meeting and exceeding an individual sales quota in addition to leading teams. Experience building and scaling sales teams and processes in growth-stage environments.
  • Prospecting & Network: Proven ability to generate pipeline via outbound efforts and relationships rather than relying on inbound demand. Established network of decision-makers to support pipeline generation.
  • Business Acumen & Skills: Depth in 2–3 industry verticals with the ability to translate business challenges into technology solutions. Excellent negotiation, communication, executive presence, and analytical mindset with CRM proficiency (Salesforce).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industry experience in Retail/CPG, Manufacturing, Energy & Utilities, Financial Services, or Healthcare.
  • Experience within enterprise technology ecosystems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft, AWS). ERP fluency is a plus.
  • Experience selling LATAM nearshore staff augmentation or embedded services.
  • Public sector experience (local municipalities, city, and state government).

Position Details & Compensation

  • Location & Territory: Full-time role covering the Central U.S. region. Candidates based in the Central region are preferred; candidates elsewhere in the U.S. who can effectively cover the territory will be considered.
  • Work Authorization: Must be eligible to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
  • Base Salary: $150,000 – $180,000 (determined by experience, skills, and background).
  • Compensation Structure: 50/50 OTE split (Base Salary / Variable Compensation). Salary plus OTE expected to be in the $300,00 - $360,000 range.
  • Travel Expectation: Approximately 50% travel.

raw.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.
raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Junior Billing & Reconciliation Analyst to support accurate merchant billing and financial recordkeeping at Bask Health.

You'll work closely with Finance, Revenue Operations, Pricing, and Customer Success to review invoices, compare billing information against approved commercial agreements, maintain reconciliation spreadsheets, and help investigate discrepancies.

This is an opportunity for someone early in their career to develop experience in billing operations, financial analysis, and commercial reconciliation.

You'll learn how merchant contracts, pricing arrangements, transaction activity, and billing systems connect. You'll also help ensure important billing details, including rates, discounts, credits, and effective dates, are accurately documented and reviewed.

We're looking for someone who is organized, comfortable working with numbers, and willing to take ownership of detailed work.

What You'll Do

  • Support daily and recurring merchant billing review activities.
  • Assist with reconciling invoices against approved commercial agreements.
  • Compare billed amounts with expected charges using established procedures.
  • Help verify that merchant rates and fees match documented pricing terms.
  • Review billing records for missing information or inconsistent values.
  • Assist with checking that discounts are applied correctly.
  • Help verify the effective dates of approved pricing changes.
  • Support the review of credits and billing adjustments.
  • Maintain spreadsheets used to track billing reconciliation results.
  • Assist with identifying duplicate, missing, or incorrect charges.
  • Help compare transaction activity with relevant billing information.
  • Review merchant billing records for completeness and accuracy.
  • Support the preparation of recurring billing reconciliation reports.
  • Help organize commercial agreements and supporting billing documentation.
  • Assist with investigating straightforward billing discrepancies.
  • Escalate complex or unusual billing issues to senior team members.
  • Track outstanding billing questions and their resolution status.
  • Support Finance with gathering information for billing investigations.
  • Collaborate with Revenue Operations to validate merchant account information.
  • Assist with reviewing approved pricing changes against billing records.
  • Help maintain accurate records of merchant rates, discounts, and billing periods.
  • Support basic reconciliation of transaction counts and applicable fees.
  • Assist with preparing documentation for billing corrections.
  • Help verify that authorized billing adjustments are accurately recorded.
  • Maintain organized records of completed reconciliation work.
  • Support monthly billing reviews and reporting deadlines.
  • Assist with checking the accuracy of data entered into billing systems.
  • Help identify recurring patterns in billing discrepancies.
  • Support the development and maintenance of reconciliation checklists.
  • Assist with improving spreadsheet templates and reporting procedures.
  • Help document billing review steps and reconciliation methods.
  • Coordinate with Customer Success when additional merchant information is needed.
  • Support the preparation of summaries for internal billing discussions.
  • Help validate information used in billing and revenue reports.
  • Assist with testing billing changes under the guidance of senior team members.
  • Learn how commercial contracts and billing configuration relate.
  • Communicate findings clearly and raise potential issues promptly.
  • Support additional billing operations and reconciliation projects as assigned.

Billing corrections, credits, and changes to commercial terms will follow Bask's established approval procedures.

Requirements

  • 0–2 years of experience in Billing Operations, Finance Administration, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or a related area; relevant coursework and internship experience are welcome.
  • No previous full-time billing experience required.
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Ability to perform basic calculations involving amounts, percentages, rates, and discounts.
  • Strong attention to detail when reviewing numerical information.
  • Ability to organize and maintain accurate financial or operational records.
  • Comfortable comparing information across spreadsheets and documents.
  • Ability to identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent information.
  • Interest in learning billing reconciliation and financial operations processes.
  • Basic understanding of invoices and financial transactions.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to follow established procedures and document completed work.
  • Willingness to learn how commercial agreements affect billing.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate discrepancies and questions clearly.
  • Comfortable handling confidential financial and commercial information.
  • Willingness to ask questions and escalate issues when necessary.
  • Ability to manage recurring assignments and meet deadlines.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability to collaborate during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Degree or coursework in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, Analytics, or a related field.
  • Internship experience involving invoicing, billing, bookkeeping, or financial records.
  • Experience using spreadsheet formulas, lookups, or pivot tables.
  • Familiarity with billing or accounting software.
  • Experience reviewing invoices or payment records.
  • Understanding of basic financial reconciliation concepts.
  • Familiarity with subscription-based or transaction-based billing.
  • Experience using Stripe or similar payment platforms.
  • Experience maintaining financial tracking spreadsheets.
  • Familiarity with commercial contracts or pricing terms.
  • Experience identifying errors in numerical datasets.
  • Interest in SaaS or B2B technology businesses.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce or online merchant businesses.
  • Basic SQL knowledge.
  • Experience preparing financial or operational reports.
  • Interest in billing automation and process improvement.
  • Familiarity with telehealth or healthcare technology.

***MUST BE BASED IN EAST COAST OR CENTRAL TIME ZONE***

Enabling safe and rewarding digital lives for genuine people, everywhere

We make it our mission to ensure more genuine people have digital access to opportunities, and businesses have access to more genuine people. Our technology draws on diverse and reliable data to create a single point of truth for identity and address verification.

With over 30 years of experience behind us our team and technology are focused on enabling safe and rewarding digital lives for everyone. Regardless of age, location or background, genuine people everywhere should be able to digitally prove who they are and where they live.

About the team and role

The Team: Revenue Operations – Americas

You’ll join a hands-on, execution-oriented Revenue Operations team that partners directly with the Americas GTM organization. The team is embedded in daily pipeline management, forecasting, deal execution, and systems enablement, while also driving the evolution of scalable processes and governance.

This is a collaborative, fast-moving environment where RevOps works shoulder-to-shoulder with sellers and leaders, takes ownership of outcomes, and continuously improves how the business operates. You’ll also collaborate closely with global RevOps peers to ensure alignment and share best practices across regions.

Revenue Operations Coordinator, Contracts

The RevOps Coordinator – Contracts is a hands-on execution role supporting the daily operations of our quoting and contract processes within Salesforce. This position plays a critical role in ensuring quotes and contracts move efficiently through approval workflows, data remains accurate, and revenue-impacting processes run smoothly.

You will work closely with Sales, RevOps, Legal, Finance and our Business Systems teams to support Salesforce CPQ quoting, Ironclad contract workflows, and reporting visibility across the quote-to-cash lifecycle. This role is highly detail-oriented and process-driven, with a strong focus on operational consistency, responsiveness, and identifying opportunities for efficiency improvements.

What you will do

Quote & Contract Execution Support

  • Review and validate Salesforce Opportunities and Quotes to ensure completeness and accuracy prior to approval routing
  • Support Salesforce CPQ quote generation, amendments, and renewals
  • Route contracts through Ironclad workflows and monitor approval progression
  • Track and follow up on pending approvals to reduce cycle time and prevent revenue delays
  • Troubleshoot quoting or workflow issues in partnership with RevOps and Legal
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for internal operational contract and quoting questions

Workflow & Process Support

  • Execute established approval processes for pricing, discounting, and contract review
  • Assist with user support and onboarding related to Salesforce CPQ and contract workflow
  • Develop and maintain up-to-date internal documentation for quoting and contracting procedures
  • Ensure compliance with defined approval matrices and governance standards

Reporting, Visibility & Process Efficiency

  • Maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards to provide visibility into:
    • Quote approval timelines
    • Contract cycle time
    • Bottlenecks in approval workflows
    • Renewal and amendment tracking
  • Monitor data quality across Opportunities, Quotes, and Contract records
  • Identify recurring friction points in the quote-to-contract process and flag improvement opportunities
  • Support data audits and clean-up efforts to ensure forecasting and reporting accuracy
  • Collaborate with cross-functional supporting teams to recommend tactical process adjustments that improve speed and accuracy

Due Diligence & Vendor/Company Validation Support

  • Execute due‑diligence checks for new and existing customers to ensure company legitimacy, compliance alignment, and risk mitigation
  • Validate vendor requirements and confirm necessary documentation (security questionnaires, procurement forms, financial verification, legal entity validation, etc.) is collected and complete
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, and Security teams to resolve gaps identified during the due‑diligence process
  • Maintain accurate records of due‑diligence outcomes in Salesforce, Ironclad, or internal systems
  • Monitor and track outstanding validation tasks to prevent delays in quote, contract, or vendor‑related workflows

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years supporting Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Contracts, or Quote-to-Cash processes
  • Working experience with Salesforce (Opportunity and Quote management, reporting, data hygiene)
  • Experience supporting Salesforce CPQ or similar quoting systems
  • Experience supporting due‑diligence processes, customer validation, or vendor onboarding requirements (preferred but not required)
  • Experience working with Ironclad or contract lifecycle management platforms
  • Strong attention to detail and process discipline
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and follow up proactively
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills

Benefits

To find out more

As an equal opportunity employer, we are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. Please inform your GBG Talent Attraction Partner if you require any reasonable adjustments to the interview process.

To chat to the Talent Attraction team and find out more about our benefits and why we’re a great place to work, drop an email to and we’ll be in touch. You can also find out more about careers at GBG and check out our current opportunities at gbgplc.com/careers.

raw.description:
Job brief

Join Elite Escapes and turn your passion for travel into your next career.

As a Remote Cruise Planner (Sales-Focused),

you'll help clients turn we should take a cruise someday into a confirmed sailing they cannot wait to board. You'll combine destination knowledge, great service, and a consultative sales approach to match travelers with the right ship, itinerary, cabin, and onboard experience—whether they are planning a romantic escape, multigenerational family vacation, celebration at sea, group sailing, or bucket-list voyage.

What You'll Do

  • Connect with clients to understand their preferred destinations, travel style, budget, dates, group size, and cruise must-haves.
  • Recommend the right cruise line, ship, itinerary, stateroom, dining package, shore excursions, and add-ons based on each traveler's needs.
  • Turn inquiries into confirmed cruise vacations through email, chat, and phone with energy, accuracy, and a client-first approach.
  • Explain cruise options clearly, including cabin categories, deposits, payment plans, travel protection, onboard packages, and port requirements.
  • Handle booking details, special requests, changes, payments, upgrades, and pre-cruise questions with professionalism and care.
  • Resolve concerns quickly and confidently, helping clients feel supported from their first quote through embarkation and their return home.
  • Share valuable cruise insights—best sailings for families, romantic itineraries, hidden-gem ports, seasonal opportunities, and limited-time promotions.
  • Build post-booking relationships that encourage repeat sailings, referrals, reviews, and long-term client loyalty.

Nice to Have

  • Interest in cruises, ocean travel, river cruising, expedition voyages, or helping people explore the world by sea.
  • Travel-industry, sales, hospitality, customer-service, or booking experience is preferred—but not required. Zero experience is welcome.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to guide clients toward a decision.
  • Strong organization skills and comfort managing multiple quotes, reservations, follow-ups, and client details.
  • Comfort with technology, online booking platforms, CRM systems, and AI tools—we will train you on the rest.
  • A genuine passion for travel, memorable experiences, and helping clients find the cruise that feels made for them.

What You Get

  • Fully remote work with the flexibility to build your schedule around your life.
  • Comprehensive onboarding and training on cruise lines, ships, itineraries, supplier platforms, sales conversations, and travel planning.
  • A collaborative, supportive team atmosphere with colleagues who want to see you succeed.
  • The opportunity to grow into specialties such as luxury cruises, family cruising, group sailings, river cruises, expedition travel, or destination celebrations.
  • Clear paths toward leadership and higher earning potential.

Cruise planning has plenty of moving parts—but if you enjoy helping people choose between ocean views and balconies, island stops and bucket-list ports, relaxation and adventure, you will thrive here. Your work will transform questions into bookings and cruise dreams into unforgettable days at sea.

Who We Are

We curate journeys that turn travel dreams into reality. We believe travel and adventure should create transformative, lifelong memories — that's why we partner with advisors who share that passion.

Sound Like You?

Apply today—we look forward to welcoming you aboard.
