Founded by Arianna Huffington in 2016, Thrive Global is a leading behavior change technology company with the mission to improve productivity and health outcomes – one Microstep at a time. Thrive helps individuals and organizations improve well-being, performance and mental resilience with its AI-powered behavior change technology platform. Thrive’s Microsteps – small, science-backed steps to improve health and productivity – have been adopted by employees at more than 230 organizations in over 160 countries, from frontline and call center workers to executives at multinational companies. For more information, visitwww.thriveglobal.com.

The Coaching & Engagement Lead leads a dedicated team of contract Health Coaches and manages programming and account operations for one of Thrive’s largest global enterprise accounts. The coaches provide 1:1 coaching, lead fitness classes and live sessions, and build relationships with regional stakeholders.

You’ll give coaches clear priorities, feedback and support, and help more employees participate in coaching and live programming. You’ll also take on operational responsibilities across the account, including coordinating content reviews and improving delivery processes, with priorities set by the Operations Manager.

This is a hands-on leadership and operations role with no coaching caseload.

How You'll Contribute

Lead the Coaching Team

  • Run regular 1:1s and team meetings, clarify priorities, remove blockers and provide timely feedback.
  • Set coach goals aligned with account priorities, including enrollment, participation, stakeholder engagement and participant outcomes.
  • Clarify responsibilities across 1:1 coaching, webinars, workshops and fitness classes, and coordinate assignments and schedules across regions.
  • Address performance concerns directly and document follow-up, involving the Operations Manager when formal action is needed.
  • Keep assignments within each contractor’s agreed scope and availability, escalating proposed changes to scope, rates or delivery commitments.

Manage Coach-Led Programming

  • Use attendance, participant feedback and client priorities to improve session timing, topics and formats within the approved roadmap.
  • Partner with the Program Manager to define success measures and recommend adding, changing or retiring offerings.
  • Work with Content to maintain a coach-ready library, with clear guidelines on what coaches can develop, adapt and present.
  • Give coaches the materials and guidance they need to deliver consistently while adapting to regional needs.
  • Provide feedback on coaching and facilitation quality, partnering with the Director, Coaching Operations on standards, methodology and quality concerns.

Grow Participation and Regional Engagement

  • Plan and run regional campaigns to grow coaching enrollment and encourage continued participation, coordinating with the Program Manager and Wellbeing Coordinators.
  • Connect 1:1 coaching with webinars, Leadership Journeys and other program activities.
  • Guide coaches in building relationships with regional HR, benefits, ERG and site leaders, and flag potential expansion opportunities to the Account Director.
  • Align coach outreach with regional engagement plans so stakeholders receive coordinated communication.

Manage Account Operations

  • Own operational work assigned by the Operations Manager, including event tracking, scheduling, delivery documentation and process improvements.
  • Coordinate content and campaign reviews between Thrive’s Content team and client reviewers, managing requests, edits, approvals and deadlines.
  • Maintain accurate, aligned records in Thrive’s documentation hub and client systems, including SharePoint.
  • Develop and maintain coach playbooks, onboarding materials and procedures.
  • Track coach capacity and contracted commitments, flag coverage gaps and coordinate with the Program Manager on the account calendar.
  • Combine programming attendance and feedback with coaching usage reporting from Coaching Operations to identify improvements and inform client reviews.
  • Share recommendations and participant stories with the Program Manager, consistent with Thrive’s confidentiality standards.
  • Coordinate coach onboarding and platform or booking issues with Coaching Operations.

    • Qualifications & Skills

    • 4+ years in coaching, wellbeing program delivery or service operations, including experience leading coaches, practitioners or contractors.
    • Experience coordinating live programming across regions and managing competing deadlines, schedules and stakeholders.
    • A clear, supportive leadership style, with the ability to give feedback and address missed expectations.
    • Comfort combining team leadership with detailed, hands-on operational work.
    • Experience setting goals and using participation data and feedback to improve programming.
    • Experience working with large enterprise clients and HR, benefits or regional stakeholders.
    • Experience managing content or communications review cycles, with strong attention to detail.
    • Sound judgment about when to make a decision, seek input or escalate an issue.
    • Health coach certification, such as NBC-HWC, or a coaching background is a plus.

    ✨ What We Offer:

    • 🌍 Mission-Driven Impact: Be part of a company that’s truly making a difference in people’s lives around the world.
    • 🚀 Career Growth: Develop within the company and help shape our growth strategy.
    • 💙 Human-Centric Culture: Thrive in a supportive environment with a range of wellness perks and benefits.
    • 💰 Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a comprehensive and rewarding total compensation package.
    • 🩺 Health & Financial Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage plus a 401(k) program with company match.
    • 🌴 Time to Recharge: Generous paid time-off programs designed to help you rest, reset, and recharge — including Thrive Time, a benefit unique to Thrive that gives employees additional paid time off after major projects or intense periods of work to truly recharge and recover.

    Compensation:

    Base compensation for this role will likely fall in the $120,000-$140,000 range.

    • Please note: We provide a competitive mix of salary, performance bonus, and equity. The final offer amount will depend on factors like experience, expertise, and may differ from the range above. This range also excludes additional benefits, such as 401(k), and medical, dental, or vision insurance.

    Thrive is proud to ensure equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, family or parental status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Become a part of our caring community

The Care Manager, Telephonic Nurse 2 , in a telephonic environment, assesses and evaluates members' needs and requirements to achieve and/or maintain optimal wellness state by guiding members/families toward and facilitate interaction with resources appropriate for the care and wellbeing of members. The Care Manager, Telephonic Nurse 2 work assignments are varied and frequently require interpretation and independent determination of the appropriate courses of action.

Our nurses are titled Care Managers, because our case management services are centered on the person rather than the condition. We contact members with multiple chronic conditions as well as financial and functional barriers in order to assist them in achieving and maintaining optimum health. We provide telephonic outreach to assess and support their health, offering education, identifying resources, and helping remove barriers to achieving health and independence, while using a multidisciplinary team.


This position will be part of our Special Needs Program (SNP) team. All of our SNP RN Care Managers are work at home associates, working from a dedicated home office space. Work at home care managers are responsible for meeting quality and productivity measures daily and maintaining working home internet at all time with demonstrated advanced communication and interpersonal skills.


This is a very compliance driven and highly visible program at Humana. The nature of the work requires telephonic interaction with members during the majority of the business day, primarily through an auto dialer system. Environment is fast paced and requires ability to engage quickly with member while concurrently navigating multiple computer applications. Due to the auto dialer process and compliance needs of the business there is limited day to day flexibility in care manager's schedule.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Telephonically assess Medicare, Medicaid, and/or and Group Account members and create actionable and measurable care plans to help guide and track the members' progress toward goals
  • Use nursing judgment to assess and coordinate care for acute situations (APS, EMS)
  • Discuss transitions of care to assist with safe discharge to the home and coordinate care for DME, home health, provider appointments, etc.
  • Guide members and their families toward and facilitate interaction with resources appropriate for the care and wellbeing of members
  • Assess member's physical, environmental and psycho-social health issues and work in collaboration with a multi-disciplinary team, such as social workers, dietitians, pharmacists, etc., employing a variety of strategies/techniques to manage appropriately and provide timely intervention


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Active Registered Nurse (RN) Multi-State/Compact State license with no disciplinary action
  • 3 or more years of clinical nursing experience
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Word, Excel, Outlook with the ability to quickly learn and navigate new applications
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in nursing (BSN)
  • Previous experience with adult chronic conditions or care management
  • Case Management certification (CCM)
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish

Additional Information

  • Training: The first 4 weeks of training are Monday-Friday 8:30am to 5:00pm EST., (No time off is permitted during the first month of training)
  • Schedule: Core hours for this position after training are Monday-Friday 9:00am to 5:30pm EST
  • Work Style: Remote
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$71,100 - $97,800 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 11-18-2026


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Operations, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Pharmacy Network Development Manager to help expand and strengthen Bask Health's network of pharmacy partners.

You'll identify potential pharmacy partners, evaluate their capabilities, develop relationships with pharmacy operators and decision-makers, and help build a network that supports our growing platform.

This role focuses on finding the right partners and developing new opportunities. You'll research pharmacy markets, assess potential partners, coordinate introductory discussions, and work with internal teams to determine which partnerships are worth pursuing.

You'll also collaborate with our commercial and operations teams to help qualified pharmacy partners move through evaluation, negotiation, and onboarding.

  • Research pharmacy markets to identify potential network gaps and expansion opportunities.

  • Support the transition of qualified partners into contracting and implementation processes.
  • Maintain communication with prospective partners throughout the evaluation process.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen existing pharmacy relationships and expand their capabilities.
  • Monitor market developments and emerging pharmacy partnership opportunities.
  • Build repeatable processes for partner research, outreach, evaluation, and qualification.
  • Prepare updates on network development activity, partnership opportunities, and outstanding dependencies.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering when prospective partnerships involve platform or integration considerations.
  • Work with Customer Success to understand pharmacy coverage needs affecting merchants.
  • Ensure pharmacy licensing and clinical matters are reviewed by appropriately qualified professionals.

  • Experience conducting outreach, discovery discussions, and partner qualification.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.

  • Comfortable using spreadsheets, CRM systems, and project management tools.
  • Ability to prepare clear partnership summaries and recommendations.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.
